clue_en: The audience keeps applauding after the planned final song. What may the performer return to play?
clue_et: Publik aplodeerib pärast kavas olnud viimast lugu edasi. Mida võib esineja naastes veel mängida?
explanation_en: An encore is an additional performance given after the scheduled programme has ended.
explanation_et: Lisalugu on pärast kavandatud programmi lõppu esitatav täiendav pala.

clue_en: What concert stunt carries a person above the audience on many raised hands?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse kontserditrikki, kus inimest kantakse publiku kohale tõstetud kätel?
explanation_en: During crowd surfing, audience members pass a person overhead from hand to hand.
explanation_et: Publiku kätel surfamisel annavad pealtvaatajad inimese pea kohal käest kätte edasi.

clue_en: What pre-show rehearsal lets musicians and technicians balance microphones and speakers?
clue_et: Milline kontserdieelne proov võimaldab muusikutel ja tehnikutel mikrofone ning kõlareid tasakaalustada?
explanation_en: A soundcheck tests the venue sound system and adjusts levels before the audience arrives.
explanation_et: Heliproovis katsetatakse saali helisüsteemi ja seadistatakse helitasemed enne publiku saabumist.

clue_en: What written order tells a band which songs it plans to play that night?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse kirja pandud järjekorda, mis näitab bändile, milliseid lugusid sel õhtul esitada?
explanation_en: A set list records the planned running order of songs for a performance.
explanation_et: Lugude nimekiri paneb paika kontserdil esitatavate palade kavandatud järjekorra.

clue_en: What performer appears before the main attraction to warm up the audience?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse esinejat, kes astub publiku soojendamiseks üles enne peaesinejat?
explanation_en: A supporting act performs an earlier, usually shorter set before the headliner.
explanation_et: Soojendusesineja annab enne peaesinejat tavaliselt lühema kontserdi.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which band recorded We Will Rock You, whose stomp-stomp-clap beat fills sports arenas?
clue_et: Milline bänd salvestas spordiareenidel kõlava tramp-tramp-plaks-rütmiga loo „We Will Rock You“?
explanation_en: Queen released We Will Rock You on the 1977 album News of the World.
explanation_et: Queen avaldas loo „We Will Rock You“ 1977. aasta albumil „News of the World“.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Whose recording of Sweet Caroline invites crowds to sing its famous “ba, ba, ba” response?
clue_et: Kelle salvestatud „Sweet Caroline“ kutsub publikut kaasa laulma kuulsat „ba, ba, ba“ vastust?
explanation_en: Neil Diamond wrote and recorded Sweet Caroline, which became a crowd singalong at many sporting events.
explanation_et: Neil Diamond kirjutas ja salvestas loo „Sweet Caroline“, millest sai paljudel spordiüritustel ühislaul.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Supporters of which English football club are especially famous for singing You’ll Never Walk Alone?
clue_et: Millise Inglise jalgpalliklubi poolehoidjad on eriti tuntud laulu „You’ll Never Walk Alone“ laulmise poolest?
explanation_en: Liverpool supporters adopted You’ll Never Walk Alone in the 1960s and still sing it before matches.
explanation_et: Liverpooli poolehoidjad võtsid laulu „You’ll Never Walk Alone“ omaks 1960. aastatel ja laulavad seda enne mänge siiani.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which rock duo created the seven-note riff that crowds chant from Seven Nation Army?
clue_et: Milline rokkduo lõi loo „Seven Nation Army“ seitsmenoodilise rifi, mida publik skandeerib?
explanation_en: The White Stripes released Seven Nation Army in 2003, and its riff became a worldwide sports chant.
explanation_et: The White Stripes avaldas „Seven Nation Army“ 2003. aastal ning selle rifist sai üleilmne spordiskandeering.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which Italian singer recorded Freed from Desire, later adapted into the football chant “Will Grigg’s on Fire”?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia lauljanna salvestas loo „Freed from Desire“, millest tehti hiljem jalgpalliskandeering „Will Grigg’s on Fire“?
explanation_en: Gala Rizzatto released Freed from Desire in 1996, and its melody later became a popular football chant.
explanation_et: Gala Rizzatto avaldas „Freed from Desire“ 1996. aastal ning selle meloodiast sai hiljem populaarne jalgpalliskandeering.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Four Beatles walk across a zebra crossing on the cover of which album?
clue_et: Millise albumi kaanel kõnnivad neli biitlit üle sebra?
explanation_en: The Beatles were photographed on the crossing outside their London studio for the Abbey Road cover.
explanation_et: The Beatles pildistati „Abbey Roadi“ kaane jaoks Londonis stuudio ees oleval sebral.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which band put a swimming baby chasing a dollar bill on the cover of Nevermind?
clue_et: Milline bänd pani albumi „Nevermind“ kaanele dollarit taga ajava ujuva beebi?
explanation_en: Nirvana used the underwater baby photograph for the cover of its 1991 album Nevermind.
explanation_et: Nirvana kasutas veealuse beebi fotot oma 1991. aasta albumi „Nevermind“ kaanel.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which musician appears with a red-and-blue lightning bolt across his face on the cover of Aladdin Sane?
clue_et: Milline muusik on albumi „Aladdin Sane“ kaanel, näol punasinine välgunool?
explanation_en: Brian Duffy photographed David Bowie in the lightning-bolt makeup created for the Aladdin Sane cover.
explanation_et: Brian Duffy pildistas David Bowiet „Aladdin Sane’i“ kaane jaoks loodud välgunoolemeigiga.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which pop artist designed the peelable banana cover for The Velvet Underground & Nico?
clue_et: Milline popkunstnik kujundas albumile „The Velvet Underground & Nico“ kooritava banaaniga kaane?
explanation_en: Andy Warhol supplied the banana artwork and was credited as the album producer.
explanation_et: Andy Warhol lõi banaanikujunduse ja oli albumil märgitud produtsendina.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which Joy Division album has a black cover crossed by stacked white radio-wave lines from a pulsar?
clue_et: Millise Joy Divisioni albumi mustal kaanel on pulsari raadiosignaalist pärit üksteise kohal valged jooned?
explanation_en: The Unknown Pleasures cover visualises radio pulses recorded from pulsar CP 1919.
explanation_et: „Unknown Pleasuresi“ kaanel on kujutatud pulsari CP 1919 salvestatud raadioimpulsse.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which curved metal wind instrument with a single-reed mouthpiece is strongly associated with jazz?
clue_et: Milline kõver metallist puhkpill kasutab ühte lesthuulikut ja seostub eriti džässiga?
explanation_en: The saxophone has a conical metal body but produces sound with a single reed like a clarinet.
explanation_et: Saksofonil on kooniline metallkorpus, kuid heli tekitab klarneti moodi üksik lest.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which instrument has an air bag under the player’s arm and several pipes rising from it?
clue_et: Millisel pillil on mängija kaenla all õhukott, millest ulatub välja mitu toru?
explanation_en: Bagpipes feed stored air from a bag into a melody pipe and one or more drone pipes.
explanation_et: Torupill juhib kotis oleva õhu viisitorusse ja ühte või mitmesse burdoonitorusse.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which small tube-shaped instrument changes a player’s humming into a buzzing sound?
clue_et: Milline väike torukujuline pill muudab mängija ümisemise põrisevaks heliks?
explanation_en: A kazoo uses a vibrating membrane to colour the sound of a player humming into it.
explanation_et: Kazuu membraan võngub, kui mängija pilli sisse ümiseb, ning muudab heli kõla.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which tuned metal instrument from Trinidad and Tobago is made from a concave steel surface?
clue_et: Milline Trinidadist ja Tobagost pärit häälestatud metallpill on valmistatud nõgusast teraspinnast?
explanation_en: A steelpan has tuned note areas hammered into the surface of a steel drum.
explanation_et: Steelpannil on terastrumli pinnale vormitud häälestatud noodialad.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which electronic instrument is played without touch by moving both hands near two antennas?
clue_et: Millist elektroonilist pilli mängitakse puudutamata, liigutades käsi kahe antenni lähedal?
explanation_en: A theremin senses hand position around its antennas to control pitch and volume.
explanation_et: Teremin tajub käte asendit antennide ümber ning juhib selle järgi helikõrgust ja tugevust.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which offbeat popular-music style grew in Jamaica and was taken worldwide by artists such as Bob Marley?
clue_et: Milline rõhutatud vasturütmiga levimuusikastiil kasvas välja Jamaical ja levis maailma muu hulgas Bob Marley kaudu?
explanation_en: Reggae developed in Jamaica in the late 1960s from ska, rocksteady, and other influences.
explanation_et: Reggae kujunes Jamaical 1960. aastate lõpus ska, rocksteady ja teiste mõjutuste põhjal.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which partner dance grew around the Río de la Plata in Argentina and Uruguay?
clue_et: Milline paaristants kasvas välja Argentina ja Uruguay vahelise Río de la Plata ümbruses?
explanation_en: Tango emerged in working-class districts around Buenos Aires and Montevideo.
explanation_et: Tango tekkis Buenos Airese ja Montevideo töölislinnaosades.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: What Mexican ensemble tradition features violins, trumpets, and guitar-family instruments in matching dress?
clue_et: Milline Mehhiko ansamblitraditsioon ühendab viiulid, trompetid ja kitarrilaadsed pillid ning ühtse riietuse?
explanation_en: Modern mariachi groups combine strings and trumpets and are strongly associated with Mexican celebrations.
explanation_et: Tänapäeva mariachi-ansamblid ühendavad keelpille ja trompeteid ning kuuluvad tihedalt Mehhiko pidustuste juurde.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which Portuguese song tradition is known for expressive singing about longing and fate?
clue_et: Milline Portugali laulutraditsioon on tuntud igatsusest ja saatusest rääkiva tundelise esituse poolest?
explanation_en: Fado became established in Lisbon and is commonly accompanied by Portuguese guitar.
explanation_et: Fado kinnistus Lissabonis ning seda saadab tavaliselt Portugali kitarr.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which witty, topical song style developed in Trinidad and Tobago and spread internationally in the twentieth century?
clue_et: Milline teravmeelne ja päevakajaline laulustiil kujunes Trinidadis ja Tobagos ning levis kahekümnendal sajandil maailma?
explanation_en: Calypso singers use memorable melodies and wordplay to comment on public events and society.
explanation_et: Kalüpsolauljad kommenteerivad meeldejäävate meloodiate ja sõnamänguga ühiskonda ning päevasündmusi.

clue_en: Before her solo career, Beyoncé sang in which group with hits such as Say My Name?
clue_et: Millises hittidega „Say My Name“ tuntud ansamblis laulis Beyoncé enne soolokarjääri?
explanation_en: Beyoncé rose to fame as a member of Destiny’s Child before releasing solo albums.
explanation_et: Beyoncé sai tuntuks Destiny’s Childi liikmena enne sooloalbumite avaldamist.

clue_en: Which Genesis drummer later became the band’s lead singer and a major solo star?
clue_et: Millisest Genesise trummarist sai hiljem bändi laulja ja suur sooloartist?
explanation_en: Phil Collins joined Genesis as drummer and took over lead vocals after Peter Gabriel left.
explanation_et: Phil Collins liitus Genesisega trummarina ja võttis pärast Peter Gabrieli lahkumist üle laulja rolli.

clue_en: Stefani Germanotta records pop music under which name?
clue_et: Millise nime all salvestab Stefani Germanotta popmuusikat?
explanation_en: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta adopted Lady Gaga as her professional name.
explanation_et: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta võttis artistinimeks Lady Gaga.

clue_en: Farrokh Bulsara became the lead singer of Queen under which name?
clue_et: Millise nime all sai Farrokh Bulsarast Queeni laulja?
explanation_en: Farrokh Bulsara adopted the name Freddie Mercury while building his career with Queen.
explanation_et: Farrokh Bulsara võttis Queeniga karjääri alustades nimeks Freddie Mercury.

clue_en: Reginald Kenneth Dwight became famous under which stage name?
clue_et: Millise lavanime all sai kuulsaks Reginald Kenneth Dwight?
explanation_en: The British singer and pianist legally changed his name to Elton Hercules John.
explanation_et: Briti laulja ja pianist muutis oma nime ametlikult Elton Hercules Johniks.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which composer wrote the piano favourite Für Elise?
clue_et: Milline helilooja kirjutas populaarse klaveripala „Für Elise“?
explanation_en: Beethoven’s Bagatelle No. 25 in A minor is widely known by its dedication Für Elise.
explanation_et: Beethoveni bagatelli nr 25 a-mollis tuntakse laialt pühenduse „Für Elise“ järgi.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: The Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy comes from which Tchaikovsky ballet?
clue_et: Millisest Tšaikovski balletist pärineb Suhkruhaldja tants?
explanation_en: Tchaikovsky included the Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy in the second act of The Nutcracker.
explanation_et: Tšaikovski lisas Suhkruhaldja tantsu „Pähklipureja“ teise vaatusse.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Who composed the Bridal Chorus commonly heard as “Here Comes the Bride”?
clue_et: Kes kirjutas pulmatseremooniatelt tuntud pruudikoori „Here Comes the Bride“?
explanation_en: Wagner wrote the Bridal Chorus for his opera Lohengrin.
explanation_et: Wagner kirjutas pruudikoori ooperile „Lohengrin“.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which Richard Strauss tone poem accompanies the famous sunrise in Stanley Kubrick’s space epic?
clue_et: Milline Richard Straussi sümfooniline poeem saadab Stanley Kubricku kosmoseeepose kuulsat päikesetõusu?
explanation_en: Stanley Kubrick used the opening fanfare of Also sprach Zarathustra in 2001: A Space Odyssey.
explanation_et: Stanley Kubrick kasutas filmi „2001: Kosmoseodüsseia“ alguses teose „Nõnda kõneles Zarathustra“ fanfaari.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which composer wrote O Fortuna as the opening and closing movement of Carmina Burana?
clue_et: Milline helilooja kirjutas „O Fortuna“ kantaadi „Carmina Burana“ ava- ja lõpupalaks?
explanation_en: Carl Orff set the medieval poem O Fortuna to music in his cantata Carmina Burana.
explanation_et: Carl Orff viis keskaegse luuletuse „O Fortuna“ muusikasse kantaadis „Carmina Burana“.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which battle gave its name to the song that won Eurovision for ABBA?
clue_et: Milline lahing andis nime laulule, millega ABBA Eurovisiooni võitis?
explanation_en: ABBA’s song compares a romantic surrender with Napoleon’s defeat at Waterloo.
explanation_et: ABBA laul võrdleb romantilist alistumist Napoleoni kaotusega Waterloo lahingus.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which comedy film sent its characters headbanging in a car to Queen’s Bohemian Rhapsody?
clue_et: Millises komöödiafilmis kuulavad tegelased autos Queeni „Bohemian Rhapsodyt“ ja loobivad pead?
explanation_en: The car singalong in Wayne’s World helped return Bohemian Rhapsody to the charts.
explanation_et: Filmi „Wayne’i maailm“ autostseen aitas „Bohemian Rhapsody“ uuesti edetabelitesse.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which band turned a casino fire beside Lake Geneva into the song Smoke on the Water?
clue_et: Milline bänd tegi Genfi järve ääres puhkenud kasiinopõlengust laulu „Smoke on the Water“?
explanation_en: Deep Purple wrote Smoke on the Water after seeing smoke spread over Lake Geneva from the Montreux Casino fire.
explanation_et: Deep Purple kirjutas „Smoke on the Wateri“ pärast seda, kui Montreux’ kasiino põlengu suits levis üle Genfi järve.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which science-fiction film inspired the title of David Bowie’s song Space Oddity?
clue_et: Milline ulmefilm inspireeris David Bowie laulu „Space Oddity“ pealkirja?
explanation_en: Bowie’s title was a play on 2001: A Space Odyssey, which he saw before writing the song.
explanation_et: Bowie pealkiri mängis filmi „2001: Kosmoseodüsseia“ nimega; ta nägi filmi enne laulu kirjutamist.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: The Nokia tune borrows a phrase from Gran Vals by which Spanish classical guitarist?
clue_et: Nokia helin laenab fraasi millise Hispaania klassikalise kitarristi teosest „Gran Vals“?
explanation_en: The familiar Nokia tune comes from a phrase in Tárrega’s 1902 guitar piece Gran Vals.
explanation_et: Tuntud Nokia helin pärineb Tárrega 1902. aasta kitarripala „Gran Vals“ fraasist.

clue_en: What kind of notation symbol marks a measured period of silence?
clue_et: Milline noodikirja märk tähistab kindla pikkusega vaikust?
explanation_en: Each rest symbol represents silence lasting for a defined note value.
explanation_et: Iga pausimärk tähistab kindla noodivältuse pikkust vaikust.

clue_en: Which clef, also called the G clef, is normally used for higher-pitched notes?
clue_et: Millist võtit, mida nimetatakse ka G-võtmeks, kasutatakse tavaliselt kõrgemate nootide jaoks?
explanation_en: The treble clef curls around the staff line assigned to the note G.
explanation_et: Viiulivõti keerdub ümber noodijoone, millel asub noot G.

clue_en: Which musical symbol tells a player to raise a note by one semitone?
clue_et: Milline muusikamärk käsib mängijal tõsta nooti ühe pooltooni võrra?
explanation_en: A sharp raises the pitch of its note by one semitone in standard notation.
explanation_et: Diees tõstab noodiga märgitud heli kõrgust ühe pooltooni võrra.

clue_en: Which clef is commonly used for low instruments such as the bass guitar and cello?
clue_et: Millist võtit kasutatakse sageli madalate pillide, näiteks basskitarri ja tšello nootide kirjutamiseks?
explanation_en: The bass clef, or F clef, places its dots around the line for the note F.
explanation_et: Bassivõtme ehk F-võtme kaks punkti ümbritsevad noodijoont, millel asub noot F.

clue_en: Which notation sign cancels an earlier sharp or flat and restores the unaltered pitch?
clue_et: Milline noodimärk tühistab varasema dieesi või bemolli ja taastab muutmata helikõrguse?
explanation_en: A natural sign cancels a sharp or flat that would otherwise alter the note.
explanation_et: Bekarr tühistab dieesi või bemolli, mis muidu noodi helikõrgust muudaks.

clue_en: Which standard female singing range lies above mezzo-soprano?
clue_et: Milline tavapärane naise lauluhääl paikneb metsosopranist kõrgemal?
explanation_en: No standard female category in classical part writing is placed above soprano.
explanation_et: Klassikalises häälestuses ei paigutata ühtki tavapärast naishäält sopranist kõrgemale.

clue_en: Which lower female voice often sings beneath the sopranos in a choir?
clue_et: Milline madalam naishääl laulab kooris sageli sopranitest allpool?
explanation_en: Alto is the lower female part in the usual four-part choral arrangement.
explanation_et: Alt on tavapärases neljahäälses kooriseades madalam naishääl.

clue_en: An adult male part above baritone normally uses which vocal range?
clue_et: Millist hääleliiki kasutab täiskasvanud meeslaulja baritonist kõrgemas partiis?
explanation_en: No common adult male category in classical part writing is placed above tenor.
explanation_et: Klassikalises häälestuses ei paigutata ühtki levinud täiskasvanud mehe häält tenorist kõrgemale.

clue_en: The lowest standard male choral part has what name?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse koori madalaimat tavapärast meeshäält?
explanation_en: Bass is the lowest standard male vocal range and anchors four-part harmony.
explanation_et: Bass on madalaim tavapärane meeshääl ning annab neljahäälsele harmooniale aluse.

clue_en: Which male singing voice lies between tenor and bass?
clue_et: Milline meeshääl asub tenori ja bassi vahel?
explanation_en: Baritone occupies the middle male range between the higher tenor and lower bass.
explanation_et: Bariton paikneb kõrgema tenori ja madalama bassi vahel.

clue_en: Who stands before an orchestra and coordinates its tempo, entries, and interpretation?
clue_et: Kes seisab orkestri ees ning juhib tempot, pillirühmade sisseastumisi ja teose tõlgendust?
explanation_en: A conductor leads the ensemble through visible gestures and rehearsal decisions.
explanation_et: Dirigent juhib ansamblit nähtavate žestide ja proovides tehtud tõlgendusotsustega.

clue_en: Which orchestra section includes violins, violas, cellos, and double basses?
clue_et: Millisesse orkestrirühma kuuluvad viiulid, vioolad, tšellod ja kontrabassid?
explanation_en: Bowed string instruments form a principal section of the modern orchestra.
explanation_et: Poognaga mängitavad keelpillid moodustavad ühe nüüdisaegse orkestri põhirühma.

clue_en: Which orchestra section contains instruments mainly struck, shaken, or scraped?
clue_et: Milline orkestrirühm sisaldab peamiselt löödavaid, raputatavaid või kraabitavaid pille?
explanation_en: The percussion section includes drums, cymbals, and many other struck instruments.
explanation_et: Löökpillide hulka kuuluvad trummid, taldrikud ja paljud muud löödavad pillid.

clue_en: Which orchestra section includes trumpets, horns, trombones, and tubas?
clue_et: Millisesse orkestrirühma kuuluvad trompetid, metsasarved, tromboonid ja tuubad?
explanation_en: Players in the brass section produce sound by buzzing their lips into a mouthpiece.
explanation_et: Vaskpuhkpillimängijad tekitavad heli huulikusse surutud huulte võnkumisega.

clue_en: Which principal violinist leads the orchestra’s string section and usually sits nearest the conductor?
clue_et: Milline esiviiuldaja juhib orkestri keelpillirühma ja istub tavaliselt dirigendile kõige lähemal?
explanation_en: The concertmaster is the lead violinist and senior player in a standard orchestra.
explanation_et: Kontsertmeister on tavapärase orkestri juhtiv viiuldaja ja vanemmängija.

clue_en: Which pair of handheld rattles is shaken to add a crisp rhythm in much Latin American music?
clue_et: Millist käes hoitavat kõristipilli paari raputatakse paljudes Ladina-Ameerika muusikastiilides terava rütmi loomiseks?
explanation_en: Seeds or beads inside the hollow shells strike their walls when the player shakes them.
explanation_et: Õõnsate kestade sees olevad seemned või helmed löövad raputamisel vastu seinu.

clue_en: Which percussion instrument has tuned wooden bars arranged like a keyboard?
clue_et: Millisel löökpillil on klaviatuuri moodi paigutatud häälestatud puitplaadid?
explanation_en: A xylophone produces notes when its graduated wooden bars are struck with mallets.
explanation_et: Ksülofonil tekivad noodid, kui eri pikkusega puitplaate lüüakse nuiadega.

clue_en: Which percussion instruments are thin metal discs that may be struck together or with sticks?
clue_et: Millised löökpillid on õhukesed metallkettad, mida lüüakse kokku või pulkadega?
explanation_en: Cymbals create bright crashing or shimmering sounds from vibrating metal discs.
explanation_et: Taldrikud tekitavad vibreerivate metallketastega eredaid kõlavaid või sillerdavaid helisid.

clue_en: Which percussion instrument is a metal bar bent into a three-sided shape?
clue_et: Milline löökpill on kolmnurkseks painutatud metallvarras?
explanation_en: The open-cornered metal triangle rings when struck with a metal beater.
explanation_et: Avatud nurgaga metalltriangel heliseb, kui seda lüüa metallpulgaga.

clue_en: Which orchestral kettle drums can be tuned to specific pitches, often with a pedal?
clue_et: Milliseid orkestri kateltrumme saab häälestada kindlatele helikõrgustele, sageli pedaaliga?
explanation_en: Timpani use a stretched head over a bowl and a mechanism that changes its tension.
explanation_et: Timpanitel on kausi kohale pingutatud membraan, mille pinget muudab häälestusmehhanism.

clue_en: Which standard orchestral string instrument is smaller and higher-pitched than the viola, cello, and double bass?

clue_et: Millise 1983. aasta instrumentaalpalaga tõid Herbie Hancock ja GrandMixer DXT plaadikraapimise laia telepublikuni?
explanation_en: Herbie Hancock’s “Rockit” prominently featured GrandMixer DXT’s scratching and became a mainstream showcase for turntablism.
explanation_et: Herbie Hancocki „Rockit“ tõstis esile GrandMixer DXT plaadikraapimise ning tutvustas turntablismi laiale publikule.

clue_en: David Bowie released which album on his 69th birthday, two days before his death?
clue_et: Millise albumi avaldas David Bowie oma 69. sünnipäeval, kaks päeva enne surma?
explanation_en: David Bowie released “Blackstar” on 8 January 2016, his 69th birthday; he died two days later.
explanation_et: David Bowie avaldas „Blackstari“ 8. jaanuaril 2016, oma 69. sünnipäeval, ning suri kaks päeva hiljem.

clue_en: Otis Redding recorded which reflective song, complete with a whistled ending, only days before his fatal plane crash?
clue_et: Millise mõtliku, vilistatud lõpuga laulu salvestas Otis Redding vaid mõni päev enne surmaga lõppenud lennuõnnetust?
response_en: (Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay
response_et: (Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay
accepted_variants_en: (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay;The Dock of the Bay
accepted_variants_et: (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay;The Dock of the Bay
explanation_en: Otis Redding recorded “(Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay” shortly before his death; it was completed and released posthumously.
explanation_et: Otis Redding salvestas loo „(Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay“ veidi enne surma ning see lõpetati ja avaldati postuumselt.
source_title: (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay — Wikipedia

clue_en: Brian May doubted whether the gravely ill Freddie Mercury could manage the demanding vocal for which Queen song?
clue_et: Millise Queeni laulu nõudliku vokaali puhul kahtles Brian May, kas raskelt haige Freddie Mercury suudab selle salvestada?
explanation_en: Brian May wrote “The Show Must Go On” while Freddie Mercury was seriously ill; Mercury nevertheless recorded its demanding lead vocal.
explanation_et: Brian May kirjutas „The Show Must Go Oni“ ajal, mil Freddie Mercury oli raskelt haige, kuid Mercury salvestas siiski nõudliku soolovokaali.
source_title: The Show Must Go On (Queen song) — Wikipedia

clue_en: A cantor and the choir of Leonard Cohen’s childhood Montreal synagogue join him on which album released weeks before his death?
clue_et: Millisel vaid mõni nädal enne Leonard Coheni surma ilmunud albumil liituvad temaga kantor ja tema lapsepõlve Montreali sünagoogi koor?
explanation_en: Leonard Cohen released “You Want It Darker” in October 2016, shortly before his death; cantor Gideon Zelermyer and the Shaar Hashomayim Choir appear on the album.
explanation_et: Leonard Cohen avaldas „You Want It Darkeri“ 2016. aasta oktoobris veidi enne surma ning albumil osalevad kantor Gideon Zelermyer ja Shaar Hashomayimi koor.

clue_en: Rick Rubin’s stark production and a late-career cover of Nine Inch Nails’ “Hurt” define which Johnny Cash album?
clue_et: Millise Johnny Cashi albumi määravad Rick Rubini napp produktsioon ja hilise loometee kaver Nine Inch Nailsi loost „Hurt“?
response_en: American IV: The Man Comes Around
response_et: American IV: The Man Comes Around
explanation_en: Johnny Cash’s “American IV: The Man Comes Around”, produced by Rick Rubin, includes his acclaimed cover of Nine Inch Nails’ “Hurt”.
explanation_et: Rick Rubini produtseeritud Johnny Cashi album „American IV: The Man Comes Around“ sisaldab tunnustatud kaverit Nine Inch Nailsi loost „Hurt“.
source_title: American IV: The Man Comes Around — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Hits first meant for someone else
category_name_et: Hitid, mis olid algul mõeldud kellelegi teisele
clue_en: Simple Minds initially resisted which “Breakfast Club” song after it had been offered to Bryan Ferry and Billy Idol?
clue_et: Millisele „The Breakfast Clubi“ laulule ütles Simple Minds algul ei pärast seda, kui seda oli pakutud Bryan Ferryle ja Billy Idolile?
accepted_variants_en: Don't You (Forget About Me);Don't You Forget About Me
accepted_variants_et: Don't You (Forget About Me);Don't You Forget About Me
explanation_en: “Don’t You (Forget About Me)” was offered to several performers before Simple Minds agreed to record it for “The Breakfast Club”.
explanation_et: Lugu „Don’t You (Forget About Me)“ pakuti mitmele esitajale, enne kui Simple Minds nõustus selle „The Breakfast Clubi“ jaoks salvestama.

category_name_en: Hits first meant for someone else
category_name_et: Hitid, mis olid algul mõeldud kellelegi teisele
clue_en: S Club 7 and Sophie Ellis-Bextor passed on which Cathy Dennis and Rob Davis song before Kylie Minogue recorded it?
clue_et: Millise Cathy Dennise ja Rob Davise laulu lükkasid S Club 7 ning Sophie Ellis-Bextor tagasi, enne kui selle salvestas Kylie Minogue?
response_en: Can’t Get You Out of My Head
response_et: Can’t Get You Out of My Head
accepted_variants_en: Can't Get You Out of My Head
accepted_variants_et: Can't Get You Out of My Head
explanation_en: Cathy Dennis and Rob Davis wrote “Can’t Get You Out of My Head”; it was offered elsewhere before Kylie Minogue recorded it.
explanation_et: Cathy Dennis ja Rob Davis kirjutasid loo „Can’t Get You Out of My Head“, mida pakuti enne Kylie Minogue’i salvestust teistele esitajatele.
source_title: Can't Get You Out of My Head — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Hits first meant for someone else
category_name_et: Hitid, mis olid algul mõeldud kellelegi teisele
clue_en: Lady Gaga first wrote which duet for Britney Spears, then recorded it with Beyoncé?
clue_et: Millise dueti kirjutas Lady Gaga algul Britney Spearsile, kuid salvestas hiljem koos Beyoncéga?
explanation_en: Lady Gaga originally wrote “Telephone” for Britney Spears before recording the song herself with Beyoncé.
explanation_et: Lady Gaga kirjutas „Telephone’i“ algul Britney Spearsile, kuid salvestas loo hiljem ise koos Beyoncéga.

category_name_en: Hits first meant for someone else
category_name_et: Hitid, mis olid algul mõeldud kellelegi teisele
clue_en: The Neptunes created which Justin Timberlake hit while writing material intended for Michael Jackson’s “Invincible”?
clue_et: Millise Justin Timberlake’i hiti lõi The Neptunes ajal, mil kirjutati Michael Jacksoni albumile „Invincible“ mõeldud materjali?
explanation_en: The Neptunes originally offered “Rock Your Body” to Michael Jackson before Justin Timberlake recorded it.
explanation_et: The Neptunes pakkus „Rock Your Bodyt“ algul Michael Jacksonile, enne kui loo salvestas Justin Timberlake.

category_name_en: Hits first meant for someone else
category_name_et: Hitid, mis olid algul mõeldud kellelegi teisele
clue_en: Songwriter George Merrill first imagined which pop song for Janet Jackson before it became an early Whitney Houston hit?
clue_et: Millise poplaulu kavandas autor George Merrill esmalt Janet Jacksonile, enne kui sellest sai Whitney Houstoni varajane hitt?
explanation_en: George Merrill and Shannon Rubicam wrote “How Will I Know” with Janet Jackson in mind; Whitney Houston ultimately recorded it.
explanation_et: George Merrill ja Shannon Rubicam kirjutasid „How Will I Know“ Janet Jacksonit silmas pidades, kuid lõpuks salvestas selle Whitney Houston.

category_name_en: Live albums that made a venue legendary
clue_en: James Brown financed the recording himself after his label doubted which electrifying 1963 concert album?
clue_et: Millise sütitava 1963. aasta kontsertalbumi salvestamist rahastas James Brown ise, sest plaadifirma kahtles selle edus?
explanation_en: James Brown recorded “Live at the Apollo” in 1962 and personally financed it after King Records initially opposed a live album.
explanation_et: James Brown salvestas „Live at the Apollo“ 1962. aastal ning rahastas seda ise, sest King Records oli algul kontsertalbumi vastu.
source_title: Live at the Apollo (1963 album) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Live albums that made a venue legendary
clue_en: The Allman Brothers Band’s twin-guitar improvisations and long jams were captured at a New York venue on which landmark live album?
clue_et: Millisele märgilisele kontsertalbumile jäädvustati The Allman Brothers Bandi kahe kitarri improvisatsioonid ja pikad jämmid ühes New Yorgi kontserdipaigas?
explanation_en: The Allman Brothers Band recorded “At Fillmore East” at New York’s Fillmore East in March 1971; it became the group’s breakthrough release.
explanation_et: The Allman Brothers Band salvestas „At Fillmore Easti“ 1971. aasta märtsis New Yorgi Fillmore Eastis ning sellest sai ansambli läbimurdeplaat.

category_name_en: Live albums that made a venue legendary
clue_en: A Japanese concert release became such a popular import that Epic issued which Cheap Trick album in the United States?
clue_et: Milline Cheap Tricki Jaapanis salvestatud kontsertalbum sai nii menukaks importplaadiks, et Epic avaldas selle ka Ameerika Ühendriikides?
explanation_en: “Cheap Trick at Budokan” was first intended for Japan; strong import demand led to a US release and the band’s breakthrough.
explanation_et: „Cheap Trick at Budokan“ oli algul mõeldud Jaapani turule, kuid suur nõudlus importplaadi järele tõi USA väljalaske ja ansambli läbimurde.

category_name_en: Live albums that made a venue legendary
clue_en: Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Bud Powell, Charles Mingus and Max Roach shared the stage in Toronto on which celebrated 1953 album?
clue_et: Millisel kuulsal 1953. aasta albumil jagasid Toronto lava Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Bud Powell, Charles Mingus ja Max Roach?
explanation_en: “Jazz at Massey Hall” documents a 1953 Toronto concert by a quintet of leading bebop musicians including Parker and Gillespie.
explanation_et: „Jazz at Massey Hall“ jäädvustab 1953. aasta Toronto kontserdi, kus esines viis juhtivat bebop-muusikut, nende seas Parker ja Gillespie.

category_name_en: Live albums that made a venue legendary
clue_en: Bill Evans and producer Orrin Keepnews selected performances that spotlight bassist Scott LaFaro from Village Vanguard sessions that also yielded “Waltz for Debby”. Which live album did they assemble?
clue_et: Bill Evans ja produtsent Orrin Keepnews valisid Village Vanguardi sessioonidelt Scott LaFaro bassimängu esile tõstvad esitused; samadest salvestustest sündis ka „Waltz for Debby“. Millise kontsertalbumi nad neist kokku panid?
explanation_en: For “Sunday at the Village Vanguard”, Evans and Keepnews chose tracks that showcased LaFaro, including two of his compositions; other performances from the same sessions became “Waltz for Debby”.
explanation_et: Albumile „Sunday at the Village Vanguard“ valisid Evans ja Keepnews LaFaro bassimängu esile tõstvad palad, sealhulgas kaks tema enda teost; samade sessioonide teised esitused ilmusid albumil „Waltz for Debby“.
source_title: Sunday at the Village Vanguard — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Classical music turned into public ritual
clue_en: The European anthem uses the melody from the choral finale of Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony without Schiller’s words. What is that melody commonly called?
clue_et: Euroopa hümn kasutab Beethoveni üheksanda sümfoonia koorifinaali meloodiat ilma Schilleri sõnadeta. Mis nime all seda meloodiat tuntakse?
explanation_en: The Council of Europe and European Union use the “Ode to Joy” theme from Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony as their anthem, in an instrumental arrangement.
explanation_et: Euroopa Nõukogu ja Euroopa Liit kasutavad oma hümnina Beethoveni üheksanda sümfoonia „Oodi rõõmule“ teemat instrumentaalseades.

category_name_en: Classical music turned into public ritual
clue_en: The trio melody known in Britain as “Land of Hope and Glory” became standard American graduation music after a 1905 Yale ceremony. Name the Elgar march.
clue_et: „Land of Hope and Glory“ nime all tuntud triomeloodia sai pärast 1905. aasta Yale’i tseremooniat USA lõpuaktuste tavamuusikaks. Nimeta Elgari marss.
explanation_en: Elgar’s “Pomp and Circumstance March No. 1” supplied the melody of “Land of Hope and Glory” and became associated with graduations in the United States.
explanation_et: Elgari marss „Pomp and Circumstance“ nr 1 andis meloodia laulule „Land of Hope and Glory“ ning seostus Ameerika Ühendriikides lõpuaktustega.

category_name_en: Classical music turned into public ritual
clue_en: Sibelius wrote which tone poem for Finnish press celebrations under Russian censorship, later adding a hymn-like section that became a national symbol?
clue_et: Millise sümfoonilise poeemi kirjutas Sibelius Soome ajakirjanduse pidustusteks Vene tsensuuri ajal ning mille hümnilaadsest osast sai hiljem rahvussümbol?
explanation_en: Sibelius composed “Finlandia” for Finnish press celebrations in 1899 amid Russian censorship; its hymn section gained separate patriotic importance.
explanation_et: Sibelius kirjutas „Finlandia“ 1899. aastal Soome ajakirjanduse pidustusteks Vene tsensuuri ajal ning selle hümniosast sai iseseisev isamaaline sümbol.

category_name_en: Classical music turned into public ritual
clue_en: Every British coronation since George II has included which Handel anthem, whose rising orchestral introduction also inspired UEFA Champions League music?
clue_et: Milline Händeli hümn on kõlanud igal Briti kroonimisel alates George II-st ning inspireeris oma tõusva orkestrisissejuhatusega ka UEFA Meistrite liiga muusikat?
explanation_en: Handel composed “Zadok the Priest” for George II’s 1727 coronation; it has been performed at every British coronation since.
explanation_et: Händel kirjutas „Preester Saadoki“ George II 1727. aasta kroonimiseks ning seda on esitatud igal järgneval Briti kroonimisel.

category_name_en: Classical music turned into public ritual
clue_en: Conductor Eugene Goossens asked American composers for wartime fanfares; Aaron Copland answered with which work named after a phrase by vice-president Henry Wallace?
clue_et: Dirigent Eugene Goossens tellis Ameerika heliloojatelt sõjaaegseid fanfaare. Millise asepresident Henry Wallace’i väljendist nime saanud teose kirjutas Aaron Copland?
explanation_en: Aaron Copland wrote “Fanfare for the Common Man” in 1942 for Eugene Goossens’s wartime fanfare project, taking its title from Henry Wallace’s “century of the common man” speech.
explanation_et: Aaron Copland kirjutas „Fanfaari tavalisele inimesele“ 1942. aastal Eugene Goossensi sõjaaegse fanfaariprojekti jaoks ning võttis pealkirja Henry Wallace’i kõnest „tavalise inimese sajandist“.
source_title: Fanfare for the Common Man — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Musicals adapted from an unexpected source
clue_en: T. S. Eliot’s verse about Jellicle felines supplied the characters and much of the lyrics for which Andrew Lloyd Webber musical?
clue_et: Millise Andrew Lloyd Webberi muusikali tegelased ja suur osa tekstist pärinevad T. S. Elioti luuletustest Jellicle’i kasside kohta?
explanation_en: Andrew Lloyd Webber based “Cats” on T. S. Eliot’s “Old Possum’s Book of Practical Cats”, setting much of the poetry to music.
explanation_et: Andrew Lloyd Webber lõi „Catsi“ T. S. Elioti kogumiku „Old Possum’s Book of Practical Cats“ põhjal, viisistades suure osa luuletustest.

category_name_en: Musicals adapted from an unexpected source
clue_en: Jean Valjean, Javert and the 1832 Paris uprising moved from a Victor Hugo novel into which stage musical?
clue_et: Millisesse lavamuusikali jõudsid Victor Hugo romaanist Jean Valjean, Javert ja 1832. aasta Pariisi ülestõus?
explanation_en: The musical “Les Misérables” adapts Victor Hugo’s 1862 novel about Jean Valjean and revolutionary Paris.
explanation_et: Muusikal „Hüljatud“ põhineb Victor Hugo 1862. aasta romaanil Jean Valjeanist ja revolutsioonilisest Pariisist.

category_name_en: Musicals adapted from an unexpected source
clue_en: Elton John composed the score when a film about a miner’s son who wants to dance became which stage show?
clue_et: Millisele lavastusele kirjutas Elton John muusika, kui filmist tantsida sooviva kaevuripoja kohta tehti muusikal?
explanation_en: “Billy Elliot the Musical”, with music by Elton John, is adapted from the 2000 film “Billy Elliot”.
explanation_et: Elton Johni muusikaga „Billy Ellioti“ muusikal põhineb 2000. aasta filmil „Billy Elliot“.

category_name_en: Musicals adapted from an unexpected source
clue_en: Five college students spend a weekend in an isolated cabin and accidentally unleash demonic terror. Which rock musical turns Sam Raimi’s horror-film franchise into a stage show?
clue_et: Viis tudengit veedavad nädalavahetuse kõrvalises metsamajas ja päästavad kogemata valla deemonliku õuduse. Milline rokkmuusikal toob Sam Raimi õudusfilmide sarja lavale?
accepted_variants_et: Evil Dead;Evil Dead musical;Evil Dead: The Musical
explanation_en: “Evil Dead: The Musical” is a rock musical based on Sam Raimi’s Evil Dead franchise; its first act adapts “The Evil Dead” and its second act “Evil Dead II”.
explanation_et: Rokkmuusikal „Evil Dead“ põhineb Sam Raimi „Evil Deadi“ filmisarjal: esimene vaatus mugandab filmi „The Evil Dead“ ja teine filmi „Evil Dead II“.

category_name_en: Musicals adapted from an unexpected source
clue_en: Glen Hansard and Markéta Irglová’s songs moved from a low-budget Irish film to which stage musical?
clue_et: Millisesse lavamuusikali jõudsid Glen Hansardi ja Markéta Irglová laulud väikese eelarvega Iiri filmist?
explanation_en: The stage musical “Once” adapts the 2007 Irish film and uses songs by Glen Hansard and Markéta Irglová.
explanation_et: Lavamuusikal „Once“ põhineb 2007. aasta Iiri filmil ning kasutab Glen Hansardi ja Markéta Irglová laule.

clue_en: George Gershwin wrote which lullaby for the opera “Porgy and Bess” before it became one of the most recorded jazz standards?
clue_et: Millise hällilaulu kirjutas George Gershwin ooperile „Porgy ja Bess“, enne kui sellest sai üks enim salvestatud džässistandardeid?
explanation_en: “Summertime” originated as an aria in Gershwin’s opera “Porgy and Bess” and was later recorded extensively by jazz musicians.
explanation_et: „Summertime“ sündis aariana Gershwini ooperis „Porgy ja Bess“ ning džässmuusikud salvestasid seda hiljem väga palju.

clue_en: John Coltrane transformed which Rodgers and Hammerstein song from “The Sound of Music” into a modal-jazz showcase?
clue_et: Millise Rodgersi ja Hammersteini laulu muusikalist „Helisev muusika“ muutis John Coltrane modaaldžässi näidislooks?
explanation_en: Rodgers and Hammerstein wrote “My Favorite Things” for “The Sound of Music”; John Coltrane’s extended jazz version became one of his signature recordings.
explanation_et: Rodgers ja Hammerstein kirjutasid „My Favorite Thingsi“ muusikalile „Helisev muusika“ ning John Coltrane’i pikk džässiversioon sai üheks tema tunnussalvestuseks.

clue_en: “Die Moritat von Mackie Messer” left Brecht and Weill’s “Threepenny Opera” to become which standard for Louis Armstrong and Bobby Darin?
clue_et: Milliseks Louis Armstrongi ja Bobby Darini standardiks kujunes Brechti ja Weilli „Kolmekrossiooperi“ laul „Die Moritat von Mackie Messer“?
explanation_en: “Mack the Knife” originated in Brecht and Weill’s “The Threepenny Opera” and later became a pop and jazz standard.
explanation_et: „Mack the Knife“ pärineb Brechti ja Weilli „Kolmekrossiooperist“ ning sai hiljem pop- ja džässistandardiks.

clue_en: Joseph Kosma’s French song “Les Feuilles mortes” gained English lyrics and became which jazz standard?
clue_et: Milliseks džässistandardiks kujunes Joseph Kosma prantsuse laul „Les Feuilles mortes“ pärast ingliskeelsete sõnade lisamist?
explanation_en: Joseph Kosma composed “Les Feuilles mortes”; Johnny Mercer later wrote the English lyrics for the standard known as “Autumn Leaves”.
explanation_et: Joseph Kosma kirjutas „Les Feuilles mortes’i“ ning Johnny Mercer lisas hiljem ingliskeelsed sõnad standardile „Autumn Leaves“.

clue_en: The nomadic songwriter eden ahbez handed Nat King Cole’s manager a manuscript that became which mysterious 1948 hit and later jazz standard?
clue_et: Millise salapärase 1948. aasta hiti ja hilisema džässistandardi käsikirja andis rändava eluviisiga autor eden ahbez Nat King Cole’i mänedžerile?
explanation_en: eden ahbez wrote “Nature Boy” and brought it to Nat King Cole’s attention; Cole’s 1948 recording became a hit and the song a standard.
explanation_et: eden ahbez kirjutas „Nature Boy“ ning juhtis sellele Nat King Cole’i tähelepanu; Cole’i 1948. aasta salvestusest sai hitt ja laulust standard.

clue_en: Prosper Mérimée’s novella about a soldier obsessed with a free-spirited woman became which Bizet opera?
clue_et: Millise Bizet’ ooperi aluseks sai Prosper Mérimée novell sõdurist, keda haarab kinnisidee vabameelse naise vastu?
explanation_en: Bizet’s opera “Carmen” is based on Prosper Mérimée’s novella of the same name.
explanation_et: Bizet’ ooper „Carmen“ põhineb Prosper Mérimée samanimelisel novellil.

clue_en: Verdi transformed Alexandre Dumas fils’s “The Lady of the Camellias” and its courtesan Marguerite into which opera about Violetta?
clue_et: Milliseks Violettast jutustavaks ooperiks muutis Verdi Alexandre Dumas noorema „Kameeliadaami“ ja selle kurtisaani Marguerite’i loo?
explanation_en: Verdi’s “La traviata” is based on Alexandre Dumas fils’s play adapted from his novel “The Lady of the Camellias”.
explanation_et: Verdi „La traviata“ põhineb Alexandre Dumas noorema näidendil, mis omakorda mugandas tema romaani „Kameeliadaam“.

clue_en: Arrigo Boito compressed Shakespeare while Verdi supplied the music for which opera about a jealous Moor and Desdemona?
clue_et: Millise armukadedast maurist ja Desdemonast jutustava ooperi lõid Verdi ja libretist Arrigo Boito Shakespeare’i näidendi põhjal?
explanation_en: Verdi’s “Otello”, with a libretto by Arrigo Boito, adapts Shakespeare’s tragedy “Othello”.
explanation_et: Verdi „Otello“, mille libreto kirjutas Arrigo Boito, mugandab Shakespeare’i tragöödiat „Othello“.

clue_en: Tchaikovsky called his work “lyrical scenes” when he adapted Tatiana’s letter and Lensky’s duel from which Pushkin verse novel?
clue_et: Millise Puškini värssromaani põhjal lõi Tšaikovski Tatjana kirja ja Lenski duelli sisaldava ooperi, mida ta nimetas „lüürilisteks stseenideks“?
explanation_en: Tchaikovsky’s opera “Eugene Onegin” is based on Alexander Pushkin’s verse novel and includes Tatiana’s letter scene and Lensky’s duel.
explanation_et: Tšaikovski ooper „Jevgeni Onegin“ põhineb Aleksandr Puškini värssromaanil ning sisaldab Tatjana kirjastseeni ja Lenski duelli.

clue_en: Alban Berg fashioned which expressionist opera from Georg Büchner’s unfinished play “Woyzeck”?
clue_et: Millise ekspressionistliku ooperi lõi Alban Berg Georg Büchneri lõpetamata näidendi „Woyzeck“ põhjal?
explanation_en: Alban Berg’s opera “Wozzeck” adapts Georg Büchner’s unfinished drama “Woyzeck”.
explanation_et: Alban Bergi ooper „Wozzeck“ põhineb Georg Büchneri lõpetamata draamal „Woyzeck“.

category_name_en: Ballets with a remarkable creation story
clue_en: Agnes de Mille choreographed a cowgirl’s story to Aaron Copland’s music for which 1942 Ballet Russe de Monte Carlo success?
clue_et: Millise Ballet Russe de Monte Carlo 1942. aasta menuteose jaoks lavastas Agnes de Mille kauboitüdruku loo Aaron Coplandi muusikale?
explanation_en: Agnes de Mille choreographed “Rodeo” to music by Aaron Copland for the Ballet Russe de Monte Carlo in 1942.
explanation_et: Agnes de Mille lõi 1942. aastal Ballet Russe de Monte Carlole Aaron Coplandi muusikaga balleti „Rodeo“.

category_name_en: Ballets with a remarkable creation story
clue_en: Aaron Copland composed this work for Martha Graham under the plain working title “Ballet for Martha”; Graham chose its final title later. Name it.
clue_et: Aaron Copland kirjutas selle teose Martha Grahamile tööpealkirjaga „Ballet for Martha“ ning Graham valis lõpliku nime hiljem. Mis ballett see on?
explanation_en: Copland composed “Appalachian Spring” for Martha Graham; the title, taken from a Hart Crane poem, was selected after the music was written.
explanation_et: Copland kirjutas „Appalachian Springi“ Martha Grahamile ning Hart Crane’i luuletusest võetud pealkiri valiti pärast muusika valmimist.

category_name_en: Ballets with a remarkable creation story
clue_en: Lincoln Kirstein commissioned Aaron Copland to turn cowboy tunes and an outlaw’s legend into which 1938 ballet?
clue_et: Millise 1938. aasta balleti tellis Lincoln Kirstein Aaron Coplandilt, paludes põimida kauboiviisid ja lindprii legendi?
explanation_en: Lincoln Kirstein commissioned Copland’s ballet “Billy the Kid”, which uses American cowboy songs in its score.
explanation_et: Lincoln Kirstein tellis Coplandilt balleti „Billy the Kid“, mille partituur kasutab Ameerika kauboilaule.

category_name_en: Ballets with a remarkable creation story
clue_en: Cocteau supplied the scenario, Satie the music and Picasso the sets and costumes for which 1917 Ballets Russes work?
clue_et: Millisele 1917. aasta Ballets Russes’i teosele kirjutas Cocteau stsenaariumi, Satie muusika ning Picasso kujundas dekoratsioonid ja kostüümid?
explanation_en: The 1917 ballet “Parade” brought together Jean Cocteau, Erik Satie and Pablo Picasso for the Ballets Russes.

clue_et: Millise Pink Floydi laulu ebatavalise seitsmelöögilise rütmi juhatab sisse kassaaparaatidest, müntidest ja rebitud paberist tehtud lindisilmus?

clue_en: A real office machine supplies the rhythmic clicks, carriage return and bell in which Leroy Anderson concert piece?
clue_et: Millises Leroy Andersoni kontsertpalas tekitab päris kontorimasin rütmilisi klõpse, reavahetuse heli ja kellahelina?

clue_et: Millise The Beatlesi eksperimentaalse kollaaži moodustavad korduv fraas „number nine“, lindisilmused, rahvahääl ja tagurpidi helid?

clue_en: Which keyboard instrument makes sound when felt-covered hammers strike strings?

explanation_en: Pressing a piano key sends a hammer toward a string and then lets it rebound.
explanation_et: Klaveriklahvi vajutamine suunab haamrikese keele vastu ning laseb sellel seejärel tagasi põrgata.

clue_en: Which electronic keyboard is worn on a strap and played like a guitar on stage?

explanation_en: A keytar combines a keyboard with a lightweight guitar-like body that lets the player move around.
explanation_et: Keytar ühendab klaviatuuri kerge kitarrilaadse korpusega, mis lubab mängijal liikuda.

clue_en: Which large keyboard instrument sends pressurised air through selected pipes?
clue_et: Milline suur klahvpill juhib suruõhku valitud viledesse?
explanation_en: An organist opens valves from the keyboards so wind can sound ranks of pipes.
explanation_et: Organist avab klaviatuurilt ventiilid, et õhk paneks vilerühmad helisema.

clue_en: Which keyboard-based instrument creates or shapes sound electronically?
clue_et: Milline sageli klaviatuuriga pill tekitab või kujundab heli elektrooniliselt?
explanation_en: A synthesizer generates audio signals and lets musicians control their timbre and pitch.
explanation_et: Süntesaator tekitab helisignaale ning võimaldab juhtida nende tämbrit ja helikõrgust.

clue_en: Which early keyboard instrument plucks its strings instead of striking them with hammers?
clue_et: Milline varasem klahvpill näpib keeli, selle asemel et neid haamrikestega lüüa?
explanation_en: A harpsichord key lifts a jack whose small plectrum plucks a string.
explanation_et: Klavessiini klahv tõstab mehhanismi, mille väike plektrum näpib keelt.

clue_en: Which kind of guitar uses a hollow wooden body to amplify its strings without electronics?
clue_et: Milline kitarr kasutab keelte heli võimendamiseks õõnsat puitkorpust ilma elektroonikata?
explanation_en: An acoustic guitar’s soundboard and hollow body project the strings’ vibrations.
explanation_et: Akustilise kitarri kõlalaud ja õõnes korpus kannavad keelte võnkumise valjemalt edasi.

clue_en: Which kind of guitar normally uses magnetic pickups and an amplifier?
clue_et: Milline kitarr kasutab tavaliselt magnethelipeasid ja võimendit?
explanation_en: Electric-guitar pickups convert string vibration into an electrical signal for amplification.
explanation_et: Elektrikitarri helipead muudavad keelte võnkumise elektrisignaaliks, mida saab võimendada.

clue_en: Which low-pitched member of the family usually has four strings and supports a band’s rhythm section?
clue_et: Millisel madala kõlaga pillil on tavaliselt neli keelt ning see toetab ansambli rütmirühma?
explanation_en: The standard electric bass commonly has four strings tuned an octave below the lowest four guitar strings.
explanation_et: Tavalisel elektribassil on neli keelt, mis on häälestatud oktaavi võrra madalamale kitarri neljast alumisest keelest.

clue_en: Which kind of guitar traditionally uses nylon strings and is played with the fingers?
clue_et: Milline kitarr kasutab traditsiooniliselt nailonkeeli ja mida mängitakse sõrmedega?
explanation_en: Modern classical guitars use nylon rather than steel strings and have a broad neck.
explanation_et: Nüüdisaegsel klassikalisel kitarril on teraskeelte asemel nailonkeeled ja lai kael.

clue_en: Which small four-string instrument, strongly associated with Hawaii, is played by strumming or plucking?
clue_et: Millist väikest neljakeelset pilli, mida seostatakse eriti Hawaiiga, mängitakse sõrmitsedes või näppides?
explanation_en: The ukulele is a small plucked string instrument that developed in Hawaii.
explanation_et: Ukulele on Hawaiil arenenud väike näpitav keelpill.

clue_en: Which wind instrument consists of a row of pipes of different lengths played by blowing across their tops?
clue_et: Milline puhkpill koosneb eri pikkusega torude reast, mille ülaärte kohale puhutakse?
explanation_en: Shorter pipes produce higher notes, while longer pipes produce lower notes.

clue_en: Which plucked zither is a traditional national instrument of Estonia?
clue_et: Milline näpitav tsitter on Eesti traditsiooniline rahvapill?
explanation_en: The kannel belongs to the Baltic psaltery family and has long been played in Estonia.
explanation_et: Kannel kuulub balti psalteeriumide perekonda ning seda on Eestis ammu mängitud.

clue_en: Which Russian folk instrument has a triangular body and usually three strings?
clue_et: Millisel Vene rahvapillil on kolmnurkne korpus ja tavaliselt kolm keelt?
explanation_en: The balalaika is a Russian long-necked lute recognised by its triangular body.
explanation_et: Balalaika on Vene pika kaelaga lautopill, mille tunneb ära kolmnurkse korpuse järgi.

clue_en: Which long-necked Indian instrument is known for sympathetic strings and a resonant buzzing tone?
clue_et: Milline pika kaelaga India pill on tuntud kaasahelisevate keelte ja kumiseva kõla poolest?
explanation_en: The sitar combines played strings with sympathetic strings that resonate beneath them.
explanation_et: Sitar ühendab mängukeeled nende all kaasa helisevate resonantskeeltega.

clue_en: Which long wind instrument developed among Aboriginal peoples of northern Australia?

explanation_en: The didgeridoo is a drone instrument associated especially with Aboriginal cultures of northern Australia.
explanation_et: Didžeriduu on burdoonpill, mida seostatakse eriti Põhja-Austraalia põlisrahvaste kultuuridega.

clue_en: Which ornate era associated with Bach and Handel came before the Classical period?

explanation_en: The Baroque era broadly spans the period from about 1600 to 1750, before musical Classicism.
explanation_et: Barokiaeg hõlmab üldjoontes ajavahemikku umbes 1600–1750 ning eelneb muusikaklassitsismile.

clue_en: Which era of balanced forms is especially associated with Haydn and Mozart?
clue_et: Millist tasakaalustatud vormidega ajastut seostatakse eriti Haydni ja Mozartiga?
explanation_en: Haydn and Mozart are central composers of the late eighteenth-century Classical style.
explanation_et: Haydn ja Mozart on kaheksateistkümnenda sajandi lõpu klassitsistliku stiili keskseid heliloojaid.

clue_en: Which nineteenth-century era expanded orchestras and emphasised individual expression?

explanation_en: Romantic composers enlarged musical forms and orchestral colour to pursue expressive aims.
explanation_et: Romantikud avardasid muusikavorme ja orkestrivärve, et saavutada tugevamat väljendusjõudu.

clue_en: Which era before the Baroque is noted for composers such as Palestrina and rich vocal polyphony?
clue_et: Milline barokile eelnenud ajastu on tuntud Palestrina ja rikkaliku vokaalpolüfoonia poolest?
explanation_en: Renaissance sacred and secular music developed elaborate interweaving vocal lines.
explanation_et: Renessansi vaimulik ja ilmalik muusika arendas keerukaid põimuvaid vokaalliine.

clue_en: Which broad twentieth-century movement experimented beyond many inherited tonal traditions?
clue_et: Milline lai kahekümnenda sajandi suund katsetas paljude pärandatud tonaalsete tavade piiridest väljaspool?

explanation_et: Muusikaline modernism hõlmas mitmesuguseid katseid harmoonia, rütmi, vormi ja kõlaga.

clue_en: What is an extended solo song within an opera called?

explanation_et: Aaria annab ühele lauljale ooperis iseseisva meloodilise lõigu.

clue_en: What is the written text of an opera called?

clue_en: Who composed the famous twentieth-century ballet score for Romeo and Juliet?

explanation_en: Prokofiev completed his score for the ballet Romeo and Juliet in the nineteen-thirties.

clue_en: Which American city is widely recognised as the birthplace of this improvisational genre?

clue_en: What is the practice of creating musical lines during a performance rather than playing every note as written?

clue_en: Which guitarist and singer gave his guitars the name Lucille?

clue_en: Which Mississippi-born musician became a leading figure of the amplified Chicago style?

clue_en: Which British-American band released the album Rumours?

explanation_et: Marimbal on puust plaadid ja resonaatortorud ning selle ulatus läheb ksülofoni omast madalamale.

category_name_en: Instruments identified by sound and shape
clue_en: Which button-and-bellows free-reed instrument supplies the plaintive voice of tango in Argentina and Uruguay?
clue_et: Milline nuppude ja lõõtsaga vabakeelpill annab Argentina ja Uruguay tangole kaebliku kõla?
explanation_en: The bandoneon is a button-operated free-reed instrument that became essential to tango in Argentina and Uruguay.
explanation_et: Bandoneon on nuppudega vabakeelpill, millest sai Argentina ja Uruguay tango oluline osa.

category_name_en: Instruments identified by sound and shape
clue_en: Which Swedish bowed instrument uses a row of wooden keys whose tangents stop the strings?
clue_et: Millise Rootsi poogenpilli keeli lühendavad puidust klahvide küljes olevad puutepulgad?
explanation_en: The Swedish nyckelharpa is bowed while wooden keys move tangents against its strings to select pitches.
explanation_et: Rootsi nyckelharpat mängitakse poognaga ning helikõrguse valivad klahvidega liigutatavad puutepulgad vastu keeli.

category_name_en: Instruments known by a sound or story
category_name_et: Kõla või loo järgi tuntud pillid
clue_en: Tchaikovsky gave the Sugar Plum Fairy her magical, bell-like voice with a keyboard whose hammers strike metal plates. What is it?
clue_et: Tšaikovski andis Suhkruploomihaldjale maagilise kellukesehääle klahvpilliga, mille haamrikesed löövad metallplaate. Mis pill see on?
explanation_en: A celesta looks like a small upright piano, but its keys operate hammers that strike metal plates; Tchaikovsky featured it in “Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy”.
explanation_et: Tšelesta meenutab väikest püstklaverit, kuid selle klahvid panevad haamrikesed lööma metallplaate; Tšaikovski kasutas pilli „Suhkruploomihaldja tantsus“.

category_name_en: Instruments known by a sound or story
category_name_et: Kõla või loo järgi tuntud pillid
clue_en: Which small vessel flute gained popularity and sales after featuring prominently in a hit 1998 Legend of Zelda game?
clue_et: Millise väikese anumflöödi populaarsus ja müük kasvasid tänu tähtsale rollile 1998. aasta menukas „Legend of Zelda“ mängus?
explanation_en: The ocarina is a vessel flute with an enclosed body and finger holes; The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time increased the instrument’s popularity and sales.
explanation_et: Okariin on suletud korpuse ja sõrmeavadega anumflööt; mäng „The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time“ kasvatas pilli populaarsust ja müüki.

category_name_en: Instruments known by a sound or story
category_name_et: Kõla või loo järgi tuntud pillid
clue_en: Augustus Pablo made which breath-powered little keyboard a distinctive voice of 1970s Jamaican reggae and dub?
clue_et: Millise hingeõhuga mängitava väikese klahvpilli muutis Augustus Pablo 1970. aastate Jamaica reggae ja dub’i äratuntavaks hääleks?
explanation_en: A melodica sends blown air across free reeds while its piano-style keys select the notes; Augustus Pablo popularised its use in reggae and dub.
explanation_et: Meloodikas suunab mängija puhutud õhu vabadele keeltele ning valib noodid klaverilaadsete klahvidega; Augustus Pablo tegi pilli reggae’s ja dub’is populaarseks.

category_name_en: Instruments known by a sound or story
category_name_et: Kõla või loo järgi tuntud pillid
clue_en: Bend a flexible hand saw into a curve and draw a bow across its smooth edge: what eerie, gliding instrument have you made?
clue_et: Painuta painduv käsisaag kaardu ja tõmba poognaga üle selle sileda serva: millise kõheda, liugleva kõlaga pilli oled loonud?
explanation_en: A musical saw is a flexible hand saw played with a bow; changing its curve alters the pitch and enables the continuous glissando often compared with a theremin.
explanation_et: Muusikasaag on painduv käsisaag, mida mängitakse poognaga; saetera kõveruse muutmine muudab helikõrgust ja võimaldab theremin’i meenutavat pidevat glissando’t.

category_name_en: Instruments known by a sound or story
category_name_et: Kõla või loo järgi tuntud pillid
clue_en: Benjamin Franklin’s 1761 invention let a player touch the wet rims of nested, spinning glass bowls. What instrument resulted?
clue_et: Benjamin Franklini 1761. aasta leiutis lubas mängijal puudutada üksteise sisse asetatud pöörlevate klaaskausside niiskeid servi. Mis pill nii sündis?
explanation_en: Franklin mechanised the sound of musical glasses by mounting graduated glass bowls on a rotating spindle, creating the glass harmonica or armonica.
explanation_et: Franklin muutis muusikaklaaside mängimise mehaaniliseks, kinnitades eri suurusega klaaskausid pöörlevale võllile; nii sündis klaasharmoonika ehk armonica.

category_name_en: Genres and the places that raised them
clue_en: Which Andalusian art form joins cante singing, toque guitar and expressive dance?
clue_et: Milline Andaluusia kunstivorm ühendab cante-laulu, toque-kitarrimängu ja väljendusrikka tantsu?
explanation_en: Flamenco developed in Andalusia and combines song, guitar playing and dance.
explanation_et: Flamenko arenes Andaluusias ning ühendab laulu, kitarrimängu ja tantsu.

category_name_en: Genres and the places that raised them
clue_en: Which “Seattle sound” fused punk energy, heavy-metal weight and heavily distorted guitars during the 1980s?
clue_et: Milline „Seattle’i kõla“ ühendas 1980. aastatel pungienergia, heavy metal’i raskuse ja tugevalt moonutatud kitarrid?
explanation_en: Grunge emerged around Seattle by combining punk and heavy-metal influences with a distorted guitar sound.
explanation_et: Grunge kujunes Seattle’i ümbruses, ühendades pungi ja heavy metal’i mõjutused moonutatud kitarrikõlaga.

category_name_en: Genres and the places that raised them
clue_en: Name the futuristic electronic genre shaped in Detroit by Juan Atkins, Derrick May and Kevin Saunderson, the Belleville Three.
clue_et: Nimeta futuristlik elektroonilise muusika žanr, mida kujundasid Detroitis Belleville Three liikmed Juan Atkins, Derrick May ja Kevin Saunderson.
explanation_en: Techno took shape in Detroit through producers including the Belleville Three, drawing on electronic music and house.
explanation_et: Techno kujunes Detroitis muu hulgas Belleville Three’i produtsentide käe all, ammutades elektroonilisest muusikast ja house’ist.

category_name_en: Genres and the places that raised them
clue_en: Name the Portuguese song tradition whose Lisbon sound joins Portuguese guitar with lyrics steeped in saudade.
clue_et: Nimeta Portugali laulutraditsioon, mille Lissaboni kõlas kohtuvad Portugali kitarr ja saudade-tundest kantud laulud.
explanation_en: Fado is a Portuguese song tradition strongly associated with Lisbon, Portuguese guitar and the feeling of saudade.
explanation_et: Fado on Lissaboniga tugevalt seotud Portugali laulutraditsioon, mille kõla kujundavad Portugali kitarr ja saudade-tunne.

category_name_en: Genres and the places that raised them
clue_en: Which West African genre grew in Ghana by blending local dance music with brass-band and jazz influences?
clue_et: Milline Lääne-Aafrika žanr arenes Ghanas, põimides kohaliku tantsumuusika puhkpilliorkestri ja džässi mõjutustega?
explanation_en: Highlife developed in Ghana from local musical traditions combined with brass-band, guitar and jazz influences.
explanation_et: Highlife arenes Ghanas, ühendades kohalikud muusikatraditsioonid puhkpilliorkestri, kitarri ja džässi mõjutustega.

clue_en: Which partner dance turns couples around the floor in a flowing triple metre?
clue_et: Milline paaristants paneb paarid mööda põrandat sujuvas kolmeosalises taktimõõdus keerlema?
explanation_en: The waltz is a rotating partner dance in triple metre that spread from German-speaking Europe.
explanation_et: Valss on kolmeosalises taktimõõdus pöörlev paaristants, mis levis saksakeelsest Euroopast.

clue_en: Which lively dance in 2/4 time began in nineteenth-century Bohemia?
clue_et: Milline elav 2/4-taktis tants sai 19. sajandil alguse Böömimaal?
explanation_en: The polka originated in nineteenth-century Bohemia and is danced in a lively 2/4 metre.
explanation_et: Polka sai alguse 19. sajandi Böömimaal ning seda tantsitakse elavas 2/4-taktis.

clue_en: Which Afro-Brazilian dance and rhythm became a defining sound of Carnival in Rio de Janeiro?
clue_et: Millisest afrobrasiilia tantsust ja rütmist sai Rio de Janeiro karnevali tunnus?
explanation_en: Samba grew from Afro-Brazilian traditions and became central to Carnival culture in Rio de Janeiro.
explanation_et: Samba kasvas afrobrasiilia traditsioonidest ning sai Rio de Janeiro karnevalikultuuri keskseks osaks.

clue_en: Name the Cuban dance created to Enrique Jorrín’s music, its name echoing the dancers’ shuffling quick steps.
clue_et: Nimeta Kuuba tants, mis loodi Enrique Jorríni muusika järgi ja mille nimi matkib tantsijate sahisevaid kiireid samme.
explanation_en: The cha-cha-cha originated in Cuba, and its name imitates the sound of the dancers’ quick shuffling steps.
explanation_et: Tšatša pärineb Kuubalt ning selle nimi matkib tantsijate kiirete sahisevate sammude heli.

clue_en: Which Levantine folk dance links people in a line or circle for rhythmic stamping at weddings and celebrations?
clue_et: Millises Levandi rahvatantsus moodustavad tantsijad pulmades ja pidudel rea või ringi ning trambivad rütmiliselt jalgu?
explanation_en: Dabke is a Levantine line or circle dance marked by rhythmic stamping and performed at celebrations.
explanation_et: Dabke on Levandi rea- või ringtants, mida iseloomustab rütmiline jalgade trampimine ja mida tantsitakse pidustustel.

clue_en: Which Aerosmith song gained a landmark rap-rock remake when Run-DMC recorded it with Steven Tyler and Joe Perry?
clue_et: Milline Aerosmithi laul sai murrangulise räpproki uusversiooni, kui Run-DMC salvestas selle koos Steven Tyleri ja Joe Perryga?
explanation_en: Run-DMC’s 1986 version brought Aerosmith into the recording and helped rap reach a wider rock audience.
explanation_et: Run-DMC 1986. aasta versioon kaasas salvestusse Aerosmithi ning aitas räpil jõuda laiema rokipublikuni.

clue_en: Which Eminem song builds an obsessed fan’s letters around a sampled refrain from Dido’s “Thank You”?
clue_et: Milline Eminemi laul jutustab kinnisideelise fänni kirjade kaudu ning kasutab refräänis sämplit Dido loost „Thank You“?
explanation_en: Eminem’s narrative track samples Dido’s opening vocal and turns the fan’s name into the song’s central character.
explanation_et: Eminemi jutustav lugu sämplib Dido avavokaali ning teeb fänni nimest laulu keskse tegelase.

clue_en: Lil Nas X added country singer Billy Ray Cyrus to the hit remix of which record-breaking country-rap song?

explanation_en: The Billy Ray Cyrus remix helped the country-rap track become a major crossover hit.
explanation_et: Billy Ray Cyruse osalusega remiks aitas kantriräpiloost kujundada suure žanripiire ületava hiti.

clue_en: Which duet paired Queen singer Freddie Mercury with opera soprano Montserrat Caballé and became linked to the 1992 Olympics?

explanation_et: Mercury ja Caballé salvestasid loo oma ühisalbumi nimilauluna ning sellest sai Barcelona olümpiamängude hümn.

clue_en: Which song from U2’s Passengers project joined Bono with Luciano Pavarotti and recalled a beauty pageant held during a siege?

explanation_en: The collaboration grew from Bill Carter’s documentary about a beauty pageant staged in besieged Sarajevo, with Pavarotti singing the operatic passage.
explanation_et: Koostöö kasvas välja Bill Carteri dokumentaalfilmist, mis käsitles ümberpiiratud Sarajevos peetud iludusvõistlust; ooperliku osa laulis Pavarotti.

category_name_en: Cover versions that found a new life
clue_en: Cyndi Lauper changed the viewpoint and turned a little-known Robert Hazard song into which exuberant pop anthem?

response_et: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
explanation_en: Hazard wrote and first recorded the song, while Lauper’s altered 1983 version became her breakthrough hit.
explanation_et: Hazard kirjutas ja salvestas loo esimesena, kuid Lauperi muudetud 1983. aasta versioonist sai tema läbimurdehitt.

category_name_en: Cover versions that found a new life
clue_en: Mark Ronson and Amy Winehouse turned which Zutons song into a brisk soul-styled hit?

explanation_en: The Zutons released the original in 2006; Ronson’s 2007 cover featured Winehouse on vocals and reached number two in Britain.
explanation_et: The Zutons avaldas originaali 2006. aastal; Ronsoni 2007. aasta kaveris laulis Winehouse ning see jõudis Suurbritannias teisele kohale.

category_name_en: Cover versions that found a new life
clue_en: Pet Shop Boys turned which country ballad, previously famous through Elvis Presley and Willie Nelson, into an upbeat synth-pop hit?
clue_et: Millise kantriballaadi, mille olid kuulsaks laulnud Elvis Presley ja Willie Nelson, muutis Pet Shop Boys hoogsaks süntpopihitiks?
explanation_en: The song had already produced major country and pop versions before Pet Shop Boys released their electronic remake in 1987.
explanation_et: Laulust oli juba tehtud menukaid kantri- ja popversioone, enne kui Pet Shop Boys avaldas 1987. aastal oma elektroonilise uusversiooni.

category_name_en: Cover versions that found a new life
clue_en: Nirvana introduced a new generation to which David Bowie song during MTV Unplugged in New York?
clue_et: Millise David Bowie laulu tutvustas Nirvana uuele põlvkonnale kontserdil „MTV Unplugged in New York“?

explanation_et: Bowie kirjutas ja salvestas loo 1970. aastal; Nirvana 1993. aasta akustilisest esitusest sai teine laialt tuntud versioon.

category_name_en: Cover versions that found a new life
clue_en: The Clash gave a punk charge to which Sonny Curtis song previously made famous by the Bobby Fuller Four?

explanation_en: Curtis wrote the song for the Crickets; the Bobby Fuller Four and later the Clash made prominent cover versions.
explanation_et: Curtis kirjutas loo The Cricketsile; tuntud uusversioonid tegid hiljem Bobby Fuller Four ja The Clash.

clue_en: Blur’s explosive “woo-hoo” chorus made which two-minute track a fixture in sports arenas?

explanation_et: Bluri lühikest ja valju singlit hakati laialt kasutama spordivõistlustel ning spordimeedias.

clue_en: At the break between the third and fourth quarters, Michigan football fans turn which Killers hit into a mass singalong?

explanation_et: Fenway Parkil mängitakse seda laulu tavaliselt kaheksanda inningu keskel ning selle refräänist on saanud publiku rituaal.

clue_en: Seattle Mariners fans chant the wordless hook of which Zombie Nation track during rallies?
clue_et: Millise Zombie Nationi pala sõnadeta meloodiat skandeerivad Seattle Marinersi fännid siis, kui meeskond kogub hoogu?
explanation_en: The Mariners began playing it during rallies in 2000, and fans chant along to its hook.
explanation_et: Mariners hakkas seda 2000. aastal mängu pöördehetkedel mängima ning fännid skandeerivad meloodiale kaasa.

clue_en: Which 1996 England football song by Baddiel, Skinner and the Lightning Seeds introduced the refrain “football’s coming home”?
clue_et: Milline Baddieli, Skinneri ja Lightning Seedsi 1996. aasta Inglismaa jalgpallilaul tõi käibele refrääni „football’s coming home“?
explanation_en: The song was recorded for UEFA Euro 1996 and became a recurring England-supporter anthem.
explanation_et: Laul salvestati 1996. aasta Euroopa meistrivõistlusteks ning sellest sai Inglismaa toetajate korduv hümn.

clue_et: Milline David Bowie laul saadab major Tomi orbiidile ning ilmus Apollo 11 missiooni ajal?
explanation_en: Bowie’s story of the fictional astronaut Major Tom was released in July 1969, days before the Moon landing.
explanation_et: Bowie väljamõeldud astronaudist major Tomist jutustav laul ilmus 1969. aasta juulis, mõni päev enne Kuu maandumist.

category_name_en: Pop songs that looked toward space
clue_en: Which Elton John hit treats space travel as an astronaut’s lonely everyday job?
clue_et: Milline Elton Johni hitt kujutab kosmoselendu astronaudi üksildase igapäevatööna?
explanation_en: Bernie Taupin’s lyrics describe an astronaut separated from his family, while Elton John wrote the music.
explanation_et: Bernie Taupini sõnad kirjeldavad perest eemal viibivat astronauti ning Elton John kirjutas muusika.

category_name_en: Pop songs that looked toward space
clue_en: Which Europe hit pairs Joey Tempest’s famous synthesizer riff with lyrics inspired by David Bowie’s “Space Oddity”?
clue_et: Milline ansambli Europe hitt ühendab Joey Tempesti kuulsa süntesaatoririfi David Bowie loost „Space Oddity“ inspireeritud sõnadega?
explanation_en: Tempest wrote the keyboard riff and cited Bowie’s “Space Oddity” as an influence on the lyrics.

category_name_en: Pop songs that looked toward space

explanation_en: Sting’s lyrics use lunar gravity as a metaphor for love, while the band gives the song a sparse reggae-influenced arrangement.

clue_et: Millises saksa- ja ingliskeelsena ilmunud süntpopihitis pöördus Peter Schilling tagasi Bowie eksinud astronaudi juurde?
explanation_en: Schilling’s song continues the Major Tom idea and became an international hit in its English version.
explanation_et: Schillingu laul jätkab major Tomi motiivi ning selle ingliskeelsest versioonist sai rahvusvaheline hitt.

clue_en: Which whistled Scorpions ballad became an unofficial soundtrack to the end of the Cold War?
clue_et: Millisest vilistava avaga Scorpionsi ballaadist sai külma sõja lõpu mitteametlik tunnuslaul?
explanation_en: Klaus Meine wrote the song after the band’s experiences in the Soviet Union as political change swept Europe.

clue_et: Pärast printsess Diana surma kirjutas Bernie Taupin ümber varasema Marilyn Monroe mälestuslaulu ning Elton John esitas uue versiooni Diana matustel. Milline 1997. aasta singel see oli?
accepted_variants_en: Candle in the Wind;Candle in the Wind ’97;Goodbye England’s Rose

clue_en: Which Midnight Oil hit demands that land be returned to its Indigenous Australian owners?
clue_et: Milline Midnight Oili hitt nõuab maa tagastamist Austraalia põlisrahvastest omanikele?
explanation_en: The song criticises the removal of Aboriginal communities from their lands and repeats the demand to give the land back.
explanation_et: Laul kritiseerib aborigeenikogukondade eemaldamist nende maadelt ning kordab nõudmist maa tagasi anda.

clue_en: Neil Young wrote which Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young song after National Guard troops killed four students at Kent State?
clue_et: Millise Crosby, Stills, Nash & Youngi laulu kirjutas Neil Young pärast seda, kui rahvuskaart tappis Kent State’i ülikoolis neli tudengit?
explanation_en: Young wrote the song in immediate response to the May 1970 Kent State shootings.

clue_et: Millises Gerry Rafferty hitis mängis Raphael Ravenscroft kõrgele tõusva saksofonirefrääni?
