category_name_en: Instrumental hooks that identify the song
clue_en: Dave Greenfield’s harpsichord figure slips between waltz-like and four-beat bars in which Stranglers hit?
clue_et: Millises The Stranglersi hitis liigub Dave Greenfieldi klavessiinikäik valsilaadsete ja neljaosaliste taktide vahel?
explanation_en: The song is built around Greenfield’s harpsichord-led figure and an unusual pattern of three- and four-beat bars.
explanation_et: Laul põhineb Greenfieldi klavessiinikäigul ning ebatavalisel kolme- ja neljaosaliste taktide vaheldumisel.

category_name_en: Jazz tunes that reached a wider audience
clue_en: Which Louis Armstrong recording returned to the charts after appearing in Good Morning, Vietnam?
clue_et: Milline Louis Armstrongi salvestis jõudis pärast filmis „Good Morning, Vietnam“ kõlamist taas edetabelitesse?
explanation_en: The 1967 recording found a new audience when the 1987 film used it on its soundtrack.
explanation_et: 1967. aasta salvestis leidis uue publiku, kui 1987. aasta film kasutas seda oma heliribal.

category_name_en: Jazz tunes that reached a wider audience
clue_en: Nina Simone’s dramatic 1965 recording made which song from The Roar of the Greasepaint a modern standard?
clue_et: Millise muusikali „The Roar of the Greasepaint“ laulu muutis Nina Simone’i dramaatiline 1965. aasta salvestis nüüdisaegseks standardiks?
explanation_en: Anthony Newley and Leslie Bricusse wrote the song for the stage musical; Simone’s version became one of its best-known recordings.
explanation_et: Anthony Newley ja Leslie Bricusse kirjutasid laulu lavamuusikalile ning Simone’i versioonist sai selle üks tuntumaid salvestisi.

category_name_en: Jazz tunes that reached a wider audience
clue_en: Billy Strayhorn turned subway directions to Duke Ellington’s home into which swing-era signature tune?
clue_et: Millise svingiajastu tunnusloo lõi Billy Strayhorn metroojuhistest Duke Ellingtoni koju?
explanation_en: Strayhorn composed the tune from directions that began with taking New York’s A train, and it became Ellington’s orchestra theme.
explanation_et: Strayhorn lõi pala juhiste põhjal, mis algasid New Yorgi A-rongiga sõitmisest, ning sellest sai Ellingtoni orkestri tunnuslugu.

category_name_en: Jazz tunes that reached a wider audience
clue_en: Which early Nina Simone recording became a European hit decades later after a Chanel No. 5 commercial?
clue_et: Milline Nina Simone’i varane salvestis sai aastakümneid hiljem tänu Chanel No. 5 reklaamile Euroopa hitiks?
response_en: My Baby Just Cares for Me
response_et: My Baby Just Cares for Me
explanation_en: Simone recorded the standard in 1958; its use in a 1980s perfume advertisement brought the recording renewed chart success.
explanation_et: Simone salvestas standardi 1958. aastal; kasutamine 1980. aastate parfüümireklaamis tõi salvestisele uue edetabeliedu.
source_title: My Baby Just Cares for Me — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Jazz tunes that reached a wider audience
clue_en: Joe Zawinul named which Weather Report composition after a New York jazz club that itself honoured Charlie Parker?
clue_et: Millise Weather Reporti pala nimetas Joe Zawinul New Yorgi džässiklubi järgi, mis omakorda kandis austusavaldusena Charlie Parkeri hüüdnime?
explanation_en: Zawinul wrote the jazz-fusion standard for Weather Report and linked its title to the club named for Parker, known as “Bird”.
explanation_et: Zawinul kirjutas džässifusiooni standardi Weather Reportile ning sidus pealkirja Charlie „Bird“ Parkeri järgi nimetatud klubiga.

category_name_en: Classical themes beyond the concert hall
clue_en: Which Tchaikovsky concert work celebrates Russia’s defence against Napoleon with cannon fire and ringing bells?
clue_et: Milline Tšaikovski kontsertteos tähistab Venemaa kaitsmist Napoleoni eest kahuripaukude ja helisevate kelladega?
explanation_en: Tchaikovsky’s 1812 Overture depicts the defeat of Napoleon’s invasion and famously calls for cannon fire and bells.
explanation_et: Tšaikovski „1812. aasta avamäng“ kujutab Napoleoni sissetungi nurjumist ning selle partituur näeb ette kahuripaugud ja kellad.

category_name_en: Classical themes beyond the concert hall
clue_en: Name the enduring Johann Strauss II waltz premiered at a Viennese men’s choral association concert in 1867.
clue_et: Nimeta Johann Strauss II püsivalt populaarne valss, mis esietendus 1867. aastal Viini meestelauluühingu kontserdil.
accepted_variants_et: Sinine Doonau;An der schönen blauen Donau
explanation_en: Johann Strauss II composed The Blue Danube, which premiered in Vienna in 1867 and became a classical favourite.
explanation_et: Johann Strauss II komponeeris valsi „Ilusal sinisel Doonaul“, mis esietendus 1867. aastal Viinis ja sai klassikarepertuaari lemmikuks.

category_name_en: Classical themes beyond the concert hall
clue_en: Which Puccini aria became a football anthem after the BBC used Luciano Pavarotti’s recording for the 1990 World Cup?
clue_et: Millisest Puccini aariast sai jalgpallihümn, kui BBC kasutas Luciano Pavarotti salvestist 1990. aasta MM-il?
explanation_en: The BBC used Luciano Pavarotti’s recording of “Nessun dorma” as its theme for the 1990 FIFA World Cup.
explanation_et: BBC kasutas Luciano Pavarotti „Nessun dorma“ salvestist 1990. aasta jalgpalli MM-i tunnusmuusikana.

category_name_en: Classical themes beyond the concert hall
clue_en: Which Wagner prelude accompanies attacking helicopters blasting music over the beach in Francis Ford Coppola’s Vietnam War film?
clue_et: Milline Wagneri prelüüd saadab Francis Ford Coppola Vietnami sõja filmis ründekoptereid, mis lasevad ranna kohal valjult muusikat?
explanation_en: Apocalypse Now uses Wagner’s “Ride of the Valkyries” during its helicopter assault sequence.
explanation_et: „Apocalypse Now“ kasutab kopterirünnaku stseenis Wagneri „Valküüride lendu“.

category_name_en: Classical themes beyond the concert hall
clue_en: Which Carl Orff chorus from Carmina Burana starts with pounding drums, drops to a whisper and builds to a dramatic climax?
clue_et: Milline Carl Orffi kooriosa kantaadist „Carmina Burana“ algab trummilöökidega, vaibub sosinaks ja kasvab dramaatilise haripunktini?
explanation_en: Carl Orff set the medieval Latin poem “O Fortuna” as the opening and closing movement of Carmina Burana.
explanation_et: Carl Orff seadis keskaegse ladinakeelse luuletuse „O Fortuna“ „Carmina Burana“ ava- ja lõpuosaks.

category_name_en: Opera plots in one dramatic turn
clue_en: Which Verdi opera makes an enslaved Ethiopian princess choose between love for the Egyptian commander Radamès and loyalty to her homeland?
clue_et: Millises Verdi ooperis peab vangistatud Etioopia printsess valima Egiptuse väejuhi Radamèsi vastu tuntava armastuse ja kodumaale truuks jäämise vahel?
explanation_en: Verdi’s Aida centres on an Ethiopian princess enslaved in Egypt and her forbidden love for Radamès.
explanation_et: Verdi „Aida“ keskmes on Egiptusesse orjastatud Etioopia printsess ja tema keelatud armastus Radamèsi vastu.

category_name_en: Opera plots in one dramatic turn
clue_en: Name the Rossini comedy in which Figaro helps Count Almaviva outwit Doctor Bartolo and marry Rosina.
clue_et: Nimeta Rossini koomiline ooper, milles Figaro aitab krahv Almavival doktor Bartolo üle kavaldada ja Rosinaga abielluda.
explanation_en: In Rossini’s The Barber of Seville, Figaro schemes to unite Count Almaviva with Rosina despite Bartolo’s plans.
explanation_et: Rossini „Sevilla habemeajajas“ sepistab Figaro plaani, et krahv Almaviva ja Rosina saaksid Bartolo kavatsustest hoolimata kokku.

category_name_en: Opera plots in one dramatic turn
clue_en: Which Puccini opera follows Cio-Cio-San as she waits in Nagasaki for the American officer Pinkerton to return?
clue_et: Milline Puccini ooper jälgib Nagasakis Cio-Cio-Sani, kes ootab Ameerika ohvitseri Pinkertoni tagasitulekut?
explanation_en: Puccini’s Madama Butterfly tells how Cio-Cio-San waits for Pinkerton, learns that he has returned with an American wife, and takes her own life.
explanation_et: Puccini „Madama Butterfly“ jutustab Cio-Cio-Sanist, kes ootab Pinkertoni, saab teada tema Ameerika naisest ja võtab endalt elu.

category_name_en: Opera plots in one dramatic turn
clue_en: Which Verdi opera turns a court jester’s plan against him when the assassin’s sack contains his daughter Gilda?
clue_et: Millises Verdi ooperis pöördub õuenarri kättemaksuplaan tema enda vastu, kui palgamõrvari kotis on tütar Gilda?
explanation_en: In Verdi’s Rigoletto, the jester discovers that the victim delivered in a sack is his daughter Gilda rather than the Duke.
explanation_et: Verdi „Rigolettos“ avastab õuenarr, et kotis toodud ohver on hertsogi asemel tema tütar Gilda.

category_name_en: Opera plots in one dramatic turn
clue_en: Which Offenbach opera has its poet hero recall three doomed loves: the doll Olympia, the singer Antonia and the courtesan Giulietta?
clue_et: Millises Offenbachi ooperis meenutab luuletajast peategelane kolme hukule määratud armastust: nukk Olympiat, laulja Antoniat ja kurtisaan Giuliettat?
explanation_en: Offenbach’s The Tales of Hoffmann builds its central acts around Hoffmann’s failed loves Olympia, Antonia and Giulietta.
explanation_et: Offenbachi „Hoffmanni lugude“ kesksetes vaatustes jutustatakse Hoffmanni nurjunud armastustest Olympia, Antonia ja Giulietta vastu.

clue_en: Which Rodgers and Hammerstein musical sends Maria to work as governess to Captain von Trapp’s seven children?
clue_et: Millises Rodgersi ja Hammersteini muusikalis läheb Maria kapten von Trappi seitsme lapse koduõpetajaks?
explanation_en: The Sound of Music follows Maria as she becomes governess to the seven von Trapp children and falls in love with their father.
explanation_et: „Helisev muusika“ jälgib Mariat, kellest saab von Trappi seitsme lapse koduõpetaja ja kes armub nende isasse.

clue_en: Which Lin-Manuel Miranda musical tells an American founding father’s life largely through sung and rapped hip-hop?
clue_et: Milline Lin-Manuel Miranda muusikal jutustab ühe Ameerika Ühendriikide rajaja elust peamiselt lauldud ja räpitud hiphopi kaudu?
explanation_en: Hamilton is Lin-Manuel Miranda’s sung-and-rapped-through biographical musical about Alexander Hamilton.
explanation_et: „Hamilton“ on Lin-Manuel Miranda laulu ja räpi kaudu jutustatud elulooline muusikal Alexander Hamiltonist.

clue_en: Name the musical in which teenager Tracy Turnblad wins a place on a Baltimore TV dance show and campaigns to integrate it.
clue_et: Nimeta muusikal, milles teismeline Tracy Turnblad pääseb Baltimore’i teletantsusaatesse ja hakkab võitlema rassilise eraldamise lõpetamise eest.
explanation_en: Hairspray centres on Tracy Turnblad, a Baltimore teenager who joins a television dance show and challenges its segregation.
explanation_et: „Hairspray“ keskmes on Baltimore’i teismeline Tracy Turnblad, kes pääseb teletantsusaatesse ja astub vastu rassilisele eraldamisele.

clue_en: Which musical traces the friendship of green-skinned Elphaba and popular Glinda before they become the witches of Oz?
clue_et: Milline muusikal jälgib rohelise nahaga Elphaba ja populaarse Glinda sõprust enne, kui neist saavad Ozi nõiad?
explanation_en: Wicked retells events in Oz through the friendship and eventual rupture between Elphaba and Glinda.
explanation_et: „Wicked“ jutustab Ozi sündmused ümber Elphaba ja Glinda sõpruse ning hilisema lahknemise kaudu.

clue_en: Which Stephen Sondheim musical intertwines Cinderella, Jack and the Beanstalk, Rapunzel and a baker’s wish for a child?
clue_et: Milline Stephen Sondheimi muusikal põimib kokku Tuhkatriinu, Jacki ja oavarre, Rapuntsli ning pagaripaari lapsesoovi?
explanation_en: Into the Woods combines several Brothers Grimm fairy tales and explores what follows after their characters’ wishes come true.
explanation_et: „Into the Woods“ ühendab mitu vendade Grimmide muinasjuttu ning uurib, mis juhtub pärast tegelaste soovide täitumist.

clue_en: Which Swedish singer won the contest with “Euphoria” in 2012 and “Tattoo” in 2023?
clue_et: Milline Rootsi laulja võitis võistluse 2012. aastal looga „Euphoria“ ja 2023. aastal looga „Tattoo“?
explanation_en: Loreen won Eurovision for Sweden with “Euphoria” in 2012 and again with “Tattoo” in 2023.
explanation_et: Loreen võitis Rootsi esindajana Eurovisiooni 2012. aastal looga „Euphoria“ ja 2023. aastal looga „Tattoo“.

clue_en: Which Ukrainian comic persona finished second in 2007 with “Dancing Lasha Tumbai”?
clue_et: Milline Ukraina koomiline lavakuju tuli 2007. aastal looga „Dancing Lasha Tumbai“ teiseks?
explanation_en: Verka Serduchka represented Ukraine in 2007, and “Dancing Lasha Tumbai” finished second with 235 points.
explanation_et: Verka Serduchka esindas 2007. aastal Ukrainat ning „Dancing Lasha Tumbai“ sai 235 punktiga teise koha.

clue_en: Name the Swedish singer who won both Melodifestivalen and Eurovision in 2015 with “Heroes”.
clue_et: Nimeta Rootsi laulja, kes võitis 2015. aastal looga „Heroes“ nii Melodifestivaleni kui ka Eurovisiooni.
explanation_en: Måns Zelmerlöw won both Melodifestivalen and Eurovision in 2015 with “Heroes”.
explanation_et: Måns Zelmerlöw võitis 2015. aastal looga „Heroes“ nii Melodifestivaleni kui ka Eurovisiooni.

clue_en: Which singer gave Portugal its first contest victory in 2017 with the understated “Amar pelos dois”?
clue_et: Milline laulja tõi 2017. aastal Portugalile esimese võidu vaoshoitud looga „Amar pelos dois“?
explanation_en: Salvador Sobral won Eurovision 2017 with “Amar pelos dois”, ending Portugal’s 53-year wait for a first victory.
explanation_et: Salvador Sobral võitis 2017. aasta Eurovisiooni looga „Amar pelos dois“ ja lõpetas Portugali 53 aastat kestnud esimese võidu ootuse.

clue_en: Which Irish performer won as a singer in 1980 and 1987, then wrote Linda Martin’s 1992 winner “Why Me?”
clue_et: Milline Iiri esineja võitis lauljana 1980. ja 1987. aastal ning kirjutas seejärel Linda Martini 1992. aasta võiduloo „Why Me?“?
explanation_en: Johnny Logan won Eurovision as a performer in 1980 and 1987 and composed the winning song in 1992.
explanation_et: Johnny Logan võitis Eurovisiooni esitajana 1980. ja 1987. aastal ning kirjutas 1992. aasta võiduloo.

clue_en: Which singer scored an early Estonian-language hit with “Roosiaia kuninganna” in 1980?
clue_et: Millise laulja varajane eestikeelne hitt oli 1980. aastal „Roosiaia kuninganna“?
explanation_en: “Roosiaia kuninganna” was Anne Veski’s first notable Estonian-language hit.
explanation_et: „Roosiaia kuninganna“ oli Anne Veski esimene laialt tuntud eestikeelne hitt.

clue_en: Which Eesti otsib superstaari winner represented Estonia with “Kuula” and placed sixth at Eurovision 2012?
clue_et: Milline „Eesti otsib superstaari“ võitja esindas Eestit looga „Kuula“ ja sai 2012. aasta Eurovisioonil kuuenda koha?
explanation_en: Ott Lepland won the third season of Eesti otsib superstaari and placed sixth at Eurovision 2012 with “Kuula”.
explanation_et: Ott Lepland võitis „Eesti otsib superstaari“ kolmanda hooaja ning saavutas looga „Kuula“ 2012. aasta Eurovisioonil kuuenda koha.

clue_en: Which singer was a member of Vanilla Ninja before launching a solo career under her first name in 2010?
clue_et: Milline laulja oli Vanilla Ninja liige ja alustas 2010. aastal eesnime all soolokarjääri?
explanation_en: Lenna Kuurmaa was a member of Vanilla Ninja and released her debut solo album Lenna in 2010.
explanation_et: Lenna Kuurmaa oli Vanilla Ninja liige ning avaldas 2010. aastal debüütsooloalbumi „Lenna“.

clue_en: Which vocalist of Ruja and Propeller died in the sinking of the ferry Estonia in 1994?
clue_et: Milline Ruja ja Propelleri laulja hukkus 1994. aastal parvlaeva Estonia katastroofis?
explanation_en: Urmas Alender fronted Ruja and Propeller and died when the ferry Estonia sank in 1994.
explanation_et: Urmas Alender oli Ruja ja Propelleri laulja ning hukkus 1994. aastal parvlaeva Estonia uppumisel.

clue_en: Which Estonian singer was nicknamed the “Kremlin’s Nightingale” for his many Russian-language performances in the 1980s?
clue_et: Millist Eesti lauljat hüüti 1980. aastatel arvukate venekeelsete esinemiste tõttu „Kremli ööbikuks“?
explanation_en: Jaak Joala became known as the “Kremlin’s Nightingale” after performing and recording widely in Russian.
explanation_et: Jaak Joala sai „Kremli ööbiku“ hüüdnime, sest esines ja salvestas palju vene keeles.

category_name_en: Baltic memories from the Eurovision stage
clue_en: Which Marie N song won Eurovision for Latvia after a costume change turned a white suit into a red dress?
clue_et: Milline Marie N laul võitis Lätile Eurovisioni, kui lavaline kostüümivahetus muutis valge ülikonna punaseks kleidiks?
explanation_en: Marie N performed the song with a choreographed costume transformation and gave Latvia its first Eurovision victory in 2002.
explanation_et: Marie N esitas laulu koreograafilise kostüümimuutusega ning tõi 2002. aastal Lätile esimese Eurovisioni võidu.

category_name_en: Baltic memories from the Eurovision stage
clue_en: Which Brainstorm song placed third on Latvia’s Eurovision debut in 2000?
clue_et: Milline Brainstormi laul saavutas Läti 2000. aasta Eurovisioni debüüdil kolmanda koha?
explanation_en: Brainstorm represented Latvia in the country’s first contest appearance and finished third with the song.
explanation_et: Brainstorm esindas Lätit riigi esimesel võistlusel ning saavutas selle lauluga kolmanda koha.

category_name_en: Baltic memories from the Eurovision stage
clue_en: Which retro-styled 2022 Eurovision entry did Monika Liu perform entirely in Lithuanian?
clue_et: Millise retrostiilis 2022. aasta Eurovisioni loo esitas Monika Liu tervenisti leedu keeles?
explanation_en: The Lithuanian-language song represented Lithuania in Turin and qualified for the final.
explanation_et: Leedukeelne laul esindas Leedut Torinos ning pääses finaali.

category_name_en: Baltic memories from the Eurovision stage
clue_en: Which LT United song finished sixth for Lithuania at Eurovision in 2006—its best result in the contest at the time?
clue_et: Milline LT Unitedi laul saavutas 2006. aasta Eurovisionil kuuenda koha, mis oli tollal Leedu parim tulemus sellel võistlusel?
explanation_en: LT United represented Lithuania with the song in 2006; the sixth-place finish was the country’s highest Eurovision placing at that time.
explanation_et: LT United esindas selle lauluga Leedut 2006. aastal ning kuues koht oli tollal riigi kõrgeim koht Eurovisionil.

category_name_en: Baltic memories from the Eurovision stage
clue_en: Which sparse electronic ballad by Aminata ended Latvia’s six-year absence from the Eurovision final?
clue_et: Milline Aminata hõreda elektroonilise seadega ballaad lõpetas Läti kuueaastase eemaloleku Eurovisioni finaalist?
explanation_en: Aminata represented Latvia in 2015, qualified for the final and achieved the country’s strongest result in a decade.
explanation_et: Aminata esindas Lätit 2015. aastal, pääses finaali ning saavutas riigi parima tulemuse kümne aasta jooksul.

category_name_en: Nordic pop songs that travelled worldwide
clue_en: Which wordless Darude track grew from a Finnish trance hit into a sports-arena staple and internet meme?
clue_et: Millisest sõnadeta Darude palast sai Soome trance’i hitt, spordiareenide lemmik ja internetimeem?
explanation_en: Darude’s 1999 instrumental became an international dance hit and later a recurring online and stadium reference.
explanation_et: Darude 1999. aasta instrumentaalpalast sai rahvusvaheline tantsuhitt ning hiljem korduv interneti- ja staadioniviide.

category_name_en: Nordic pop songs that travelled worldwide
clue_en: Which traditional American tune did Swedish group Rednex turn into a 1994 Eurodance-country hit?
clue_et: Millise Ameerika pärimuslaulu muutis Rootsi ansambel Rednex 1994. aastal eurodance’i ja kantri hitiks?
explanation_en: Rednex combined the traditional song with Eurodance and American instruments such as banjo and fiddle for an international hit.
explanation_et: Rednex ühendas pärimuslaulu eurodance’i ning Ameerika pillide, nagu bandžo ja viiuli kõlaga, saades rahvusvahelise hiti.

category_name_en: Nordic pop songs that travelled worldwide
clue_en: Which Robyn song turns watching an ex with someone else into a solitary dance-floor anthem?
clue_et: Milline Robyni laul muudab endise kallima uue kaaslase kõrvalt vaatamise üksildaseks tantsupõrandahümniks?
explanation_en: The Swedish singer’s electronic pop song places its narrator alone in a club, dancing while the former partner moves on.
explanation_et: Rootsi laulja elektrooniline poplugu asetab jutustaja klubisse üksi tantsima, samal ajal kui endine partner eluga edasi läheb.

category_name_en: Nordic pop songs that travelled worldwide
clue_en: Which Roxette song broke in the United States after an exchange student brought its Swedish album to a Minneapolis radio station?
clue_et: Milline Roxette’i laul murdis läbi USA-s pärast seda, kui vahetusõpilane viis ansambli Rootsi albumi Minneapolise raadiojaama?
explanation_en: A listener passed the album to station KDWB, whose airplay helped turn the song into Roxette’s first US number one.
explanation_et: Kuulaja andis albumi raadiojaamale KDWB ning sealne eetrimäng aitas laulul saada Roxette’i esimeseks USA esikohahitiks.

category_name_en: Nordic pop songs that travelled worldwide
clue_en: Which Björk cover bursts from whispered verses into brass-band choruses in a Spike Jonze street-musical video?
clue_et: Milline Björki kaver paisub sosistatud salmidest puhkpilliorkestriga refräänideks Spike Jonze’i tänavamuusikali meenutavas videos?
explanation_en: Björk reworked a song previously recorded by Betty Hutton, and Jonze directed its exuberant musical-style video.
explanation_et: Björk tegi uue versiooni Betty Huttoni varem salvestatud laulust ning Jonze lavastas selle hoogsa muusikalistiilis video.

category_name_en: Songs whose covers eclipsed the original
clue_en: Johnny Cash’s stark 2002 recording and its ageing-themed video recast a Nine Inch Nails song. Which song?
clue_et: Johnny Cashi napp 2002. aasta salvestis ja vananemisteemaline video andsid Nine Inch Nailsi loole uue tähenduse. Mis laul?
explanation_en: Nine Inch Nails released “Hurt” in 1995; Cash covered it near the end of his life, and Trent Reznor praised the deeply personal reinterpretation.
explanation_et: Nine Inch Nails avaldas „Hurti“ 1995. aastal; Cash kaverdas selle oma elu lõpul ning Trent Reznor kiitis väga isiklikku uut tõlgendust.

category_name_en: Songs whose covers eclipsed the original
clue_en: Prince wrote it and the Family recorded it first, but Sinéad O’Connor’s tearful close-up made which song a worldwide hit?
clue_et: Prince kirjutas selle ja The Family salvestas selle esimesena, kuid Sinéad O’Connori pisarane lähivõte tegi millisest laulust maailmahiti?
explanation_en: Prince wrote “Nothing Compares 2 U” for the Family; O’Connor’s 1990 recording became her signature hit and its video centred on her face.
explanation_et: Prince kirjutas „Nothing Compares 2 U“ ansamblile The Family; O’Connori 1990. aasta salvestisest sai tema tunnushitt ning video keskendus tema näole.

category_name_en: Songs whose covers eclipsed the original
clue_en: Leonard Cohen’s original drew little notice; John Cale simplified it, then Jeff Buckley turned that arrangement into an intimate standard. Which song?
clue_et: Leonard Coheni originaal äratas vähe tähelepanu; John Cale lihtsustas seadet ning Jeff Buckley intiimsest tõlgendusest sai klassika. Mis laul?
explanation_en: Cohen released “Hallelujah” in 1984; Cale’s later arrangement inspired Buckley’s celebrated voice-and-guitar recording.
explanation_et: Cohen avaldas laulu „Hallelujah“ 1984. aastal; Cale’i hilisem seade innustas Buckley tunnustatud intiimset versiooni, milles on kuulda vaid tema lauluhääl ja kitarr.

category_name_en: Songs whose covers eclipsed the original
clue_en: Lori Lieberman recorded it first; Roberta Flack topped the charts in 1973 and the Fugees revived it in 1996. Name the song.
clue_et: Lori Lieberman salvestas selle esimesena, Roberta Flack jõudis sellega 1973. aastal edetabeli tippu ning Fugees tõi loo 1996. aastal tagasi. Nimeta laul.
response_en: Killing Me Softly with His Song
response_et: Killing Me Softly with His Song
explanation_en: “Killing Me Softly with His Song” was first recorded by Lieberman, then became a major hit for Flack and later for the Fugees.
explanation_et: Laulu „Killing Me Softly with His Song“ salvestas esimesena Lieberman; hiljem sai sellest suur hitt nii Flacki kui ka Fugeesi esituses.
source_title: Killing Me Softly with His Song — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Songs whose covers eclipsed the original
clue_en: Bob Dylan began performing this song more like Jimi Hendrix’s stormy electric remake than his own acoustic original. Which song?
clue_et: Bob Dylan hakkas seda laulu esitama pigem Jimi Hendrixi tormilise elektrilise uusversiooni kui oma akustilise originaali moodi. Mis laul?
explanation_en: Hendrix transformed Dylan’s “All Along the Watchtower” with layered guitars; Dylan later adopted elements of the cover in concert.
explanation_et: Hendrix muutis Dylani laulu „All Along the Watchtower“ kihiliste kitarridega ning Dylan võttis hiljem kontsertidel kaverversiooni elemente üle.

category_name_en: Duets where two voices play different roles
category_name_et: Duetid, kus kahel häälel on eri roll
clue_en: In A Star Is Born, Bradley Cooper begins this exchange before Lady Gaga steps onstage and drives it to its soaring climax. Which duet?
clue_et: Filmis „A Star Is Born“ alustab Bradley Cooper seda laulu, enne kui Lady Gaga lavale astub ja loo võimsa haripunktini viib. Mis duett?
explanation_en: “Shallow” is performed by Cooper and Gaga in A Star Is Born, moving from his opening lines to her climactic vocal.
explanation_et: Laulu „Shallow“ esitavad filmis „A Star Is Born“ Cooper ja Gaga; laul liigub tema avaridadest Gaga võimsa lõpuvokaalini.
source_title: Shallow (Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper song) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Duets where two voices play different roles
category_name_et: Duetid, kus kahel häälel on eri roll
clue_en: Which 1976 duet pairs Elton John and Kiki Dee in an affectionate Motown-style pastiche?
clue_et: Milline 1976. aasta duett ühendab Elton Johni ja Kiki Dee mängulises Motowni stiili jäljenduses?
explanation_en: “Don’t Go Breaking My Heart” is an Elton John and Kiki Dee duet written as an affectionate pastiche of the Motown style.
explanation_et: „Don’t Go Breaking My Heart“ on Elton Johni ja Kiki Dee duett, mis kirjutati südamliku Motowni stiili jäljendusena.
source_title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Duets where two voices play different roles
category_name_et: Duetid, kus kahel häälel on eri roll
clue_en: Jay-Z supplies the street-level New York verses while Alicia Keys answers with the soaring chorus in which hit?
clue_et: Millises hitis esitab Jay-Z New Yorgi tänavaelu värsid ning Alicia Keys vastab võimsa refrääniga?
explanation_en: “Empire State of Mind” pairs Jay-Z’s rap verses with Alicia Keys’s sung chorus as a tribute to New York City.
explanation_et: „Empire State of Mind“ ühendab Jay-Z räpivärsid Alicia Keysi lauldud refrääniga ning on austusavaldus New Yorgile.

category_name_en: Duets where two voices play different roles
category_name_et: Duetid, kus kahel häälel on eri roll
clue_en: Peter Gabriel voices an unemployed man in despair; Kate Bush answers with comfort and hope. Which 1986 duet?
clue_et: Peter Gabriel kehastab meeleheitel töötut meest, Kate Bush vastab talle lohutuse ja lootusega. Mis 1986. aasta duett?
explanation_en: In “Don’t Give Up”, Gabriel sings the despairing verses and Bush provides the encouraging response.
explanation_et: Loos „Don’t Give Up“ laulab Gabriel meeleheitlikud salmid ning Bush vastab julgustava häälega.
source_title: Don't Give Up (Peter Gabriel and Kate Bush song) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Duets where two voices play different roles
category_name_et: Duetid, kus kahel häälel on eri roll
clue_en: Nick Cave tells a murder story from the killer’s viewpoint while Kylie Minogue sings as his victim. Which dark ballad?
clue_et: Nick Cave jutustab mõrvaloo tapja vaatepunktist, Kylie Minogue aga laulab ohvri rollis. Mis tume ballaad see on?
explanation_en: “Where the Wild Roses Grow” is a murder ballad whose alternating voices cast Cave as the killer and Minogue as Elisa Day, his victim.
explanation_et: „Where the Wild Roses Grow“ on mõrvaballaad, mille vahelduvates häältes on Cave tapja ja Minogue tema ohver Elisa Day.
source_title: Where the Wild Roses Grow — Wikipedia

clue_en: Trauma and isolation lead the rock star Pink to build an imaginary barrier around himself in which Pink Floyd album?
clue_et: Millisel Pink Floydi albumil ajendavad traumad ja eraldatus rokkstaar Pinki enda ümber kujuteldavat müüri ehitama?
explanation_en: The Wall follows Pink as painful experiences become metaphorical bricks separating him from other people.
explanation_et: „The Wall“ jälgib Pinki, kelle valusatest kogemustest saavad kujundlikud tellised, mis eraldavad teda teistest inimestest.

clue_en: Jesus of Suburbia leaves home, meets St. Jimmy and Whatsername, and confronts disillusionment across which Green Day album?
clue_et: Millisel Green Day albumil lahkub Jesus of Suburbia kodust, kohtub St. Jimmy ja Whatsername’iga ning kogeb pettumust?
explanation_en: American Idiot is a rock opera centred on the antihero Jesus of Suburbia and his experiences in an alienating America.
explanation_et: „American Idiot“ on rokk-ooper, mille keskmes on antikangelane Jesus of Suburbia ja tema kogemused võõrandavas Ameerikas.

clue_en: A dying figure called the Patient reviews his life and imagines death arriving as a procession in which My Chemical Romance album?
clue_et: Millisel My Chemical Romance’i albumil vaatab Patsient oma elule tagasi ja kujutleb surma saabumas rongkäiguna?
explanation_en: The Black Parade is a concept album about the Patient, a terminally ill man facing death and looking back on his life.
explanation_et: „The Black Parade“ on kontseptuaalalbum Patsiendist, ravimatult haigest mehest, kes seisab silmitsi surmaga ja vaatab tagasi oma elule.

clue_en: David Bowie’s alien rock messenger becomes famous as Earth approaches apocalypse, then falls from grace as his ego alienates fans and costs him his bandmates. Which album tells his story?
clue_et: David Bowie loodud tulnukast rokisõnumitooja saab maailmalõpu eel kuulsaks, kuid langeb oma ego tõttu soosingust, võõrandab fännid ja kaotab bändikaaslased. Milline album jutustab tema loo?
response_en: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
response_et: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
accepted_variants_en: Ziggy Stardust;The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust
accepted_variants_et: Ziggy Stardust;The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust
explanation_en: The album follows Ziggy Stardust from his arrival as a messenger through fame, an ego-driven loss of fans and bandmates, and a fall from grace.
explanation_et: Album jälgib Ziggy Stardusti teekonda sõnumitoojast kuulsuseni ning sealt ego põhjustatud fännide ja bändikaaslaste kaotuse ning languseni.
source_title: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars — Wikipedia

clue_en: A traumatised boy becomes a pinball champion and later a spiritual leader in which album by the Who?
clue_et: Millisel The Who albumil saab traumeeritud poisist flipperitšempion ja hiljem vaimne juht?
explanation_en: Tommy is the Who’s rock opera about Tommy Walker, whose extraordinary pinball skill leads to fame and a religious following.
explanation_et: „Tommy“ on The Who rokk-ooper Tommy Walkerist, kelle erakordne flipperioskus viib kuulsuse ja usulise järgijaskonnani.

category_name_en: Rock riffs with an origin story
clue_en: Keith Richards captured a guitar riff on a cassette player; the tape then held forty minutes of his snoring. Which Rolling Stones hit grew from it?
clue_et: Keith Richards salvestas kassettmakile kitarririfi; lindile jäi seejärel nelikümmend minutit tema norskamist. Milline Rolling Stonesi hitt sellest sündis?
accepted_variants_en: Satisfaction;I Can’t Get No Satisfaction;(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction;I Can't Get No Satisfaction
accepted_variants_et: Satisfaction;I Can’t Get No Satisfaction;(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction;I Can't Get No Satisfaction
explanation_en: The tape held about two minutes of acoustic guitar, then the sound of Richards dropping his pick and snoring for the next forty minutes.
explanation_et: Lindile jäi umbes kaks minutit akustilist kitarri, seejärel Richardsi plektri kukkumine ja tema järgmise neljakümne minuti norskamine.

category_name_en: Rock riffs with an origin story
clue_en: Ed King wrote the signature opening riff for which Lynyrd Skynyrd answer to Neil Young’s “Southern Man” and “Alabama”?
clue_et: Millise Lynyrd Skynyrdi vastuslaulu Neil Youngi lugudele „Southern Man“ ja „Alabama“ avab Ed Kingi tunnusriff?
explanation_en: Ed King wrote and played the signature riff; the band wrote “Sweet Home Alabama” in response to Neil Young’s criticism of the American South.
explanation_et: Ed King kirjutas ja mängis tunnusrifi; ansambel lõi loo „Sweet Home Alabama“ vastuseks Neil Youngi kriitikale USA lõunaosariikide aadressil.

category_name_en: Rock riffs with an origin story
clue_en: Slash was playing a string-skipping warm-up exercise when the rest of Guns N’ Roses built a song around it. Which hit?
clue_et: Slash mängis keelte vahelejätmisega soojendusharjutust, kui ülejäänud Guns N’ Roses ehitas selle ümber laulu. Mis hitt?
explanation_en: The opening riff of “Sweet Child o’ Mine” began as a practice exercise Slash played during a rehearsal jam.
explanation_et: Laulu „Sweet Child o’ Mine“ avariff sai alguse soojendusharjutusest, mida Slash bändi ühise jämmimise ajal mängis.

category_name_en: Rock riffs with an origin story
clue_en: Mark Knopfler improvised its riff to a studio click track while chasing Billy Gibbons’s ZZ Top tone; Sting sings the opening. Which song?
clue_et: Mark Knopfler improviseeris selle rifi stuudios klikiraja saatel, püüdes Billy Gibbonsi ZZ Topi kõla; algust laulab Sting. Mis laul?
explanation_en: Knopfler devised the “Money for Nothing” riff while improvising to a click track and modelled its guitar sound on Gibbons; Sting contributed the falsetto introduction.
explanation_et: Knopfler mõtles laulu „Money for Nothing“ rifi välja klikiraja saatel improviseerides ja võttis kitarrikõla eeskujuks Gibbonsi; Sting lisas falsetis sissejuhatuse.

category_name_en: Rock riffs with an origin story
clue_en: Jack Bruce devised this heavy descending Cream riff after attending a Jimi Hendrix concert. Which song grew from it?
clue_et: Jack Bruce mõtles selle raske laskuva Creami rifi välja pärast Jimi Hendrixi kontserti. Milline laul sellest kasvas?
explanation_en: Bruce wrote the riff that anchors “Sunshine of Your Love” after seeing Hendrix perform in London in 1967.
explanation_et: Bruce kirjutas laulu „Sunshine of Your Love“ kandva rifi pärast Hendrixi 1967. aasta Londoni kontserdi nägemist.

category_name_en: Pop songs that begin at the keyboard
clue_en: A repeating three-note piano arpeggio starts which Coldplay hit before drums and synthesiser widen the sound?
clue_et: Milline Coldplay hitt algab korduva kolmenoodilise klaveriarpedžoga, enne kui trummid ja süntesaator kõla avardavad?
explanation_en: “Clocks” grew from Chris Martin’s repeating piano riff, which remains the song’s central musical idea.
explanation_et: „Clocks“ kasvas Chris Martini korduvast klaveririfist, mis jäi laulu keskseks muusikaliseks ideeks.

category_name_en: Pop songs that begin at the keyboard
clue_en: Adele sings directly to an ex over Dan Wilson’s spare repeating piano figure in which breakup ballad?
clue_et: Millises lahkuminekuballaadis laulab Adele endisele kallimale Dan Wilsoni napi korduva klaverikäigu saatel?
explanation_en: “Someone Like You” was written by Adele and Dan Wilson and recorded with Adele’s voice accompanied only by piano.
explanation_et: „Someone Like You“ on Adele’i ja Dan Wilsoni kirjutatud ning salvestusel saadab Adele’i häält ainult klaver.

category_name_en: Pop songs that begin at the keyboard
clue_en: Vanessa Carlton plays a rolling piano pattern while travelling through the streets on a moving piano in which debut single?
clue_et: Millises debüütsinglis mängib Vanessa Carlton veerevat klaverikäiku, sõites samal ajal liikuva klaveriga mööda tänavaid?
explanation_en: “A Thousand Miles” opens with Carlton’s piano hook, and its music video famously shows her and the piano moving through several locations.
explanation_et: „A Thousand Miles“ algab Carltoni klaverikäiguga ning kuulsas videos liiguvad tema ja klaver läbi eri paikade.

category_name_en: Pop songs that begin at the keyboard
clue_en: Elton John’s first international Top 10 was written with Bernie Taupin and recorded for John’s self-titled second album. Which song?
clue_et: Milline koos Bernie Taupiniga kirjutatud ja Elton Johni teisele, omanimelisele albumile salvestatud laul sai Johni esimeseks rahvusvaheliseks esikümnehitiks?
explanation_en: “Your Song” was written by John and Taupin, appeared on Elton John and became John’s first international Top 10 single.
explanation_et: „Your Songi“ kirjutasid John ja Taupin, see ilmus albumil „Elton John“ ning sai Johni esimeseks rahvusvaheliseks esikümnesingliks.

category_name_en: Pop songs that begin at the keyboard
clue_en: A spare 1957 Sun Studio session used Jerry Lee Lewis on piano and vocals, with only bass and drums beside him. Which hit came from it?
clue_et: Milline hitt salvestati 1957. aastal Sun Studios hõreda koosseisuga: Jerry Lee Lewis mängis klaverit ja laulis ning teda saatsid ainult bass ja trummid?
explanation_en: “Great Balls of Fire” was recorded by Lewis with Sidney Stokes on bass and Larry Linn on drums; Lewis supplied both piano and vocals.
explanation_et: Laulu „Great Balls of Fire“ salvestusel mängis Sidney Stokes bassi ja Larry Linn trumme, Lewis ise mängis klaverit ning laulis.

category_name_et: Löökpillimomendid, millest ei saa mööda kuulata
clue_en: A sparse drum-machine stomp and a cheerleader-style chant drive which 2005 Gwen Stefani hit?
clue_et: Millist Gwen Stefani 2005. aasta hitti kannavad napp trummimasinabiit ja ergutushüüdu meenutav skandeering?
explanation_en: The Neptunes produced “Hollaback Girl” around a minimal programmed beat, while its cheerleading motif shapes the song’s shouted hook.
explanation_et: The Neptunes ehitas loo „Hollaback Girl“ minimalistlikule programmeeritud biidile, millele annab äratuntava kuju ergutushüüu motiiv.

category_name_et: Löökpillimomendid, millest ei saa mööda kuulata
clue_en: Phil Collins’s gated-reverb drum break crashes in towards the end of which song?
clue_et: Millise laulu lõpuosas murrab sisse Phil Collinsi väravkajaga trummipartii?
explanation_en: The famous drum break in “In the Air Tonight” arrives towards the end and uses gated reverb, a sound strongly associated with 1980s pop.
explanation_et: Laulu „In the Air Tonight“ kuulus trummipartii saabub lõpuosas ja kasutab väravkaja, mida seostatakse tugevalt 1980. aastate popmuusikaga.

category_name_et: Löökpillimomendid, millest ei saa mööda kuulata
clue_en: Ron Wilson’s rapid, rolling drum solo keeps returning through which 1963 surf-rock instrumental by the Surfaris?
clue_et: Millises ansambli The Surfaris 1963. aasta surf-rock’i instrumentaalpalas naaseb aina Ron Wilsoni kiire veerev trummisoolo?
explanation_en: “Wipe Out” is built around Wilson’s energetic drum feature, one of surf rock’s best-known percussion passages.
explanation_et: „Wipe Out“ on ehitatud Wilsoni hoogsa trummipartii ümber, mis on surf-rock’i üks tuntumaid löökpillilõike.

category_name_et: Löökpillimomendid, millest ei saa mööda kuulata
clue_en: John Bonham played at the foot of Headley Grange’s stairwell while microphones hung above him for the huge opening beat of which Led Zeppelin track?
clue_et: Millise Led Zeppelini loo hiiglasliku avarütmi jaoks mängis John Bonham Headley Grange’i trepikoja all, mikrofonid kõrgel pea kohal?
explanation_en: For “When the Levee Breaks”, Bonham’s drums were recorded in a stairwell with distant microphones and heavy processing, producing their monumental sound.
explanation_et: Laulu „When the Levee Breaks“ trummid salvestati trepikojas kaugete mikrofonide ja tugeva töötlusega, mis andis neile monumentaalse kõla.

category_name_et: Löökpillimomendid, millest ei saa mööda kuulata
clue_en: Gene Krupa’s extended tom-tom passages became the star of Benny Goodman’s famous big-band version of which Louis Prima tune?
clue_et: Millise Louis Prima loo Benny Goodmani kuulsas bigbändiversioonis tõusid esiplaanile Gene Krupa pikad tom-tom’i lõigud?
explanation_en: Louis Prima wrote “Sing, Sing, Sing”; Benny Goodman’s recording became celebrated for Krupa’s unusually prominent extended drum solos.
explanation_et: Louis Prima kirjutas „Sing, Sing, Singi“; Benny Goodmani salvestus sai kuulsaks Krupa tolle aja kohta haruldaselt pikkade ja silmapaistvate trummisoolodega.
source_title: Sing, Sing, Sing (with a Swing) — Wikipedia

clue_en: Engineers pushed pitch correction far beyond transparency to create Cher’s deliberately stepped vocal on which 1998 hit?
clue_et: Millises 1998. aasta Cheri hitis keerati helikõrguse korrigeerimine meelega äärmuslikuks, et hääl kõlaks astmeliselt?
explanation_en: “Believe” used extreme Auto-Tune settings as an audible effect, pioneering the vocal treatment often called the Cher effect.
explanation_et: „Believe“ kasutas Auto-Tune’i äärmuslikke seadeid kuuldava efektina ning tegi teerajajana tuntuks nn Cheri efekti.

clue_en: Brian Wilson assembled fragments recorded in four studios and added an electro-Theremin to make which Beach Boys single?
clue_et: Millise Beach Boysi singli pani Brian Wilson kokku neljas stuudios salvestatud lõikudest ja lisas sellele elektrotheremin’i?
explanation_en: “Good Vibrations” was constructed from many modular recording sessions across several studios, with its unusual electro-Theremin line helping define the sound.
explanation_et: „Good Vibrations“ ehitati paljudest eri stuudiotes tehtud moodulsalvestustest ning selle kõla kujundas ebatavaline elektrotheremin’i partii.

clue_en: George Martin joined two Beatles takes recorded in different keys and tempos by changing their tape speeds. Which song was the result?
clue_et: George Martin ühendas kaks eri helistikus ja tempos Beatlesi võtet, muutes nende lindikiirust. Milline laul nii valmis?
explanation_en: “Strawberry Fields Forever” combines takes 7 and 26; varispeed brought their pitch and tempo close enough for a seamless edit.
explanation_et: „Strawberry Fields Forever“ ühendab võtted 7 ja 26; lindikiirust muutes sobitas Martin nende helikõrguse ja tempo ning tegi sujuva liite.

clue_en: The Beatles fed homemade tape loops into several studio machines while John Lennon’s voice passed through a rotating Leslie speaker. Which track?
clue_et: Millises Beatlesi loos lasti isetehtud lindisilmuseid läbi mitme stuudiomasina ning suunati John Lennoni hääl läbi pöörleva Leslie kõlari?
explanation_en: “Tomorrow Never Knows” layers multiple tape loops and processes Lennon’s vocal through a Leslie speaker, making the studio central to the composition.
explanation_et: „Tomorrow Never Knows“ kihistab mitu lindisilmust ja töötleb Lennoni häält Leslie kõlariga, muutes stuudio heliloomingu keskseks osaks.

clue_en: Giorgio Moroder built a futuristic backing almost entirely from a Moog synthesiser beneath Donna Summer’s voice. Which disco landmark?
clue_et: Millises diskoklassikas ehitas Giorgio Moroder Donna Summeri hääle alla peaaegu täielikult Moogi süntesaatoril loodud futuristliku saate?
explanation_en: The electronic pulse of “I Feel Love” was created with a Moog modular synthesiser and became highly influential on later dance music.
explanation_et: Laulu „I Feel Love“ elektrooniline pulss loodi Moogi modulaarsüntesaatoriga ning see mõjutas tugevalt hilisemat tantsumuusikat.

clue_en: What software can gently correct a singer’s pitch or, at extreme settings, turn the voice into audible electronic steps?
clue_et: Milline tarkvara võib laulja helikõrgust märkamatult parandada või äärmuslikul seadistusel muuta hääle kuuldavateks elektroonilisteks astmeteks?
explanation_en: Auto-Tune analyses vocal pitch and shifts notes toward selected targets; fast correction produces its familiar stepped sound.
explanation_et: Auto-Tune analüüsib vokaali helikõrgust ja nihutab noodid valitud sihthelidele; kiire korrektsioon tekitab tuttava astmelise kõla.

clue_en: A voice stops, yet many tiny reflections make it linger as though it were in a hall or cathedral. What effect is this?
clue_et: Hääl vaikib, kuid paljud väikesed peegeldused lasevad sel kõlada edasi nagu saalis või katedraalis. Mis efekt see on?
explanation_en: Reverb, short for reverberation, is the persistence of sound caused by reflections arriving after the original sound.
explanation_et: Järelkõla ehk reverberatsioon on heli püsimine, sest peegeldused jõuavad kuulajani pärast algset heli.

clue_en: Clipping, overdrive and fuzz are different ways of producing which broader change to an audio signal’s waveform?
clue_et: Clipping, overdrive ja fuzz on eri viisid, kuidas tekitada millist laiemat helisignaali lainekuju muutust?
explanation_en: Distortion is the umbrella term for modification of a signal’s waveform; clipping and overdrive are common nonlinear forms used for guitar sounds.
explanation_et: Helimoonutus on üldnimetus signaali lainekuju muutmisele; signaalitippude äralõikamine ja ülevõimendamine on kitarrikõlas levinud mittelineaarsed vormid.

clue_en: Homer Dudley invented which speech-coding device at Bell Labs in 1937 to synthesise human speech, before musicians adopted it as an electronic instrument?
clue_et: Millise kõnekodeerimisseadme leiutas Homer Dudley 1937. aastal Bell Labsis inimkõne sünteesimiseks, enne kui muusikud võtsid selle kasutusele elektroonilise pillina?
explanation_en: The vocoder was invented by Dudley at Bell Labs as a speech-synthesis and bandwidth-saving telecommunications system and was later widely used as an electronic musical instrument.
explanation_et: Dudley leiutas vokoodri Bell Labsis kõnesünteesiks ja sidekanali ribalaiuse säästmiseks; hiljem hakati seda laialdaselt kasutama elektroonilise pillina.

clue_en: Mix a signal with a copy whose tiny delay continually changes and a sweeping, jet-plane-like comb filter appears. Name the effect.
clue_et: Sega signaal koopiaga, mille väga lühike viivitus pidevalt muutub, ning tekib pühkiv reaktiivlennukilaadne kammfilter. Nimeta efekt.
explanation_en: Flanging combines a sound with a slightly delayed, time-varying copy, causing moving peaks and notches in the frequency spectrum.
explanation_et: Flanger-efekt ühendab heli veidi viivitatud ja ajas muutuva koopiaga, tekitades sagedusspektris liikuvad tipud ja sälgud.

category_name_en: Songs that became voices of resistance
clue_en: A gospel hymn reshaped by labour activists became the communal anthem of the American civil-rights movement. Which song?
clue_et: Töölisliikumise aktivistide ümber kujundatud gospelhümnist sai Ameerika kodanikuõiguste liikumise ühine laul. Mis laul?
explanation_en: “We Shall Overcome” grew from gospel and labour-song traditions and became the best-known anthem of the US civil-rights movement.
explanation_et: „We Shall Overcome“ kasvas gospeli- ja töölislaulu traditsioonist ning sai USA kodanikuõiguste liikumise tuntuimaks hümniks.

category_name_en: Songs that became voices of resistance
clue_en: Bob Dylan asks how many roads, seas and deaths it will take before people recognise freedom and peace. Which song?
clue_et: Millises Bob Dylani laulus küsitakse, kui palju teid, meresid ja surmasid kulub, enne kui mõistetakse vabaduse ja rahu vajadust?
explanation_en: “Blowin’ in the Wind” poses rhetorical questions about war, peace and freedom; Peter, Paul and Mary helped turn it into a civil-rights standard.
explanation_et: „Blowin’ in the Wind“ esitab retoorilisi küsimusi sõja, rahu ja vabaduse kohta; Peter, Paul and Mary aitasid sellest teha kodanikuõiguste liikumise standardi.

category_name_en: Songs that became voices of resistance
clue_en: A martial drumbeat drives U2’s rejection of violence during the Troubles and recalls the 1972 killings in Derry. Which song?
clue_et: Sõjaväeline trummirütm kannab U2 vastuseisu Põhja-Iirimaa konflikti vägivallale ning meenutab 1972. aasta tapmisi Derrys. Mis laul?
explanation_en: “Sunday Bloody Sunday” refers to Bloody Sunday in Derry and frames the conflict through an insistent martial rhythm while condemning violence.
explanation_et: „Sunday Bloody Sunday“ viitab Derry verisele pühapäevale ning käsitleb konflikti tungiva sõjaväelise rütmi saatel, mõistes vägivalla hukka.

category_name_en: Songs that became voices of resistance
clue_en: Bob Marley stands almost alone with an acoustic guitar on the closing track of Uprising, urging listeners to free their minds. Which song?
clue_et: Millises albumi „Uprising“ lõpuloos laulab Bob Marley üksi, saatjaks ainult akustiline kitarr, ning kutsub kuulajaid oma mõistust vabastama?
explanation_en: “Redemption Song” closes Marley’s Uprising album in a solo acoustic performance and adapts words from Marcus Garvey into a call for mental emancipation.
explanation_et: „Redemption Song“ lõpetab Marley albumi „Uprising“: Marley laulab üksi akustilise kitarri saatel ning muudab Marcus Garvey sõnad vaimse vabanemise üleskutseks.

category_name_en: Songs that became voices of resistance
clue_en: Peter Gabriel commemorated the anti-apartheid activist who died in South African police custody in which 1980 protest song?
clue_et: Millises 1980. aasta protestilaulus mälestas Peter Gabriel Lõuna-Aafrika politsei vahi all surnud apartheidivastast aktivisti?
explanation_en: “Biko” tells of Steve Biko’s death in police custody and helped bring the anti-apartheid cause to a wider rock audience.
explanation_et: „Biko“ jutustab Steve Biko surmast politsei vahi all ning aitas tutvustada apartheidivastast võitlust laiemale rokipublikule.

category_name_en: Instruments that carry a region’s sound
category_name_et: Pillid, mis kannavad oma kandi kõla
clue_en: Which goblet-shaped West African drum is played with bare hands and can produce bass, tone and slap sounds?
clue_et: Millist pokaalikujulist Lääne-Aafrika trummi mängitakse paljaste kätega ning sellest saab tekitada bassi-, tooni- ja laksuhelisid?
explanation_en: The djembe is a rope-tuned, skin-covered goblet drum from West Africa, played by hand with several distinct strokes.
explanation_et: Djembe on Lääne-Aafrikast pärit nöörpingutusega nahkkattega pokaaltrumm, mida mängitakse kätega eri löögiviisidel.

category_name_en: Instruments that carry a region’s sound
category_name_et: Pillid, mis kannavad oma kandi kõla
clue_en: A long neck, a rounded body and bright paired strings make which Greek lute central to rebetiko music?
clue_et: Millise Kreeka lauto pikk kael, ümar korpus ja heledad paariskeeled annavad rebetiko-muusikale iseloomuliku kõla?
explanation_en: The bouzouki is a long-necked Greek lute whose metallic sound became closely associated with rebetiko and modern Greek popular music.
explanation_et: Buzuki on pika kaelaga Kreeka lauto, mille metallikõla seostub tihedalt rebetiko ja moodsa Kreeka levimuusikaga.

category_name_en: Instruments that carry a region’s sound
category_name_et: Pillid, mis kannavad oma kandi kõla
clue_en: Thirteen strings usually cross movable bridges on which long Japanese zither, plucked with finger picks?
clue_et: Millise pika Jaapani tsitri kolmteist keelt kulgevad tavaliselt üle liigutatavate roopide ja neid näpitakse sõrmeküünistega?
explanation_en: The koto is a Japanese long zither, commonly with thirteen strings stretched over movable bridges and plucked with picks.
explanation_et: Koto on Jaapani pikk tsitter, millel on tavaliselt 13 üle liigutatavate roopide kulgevat keelt ja mida näpitakse küünistega.

category_name_en: Instruments that carry a region’s sound
category_name_et: Pillid, mis kannavad oma kandi kõla
clue_en: Only two strings run beside a tiny snakeskin-covered soundbox, yet a bow held between them gives which Chinese instrument its singing voice?
clue_et: Vaid kaks keelt kulgevad väikese maonahaga kaetud kõlakasti kõrval ning nende vahel olev poogen annab millisele Hiina pillile laulva hääle?
explanation_en: The erhu is a two-stringed Chinese bowed instrument with a small soundbox traditionally covered in python skin.
explanation_et: Erhu on kahe keelega Hiina poogenpill, mille väike kõlakast on traditsiooniliselt kaetud püütoninahaga.

category_name_en: Instruments that carry a region’s sound
category_name_et: Pillid, mis kannavad oma kandi kõla
clue_en: West African griots accompany histories and praise songs on which 21-string bridge-harp built from a large calabash?
clue_et: Millisel suurest kalebassist ehitatud 21-keelsel sildharfil esitavad Lääne-Aafrika griot’d ajalugusid ja ülistuslaule?
explanation_en: The kora is a 21-string West African bridge-harp traditionally played by griots, hereditary historians and musicians.
explanation_et: Kora on 21-keelne Lääne-Aafrika sildharf, mida mängivad traditsiooniliselt pärilikud ajaloojutustajad ja muusikud ehk griot’d.

clue_en: Pacius’s melody also carries Finland’s “Maamme”, but Johann Voldemar Jannsen’s Estonian words make it which anthem?
clue_et: Milline hümn kasutab Paciuse meloodiat, millel kõlab ka Soome „Maamme“, kuid Johann Voldemar Jannseni eestikeelseid sõnu?

accepted_variants_et: Mu isamaa;Mu isamaa, mu onn ja room
explanation_en: “Mu isamaa, mu õnn ja rõõm” uses a melody by Fredrik Pacius that is also used for Finland’s national anthem “Maamme”.
explanation_et: „Mu isamaa, mu õnn ja rõõm“ kasutab Fredrik Paciuse meloodiat, millel kõlab ka Soome riigihümn „Maamme“.

clue_en: Rouget de Lisle wrote a war song for the Army of the Rhine; volunteers from Marseille carried it to Paris. Which anthem?
clue_et: Rouget de Lisle kirjutas Reini armeele sõjalaulu; Marseille’ vabatahtlikud viisid selle Pariisi. Mis hümn?
explanation_en: “La Marseillaise” began in 1792 as a war song for the Army of the Rhine and took its familiar name from Marseille volunteers.
explanation_et: „La Marseillaise“ sündis 1792. aastal Reini armee sõjalauluna ning sai tuttava nime Marseille’ vabatahtlike järgi.

clue_en: New Zealand gives equal official status to “God Save the King” and which locally written anthem, commonly sung in both English and Māori?
clue_et: Uus-Meremaa annab „God Save the Kingiga“ võrdse staatuse millisele kohapeal kirjutatud hümnile, mida lauldakse tavaliselt nii inglise kui ka maoori keeles?
explanation_en: “God Defend New Zealand” is one of New Zealand’s two national anthems and has official lyrics in English and Māori.
explanation_et: „God Defend New Zealand“ on üks Uus-Meremaa kahest riigihümnist ning sellel on ametlikud sõnad inglise ja maoori keeles.

clue_en: Lyrics adapted from a tiny ancient waka poem wish that a reign endure until pebbles grow into moss-covered boulders. Which Japanese anthem?
clue_et: Millise Jaapani hümni sõnad pärinevad lühikesest vanast waka-luuletusest, mis soovib valitsusajale kestust, kuni kivikesed kasvavad samblasteks rahnudeks?
explanation_en: “Kimigayo” sets words based on a waka poem found in a tenth-century anthology, making its text far older than its modern melody.
explanation_et: „Kimigayo“ sõnad põhinevad 10. sajandi luulekogus leiduval waka-luuletusel ning on seega tänapäevasest meloodiast palju vanemad.

clue_en: A resistance song written for the 1935 film Children of Troubled Times later became China’s national anthem. What is its title?
clue_et: 1935. aasta filmile „Children of Troubled Times“ kirjutatud vastupanulaulust sai hiljem Hiina riigihümn. Mis on selle pealkiri?
explanation_en: “March of the Volunteers” was created as the theme song of the 1935 film Children of Troubled Times before its adoption as China’s anthem.
explanation_et: „Vabatahtlike marss“ loodi 1935. aasta filmi „Children of Troubled Times“ tunnuslauluks ning võeti hiljem kasutusele Hiina hümnina.

category_name_en: Music videos remembered from one scene
clue_en: Michael Jackson becomes a zombie and leads the undead through one of pop’s most copied dance routines. Which video?
clue_et: Michael Jackson muutub zombiks ja juhib elavaid surnuid popajaloo ühes enim jäljendatud tantsunumbris. Mis video?
explanation_en: John Landis directed “Michael Jackson’s Thriller” as a horror short film whose central zombie dance became an enduring pop-culture image.
explanation_et: John Landis lavastas „Michael Jackson’s Thrilleri“ õudusliku lühifilmina, mille keskne zombitants sai püsivaks popkultuuri ikooniks.

category_name_en: Music videos remembered from one scene
clue_en: Peter Gabriel lies beneath a camera while fruit, clay figures and painted images animate around and across his face. Which video?
clue_et: Peter Gabriel lebab kaamera all, samal ajal kui puuviljad, savikujud ja maalitud pildid tema näo ümber ning peal kaaderhaaval elustuvad. Mis video?
explanation_en: The “Sledgehammer” video used stop motion, clay animation and pixilation, requiring Gabriel to pose frame by frame.
explanation_et: „Sledgehammeri“ video kasutas kaaderanimatsiooni, savianimatsiooni ja piksillatsiooni ning Gabriel pidi poseerima kaaderhaaval.

category_name_en: Music videos remembered from one scene
clue_en: Childish Gambino shifts from cheerful dance steps to sudden gun violence as chaos grows in a warehouse behind him. Which video?
clue_et: Childish Gambino liigub rõõmsatest tantsusammudest äkilise relvavägivallani, samal ajal kui tema taga laos kaos kasvab. Mis video?
explanation_en: Hiro Murai directed “This Is America”, whose long tracking shots contrast viral dance choreography with abrupt violence and background disorder.
explanation_et: Hiro Murai lavastas video „This Is America“, mille pikad liikuvad kaadrid vastandavad viraalse tantsukoreograafia äkilise vägivalla ja taustal kasvava korratusega.

category_name_en: Music videos remembered from one scene
clue_en: Four members of OK Go perform a single-take routine on eight moving treadmills. Which music video?
clue_et: OK Go neli liiget esitavad ühe võttega tantsukava kaheksal liikuval jooksulindil. Mis muusikavideo?
explanation_en: OK Go’s “Here It Goes Again” video became famous for its choreographed one-take performance on treadmills.
explanation_et: OK Go video „Here It Goes Again“ sai kuulsaks jooksulintidel tehtud koreograafilise ühevõtte-esitusega.

category_name_en: Music videos remembered from one scene
clue_en: Christopher Walken rises from a hotel chair, dances through the empty building and finally flies through its atrium. Which video?
clue_et: Christopher Walken tõuseb hotellitoolilt, tantsib läbi tühja hoone ja lendab lõpuks aatriumis. Mis video?
explanation_en: Spike Jonze directed the “Weapon of Choice” video, centred on Walken’s solo dance and flight through a Los Angeles hotel.
explanation_et: Spike Jonze lavastas „Weapon of Choice’i“ video, mille keskmes on Walkeni soolotants ja lend läbi Los Angelese hotelli.

category_name_en: Global hits adapted from another language
clue_en: Paul Anka kept the melody of Claude François’ “Comme d’habitude” but wrote new English lyrics for Frank Sinatra. Name the resulting standard.
clue_et: Paul Anka jättis alles Claude François’ loo „Comme d’habitude“ meloodia, kuid kirjutas Frank Sinatra jaoks uue ingliskeelse teksti. Mis laul sündis?
explanation_en: Paul Anka wrote English lyrics unrelated to the French words of “Comme d’habitude”; Frank Sinatra’s recording made “My Way” a standard.
explanation_et: Paul Anka kirjutas „Comme d’habitude’i“ meloodiale prantsuskeelsest algtekstist sõltumatu ingliskeelse teksti ning Frank Sinatra salvestus tegi loost standardi.

category_name_en: Global hits adapted from another language
clue_en: Solomon Linda recorded the Zulu song “Mbube”; after the “Wimoweh” stage of its journey, which English-language hit grew from it?
clue_et: Solomon Linda salvestas suulukeelse laulu „Mbube“. Milline ingliskeelne hitt kujunes sellest pärast „Wimoweh’“ etappi?
explanation_en: “The Lion Sleeps Tonight” developed from Solomon Linda’s “Mbube”, which had also circulated internationally as “Wimoweh”.
explanation_et: „The Lion Sleeps Tonight“ arenes Solomon Linda loost „Mbube“, mis oli rahvusvaheliselt levinud ka nime „Wimoweh“ all.

category_name_en: Global hits adapted from another language
clue_en: Rod McKuen adapted Jacques Brel’s “Le Moribond” into English; Terry Jacks later took which version to number one?
clue_et: Rod McKuen mugandas Jacques Breli „Le Moribondi“ inglise keelde. Millise versiooni viis Terry Jacks hiljem edetabeli tippu?
explanation_en: Rod McKuen wrote the English adaptation “Seasons in the Sun” from Jacques Brel’s “Le Moribond”; Terry Jacks made it a major hit.
explanation_et: Rod McKuen kirjutas Jacques Breli „Le Moribondist“ ingliskeelse muganduse „Seasons in the Sun“, mille Terry Jacks tegi suureks hitiks.

category_name_en: Global hits adapted from another language
clue_en: Jack Lawrence kept the melody of Charles Trenet’s “La Mer” but replaced its seascape with an English love lyric later popularized by Bobby Darin. Name the adaptation.
clue_et: Jack Lawrence säilitas Charles Trenet’ „La Meri“ meloodia, kuid asendas meremaastiku ingliskeelse armastuslaulu sõnadega, mille tegi hiljem tuntuks Bobby Darin. Mis mugandus see on?
explanation_en: “Beyond the Sea” uses the music of Charles Trenet’s “La Mer”, but Jack Lawrence’s English lyric is not a translation of the French words.
explanation_et: „Beyond the Sea“ kasutab Charles Trenet’ „La Meri“ muusikat, kuid Jack Lawrence’i ingliskeelne tekst ei ole prantsuskeelsete sõnade tõlge.

category_name_en: Global hits adapted from another language
clue_en: Dusty Springfield heard “Io che non vivo” at Sanremo, then asked friends to write unrelated English words to its melody. Name her hit.
clue_et: Dusty Springfield kuulis Sanremos laulu „Io che non vivo“ ja palus sõpradel selle meloodiale kirjutada uued ingliskeelsed sõnad. Mis hitt sündis?
response_en: You Don’t Have to Say You Love Me
response_et: You Don’t Have to Say You Love Me
accepted_variants_en: You Don't Have to Say You Love Me
accepted_variants_et: You Don't Have to Say You Love Me
explanation_en: “You Don’t Have to Say You Love Me” is Dusty Springfield’s English adaptation of “Io che non vivo”; its English lyric is not a literal translation.
explanation_et: „You Don’t Have to Say You Love Me“ on Dusty Springfieldi ingliskeelne mugandus laulust „Io che non vivo“ ning selle tekst ei ole otsetõlge.

clue_en: Adele channelled a breakup into an album containing “Rolling in the Deep” and “Someone Like You”. Name the album.
clue_et: Adele valas lahkumineku albumisse, millel kõlavad „Rolling in the Deep“ ja „Someone Like You“. Mis album see on?
explanation_en: Adele wrote “21” in the aftermath of separation from a partner; its songs include “Rolling in the Deep” and “Someone Like You”.
explanation_et: Adele kirjutas albumi „21“ pärast lahkuminekut ning selle laulude seas on „Rolling in the Deep“ ja „Someone Like You“.

clue_en: Which Alanis Morissette album moves from the fury of “You Oughta Know” toward the tenderness of “Head over Feet”?
clue_et: Milline Alanis Morissette’i album liigub „You Oughta Know“ raevust „Head over Feeti“ helluse poole?
explanation_en: “Jagged Little Pill” explores anger, broken relationships and recovery, including “You Oughta Know” and “Head over Feet”.
explanation_et: „Jagged Little Pill“ käsitleb viha, purunenud suhteid ja taastumist ning sisaldab lugusid „You Oughta Know“ ja „Head over Feet“.

clue_en: Which Bob Dylan album is widely heard through the lens of his marital breakup, although Dylan resisted a simple autobiographical reading?
clue_et: Millist Bob Dylani albumit seostatakse laialt tema abielu purunemisega, kuigi Dylan ise tõrjus lihtsat autobiograafilist tõlgendust?
explanation_en: “Blood on the Tracks” has often been interpreted in relation to Bob Dylan’s marital turmoil, though Dylan disputed that straightforward reading.
explanation_et: Albumit „Blood on the Tracks“ on sageli tõlgendatud Bob Dylani abielukriisi kaudu, ehkki Dylan vaidles sellisele otsesele tõlgendusele vastu.

clue_en: After ending his relationship with Leigh Limon, Beck turned toward strings, acoustic textures and unusually direct sadness on which album?
clue_et: Pärast suhte lõppu Leigh Limoniga pöördus Beck keelpillide, akustilise kõla ja ebatavaliselt otsese kurbuse poole. Mis albumil?
explanation_en: Beck made “Sea Change” after his breakup with Leigh Limon, shaping its songs around melancholy acoustic arrangements and strings.
explanation_et: Beck tegi albumi „Sea Change“ pärast lahkuminekut Leigh Limonist, kujundades selle laulud nukrate akustiliste seadete ja keelpillide ümber.

clue_en: A divorce settlement directed part of Marvin Gaye’s royalties to Anna Gordy; which candid double album emerged from that breakup?
clue_et: Lahutuskokkulepe suunas osa Marvin Gaye’i autoritasudest Anna Gordyle. Milline avameelne topeltalbum sellest lahkuminekust sündis?
explanation_en: Marvin Gaye recorded “Here, My Dear” while divorcing Anna Gordy; the settlement tied proceeds from his next album to her.
explanation_et: Marvin Gaye salvestas „Here, My Deari“ Anna Gordyst lahutamise ajal ning kokkulepe sidus tema järgmise albumi tulu Gordyga.

clue_en: Freddie Mercury led Wembley through “Radio Ga Ga” and “We Are the Champions” in a celebrated 1985 benefit set. Which performance was this?
clue_et: Freddie Mercury pani Wembley 1985. aasta heategevuskontserdil kaasa elama lugudele „Radio Ga Ga“ ja „We Are the Champions“. Milline esinemine see oli?
accepted_variants_en: Queen at Live Aid;Queen Live Aid
accepted_variants_et: Queen Live Aid;Queeni Live Aidi esinemine
explanation_en: Queen played a widely celebrated set at Live Aid in Wembley Stadium on 13 July 1985, fronted by Freddie Mercury.
explanation_et: Queen andis 13. juulil 1985 Wembley staadionil Live Aidil laialt kiidetud kontserdikava, mida juhtis Freddie Mercury.

clue_en: Police stopped which unannounced 1969 concert on the roof of Apple Corps in London?
clue_et: Millise ette teatamata 1969. aasta kontserdi Londonis Apple Corpsi katusel politsei lõpetas?
accepted_variants_en: the Beatles' rooftop concert;Beatles rooftop concert
explanation_en: The Beatles performed unannounced on the roof of Apple Corps on 30 January 1969; it became their final public performance as a group.
explanation_et: The Beatles esines 30. jaanuaril 1969 ette teatamata Apple Corpsi katusel; sellest sai ansambli viimane avalik esinemine.

clue_en: At which folk festival did Bob Dylan appear with electric instruments and members of the Paul Butterfield Blues Band, provoking a famous controversy?
clue_et: Millisel folkfestivalil astus Bob Dylan lavale elektripillide ja Paul Butterfield Blues Bandi liikmetega, põhjustades kuulsa poleemika?
explanation_en: Bob Dylan’s amplified set at the 1965 Newport Folk Festival prompted controversy and became a landmark in his move toward electric rock.
explanation_et: Bob Dylani võimendatud esinemine 1965. aasta Newport Folk Festivalil tekitas poleemikat ning tähistas tema liikumist elektrilise roki poole.

clue_en: George Harrison and Ravi Shankar organised which 1971 Madison Square Garden benefit for refugees from East Pakistan?
clue_et: Millise 1971. aasta Madison Square Gardeni heategevuskontserdi korraldasid George Harrison ja Ravi Shankar Ida-Pakistani põgenike toetuseks?
explanation_en: George Harrison and Ravi Shankar organised the Concert for Bangladesh at Madison Square Garden in 1971 to aid refugees from the Bangladesh Liberation War.
explanation_et: George Harrison ja Ravi Shankar korraldasid 1971. aastal Madison Square Gardenis Concert for Bangladeshi, et aidata Bangladeshi vabadussõja põgenikke.

clue_en: The Band billed its 1976 farewell with Bob Dylan, Joni Mitchell and Muddy Waters; Martin Scorsese filmed it. Name the concert.
clue_et: The Band reklaamis oma 1976. aasta hüvastijättu, kus esinesid Bob Dylan, Joni Mitchell ja Muddy Waters; Martin Scorsese filmis selle. Mis kontsert see oli?
explanation_en: The Last Waltz was the Band’s 1976 farewell concert, featuring many guests and filmed by Martin Scorsese.
explanation_et: „The Last Waltz“ oli The Bandi 1976. aasta hüvastijätukontsert paljude külalistega ning Martin Scorsese jäädvustas selle filmile.

clue_et: Millise tantsuhiti ehitas Madonna ABBA loo „Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!“ klahvpillikäigu ümber, olles saanud selleks haruldase loa?
explanation_en: Madonna’s “Hung Up” prominently samples the instrumental introduction to ABBA’s “Gimme! Gimme! Gimme! (A Man After Midnight)”.
explanation_et: Madonna „Hung Up“ sämplib silmapaistvalt ABBA loo „Gimme! Gimme! Gimme! (A Man After Midnight)“ instrumentaalset algust.

category_name_et: Kuulsad laulud, mille keskmes on sämpl
clue_en: Which Verve hit used a loop from the Andrew Oldham Orchestra’s version of “The Last Time”, leading to a long rights dispute?
clue_et: Milline The Verve’i hitt kasutas tsüklina Andrew Oldham Orchestra versiooni loost „The Last Time“ ning põhjustas pika õigustevaidluse?
explanation_en: “Bitter Sweet Symphony” uses a sample from the Andrew Oldham Orchestra recording of “The Last Time”; its rights became the subject of a prolonged dispute.
explanation_et: „Bitter Sweet Symphony“ kasutab sämplit Andrew Oldham Orchestra salvestusest „The Last Time“ ning selle õiguste üle peeti pikka vaidlust.

clue_en: A loop from the Clash’s “Straight to Hell” meets gunshots and a cash register in which M.I.A. hit?
clue_et: Millises M.I.A. hitis kohtuvad The Clashi loo „Straight to Hell“ tsükkel, püssipaugud ja kassaaparaadi heli?
explanation_en: M.I.A.’s “Paper Planes” samples the Clash’s “Straight to Hell” and punctuates its chorus with gunshot and cash-register sounds.
explanation_et: M.I.A. „Paper Planes“ sämplib The Clashi lugu „Straight to Hell“ ning lisab refrääni püssipaugud ja kassaaparaadi heli.

clue_en: Fatboy Slim turned Camille Yarbrough’s vocal from “Take Yo’ Praise” into the centre of which hit?
clue_et: Millise hiti keskmesse tõstis Fatboy Slim Camille Yarbrough’ vokaali loost „Take Yo’ Praise“?
explanation_en: Fatboy Slim’s “Praise You” is built around a prominent sample of Camille Yarbrough’s “Take Yo’ Praise”.
explanation_et: Fatboy Slimi „Praise You“ põhineb Camille Yarbrough’ loo „Take Yo’ Praise“ silmapaistval sämplil.

clue_en: The Fugees sampled Enya’s “Boadicea” without initial permission on which 1996 single, before the dispute was settled?
clue_et: Millises 1996. aasta singlis sämplis The Fugees Enya lugu „Boadicea“ esialgu loata, enne kui vaidlus lahendati?
explanation_en: The Fugees’ “Ready or Not” samples Enya’s “Boadicea”; the unapproved use was later settled.
explanation_et: The Fugeesi „Ready or Not“ sämplib Enya lugu „Boadicea“; algselt loata kasutus lahendati hilisema kokkuleppega.

category_name_en: Technologies that changed how music travelled
clue_en: Apple launched which pocket player in 2001 with the promise of “1,000 songs in your pocket”?
clue_et: Millise taskupleieri tõi Apple 2001. aastal turule lubadusega „1000 laulu sinu taskus“?
explanation_en: Apple introduced the iPod in 2001 and promoted its capacity with the phrase “1,000 songs in your pocket”.
explanation_et: Apple tutvustas iPodi 2001. aastal ning reklaamis selle mahutavust fraasiga „1000 laulu sinu taskus“.

category_name_en: Technologies that changed how music travelled
clue_en: Philips and Sony jointly standardised which optical format that replaced many vinyl records and cassettes?
clue_et: Millise optilise formaadi standardisid Philips ja Sony ühiselt ning mis asendas paljud vinüülplaadid ja kassetid?
explanation_en: Philips and Sony collaborated on the compact disc, an optical digital-audio format commercially introduced in the early 1980s.
explanation_et: Philips ja Sony tegid koostööd kompaktplaadi loomisel; see optiline digitaalaudio formaat jõudis turule 1980. aastate alguses.

category_name_en: Technologies that changed how music travelled
clue_en: Which late-1990s peer-to-peer service made MP3 sharing effortless, then faced lawsuits from the recording industry?
clue_et: Milline 1990. aastate lõpu võrdõigusvõrgu teenus muutis MP3-failide jagamise lihtsaks ning sattus seejärel plaaditööstusega kohtuvaidlustesse?
explanation_en: Napster launched as a peer-to-peer music-sharing service in 1999 and was forced to shut down after copyright litigation.
explanation_et: Napster alustas 1999. aastal võrdõigusvõrgus muusikajagamise teenusena ning pidi autoriõiguste üle peetud kohtuvaidluste järel tegevuse lõpetama.

category_name_en: Technologies that changed how music travelled
clue_en: Replacing fragile vacuum tubes with a solid-state component made which receiver small enough to carry everywhere?
clue_et: Vaakumlampide asendamine pooljuhtelemendiga muutis millise vastuvõtja piisavalt väikeseks, et seda kõikjale kaasa võtta?
explanation_en: The transistor radio used transistors instead of vacuum tubes, enabling small, battery-powered and portable receivers.
explanation_et: Transistorraadio kasutas lampide asemel transistore, võimaldades väikseid patareitoitel kaasaskantavaid vastuvõtjaid.

category_name_en: Technologies that changed how music travelled
clue_en: Sony introduced which recordable magneto-optical format in 1992, hoping it would succeed the cassette?
clue_et: Millise salvestatava magnetoptilise formaadi tõi Sony 1992. aastal turule lootusega, et see asendab kasseti?
explanation_en: Sony introduced MiniDisc in 1992 as a magneto-optical digital format positioned as a successor to the compact cassette.
explanation_et: Sony tõi MiniDisci 1992. aastal turule magnetoptilise digiformaadina, mida kavandati kompaktkasseti järglaseks.

category_name_en: When rock, rap and pop shared a track

explanation_en: Queen and David Bowie wrote and recorded “Under Pressure” together after jamming at Mountain Studios in Switzerland.

explanation_en: Santana’s “Smooth” features Rob Thomas as singer and co-writer and became a major 1999 chart hit.
explanation_et: Santana „Smoothis“ laulab ja kaasautorina osaleb Rob Thomas; loost sai 1999. aastal suur edetabelihitt.

explanation_et: Evanescence’i „Bring Me to Life“ ühendab Amy Lee soolovokaali 12 Stonesi laulja Paul McCoy külalisvokaaliga.

clue_en: Linkin Park and Jay-Z fused two of their songs for which Grammy-winning track from the mash-up EP “Collision Course”?
clue_et: Millise Grammy võitnud loo ühendasid Linkin Park ja Jay-Z oma lugudest ühisel mash-up-EP-l „Collision Course“?
explanation_en: “Numb/Encore” combines Linkin Park’s “Numb” with Jay-Z’s “Encore” and appeared on their collaborative EP “Collision Course”.
explanation_et: „Numb/Encore“ ühendab Linkin Parki „Numbi“ ja Jay-Z „Encore’i“ ning ilmus nende ühisel EP-l „Collision Course“.

clue_en: Public Enemy remade which song with Anthrax in 1991, creating a landmark meeting of rap and heavy metal?
clue_et: Millise loo tegi Public Enemy 1991. aastal koos Anthraxiga uuesti, luues räpi ja raskemetalli märgilise kohtumise?
explanation_en: Public Enemy and Anthrax released a joint 1991 version of “Bring the Noise”, influential in the development of rap metal.
explanation_et: Public Enemy ja Anthrax avaldasid 1991. aastal ühise versiooni loost „Bring the Noise“, mis mõjutas räppmetalli arengut.

category_name_en: Songs that turned headlines into protest
clue_en: Billie Holiday made Abel Meeropol’s anti-lynching poem into which haunting song?
clue_et: Millise painava laulu tegi Billie Holiday Abel Meeropoli lintšimisvastasest luuletusest?
explanation_en: Abel Meeropol wrote “Strange Fruit” as a protest against lynching; Billie Holiday’s recording made it famous.
explanation_et: Abel Meeropol kirjutas „Strange Fruiti“ protestiks lintšimise vastu ning Billie Holiday salvestus tegi selle tuntuks.

category_name_en: Songs that turned headlines into protest
clue_en: Which Creedence Clearwater Revival song attacked the class privilege that let powerful families avoid the Vietnam draft?
clue_et: Milline Creedence Clearwater Revivali laul ründas klassieeliseid, mis aitasid mõjuvõimsate perede poegadel Vietnami mobilisatsioonist pääseda?
explanation_en: “Fortunate Son” protests the unequal burden of the Vietnam War and the privilege enjoyed by politically connected families.
explanation_et: „Fortunate Son“ protestib Vietnami sõja ebavõrdse koorma ja poliitiliselt seotud perekondade privileegide vastu.

category_name_en: Songs that turned headlines into protest
clue_en: Jerry Dammers and the Special AKA turned the imprisonment of a South African leader into which upbeat 1984 protest single?
clue_et: Millise hoogsa 1984. aasta protestisingli tegid Jerry Dammers ja The Special AKA ühe Lõuna-Aafrika juhi vangistamise teemal?
explanation_en: Jerry Dammers wrote “Free Nelson Mandela”, recorded by the Special AKA in 1984 as an anti-apartheid protest.
explanation_et: Jerry Dammers kirjutas apartheidivastase loo „Free Nelson Mandela“, mille The Special AKA salvestas 1984. aastal.

category_name_en: Songs that turned headlines into protest
clue_en: Nina Simone wrote which furious song after Medgar Evers’s murder and the bombing of Birmingham’s 16th Street Baptist Church?
clue_et: Millise raevuka laulu kirjutas Nina Simone pärast Medgar Eversi mõrva ja Birminghami 16th Street Baptist Churchi pommitamist?
explanation_en: Nina Simone wrote “Mississippi Goddam” in response to racist violence including Medgar Evers’s murder and the Birmingham church bombing.
explanation_et: Nina Simone kirjutas „Mississippi Goddami“ vastuseks rassistlikule vägivallale, sealhulgas Medgar Eversi mõrvale ja Birminghami kiriku pommitamisele.

category_name_en: Songs that turned headlines into protest
clue_en: Elvis Costello wrote the words and Robert Wyatt recorded the best-known early version of which song about the Falklands War’s cruel economic bargain?
clue_et: Millise Falklandi sõja julma majanduslikku tehingut käsitleva laulu sõnad kirjutas Elvis Costello ja tuntuima varase versiooni salvestas Robert Wyatt?
explanation_en: “Shipbuilding”, with lyrics by Elvis Costello, reflects on shipyard jobs created by a war that also sends local men to fight; Robert Wyatt recorded an acclaimed version.
explanation_et: Elvis Costello sõnadega „Shipbuilding“ vaatleb sõja loodud laevatehasetööde ja sõtta saadetud kohalike meeste vastuolu; tuntud versiooni salvestas Robert Wyatt.

category_name_en: Live albums that define a performer
clue_en: Nirvana’s mostly acoustic MTV television set in New York was released as which live album after Kurt Cobain’s death?
clue_et: Millise kontsertalbumina ilmus pärast Kurt Cobaini surma Nirvana peamiselt akustiline MTV teleesinemine New Yorgis?
explanation_en: Nirvana’s “MTV Unplugged in New York” documents the band’s 1993 acoustic television performance, whose set avoided a conventional parade of hits.
explanation_et: Nirvana „MTV Unplugged in New York“ jäädvustab ansambli 1993. aasta akustilise teleesinemise, mille kava vältis tavapärast hitirida.
source_title: MTV Unplugged in New York — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Live albums that define a performer
clue_en: Johnny Cash recorded which landmark 1968 live album before inmates at a California prison?
clue_et: Millise märgilise 1968. aasta kontsertalbumi salvestas Johnny Cash ühe California vangla kinnipeetavate ees?
explanation_en: Johnny Cash recorded “At Folsom Prison” before inmates at Folsom State Prison in January 1968.
