explanation_et: Johnny Cash salvestas albumi „At Folsom Prison“ 1968. aasta jaanuaris Folsomi osariigivangla kinnipeetavate ees.

category_name_en: Live albums that define a performer
clue_en: A talk box electrifies “Show Me the Way” and “Do You Feel Like We Do” on which blockbuster double live album?
clue_et: Millise menuka topeltkontsertalbumi lugudes „Show Me the Way“ ja „Do You Feel Like We Do“ särab talk box?
explanation_en: Peter Frampton’s double live album “Frampton Comes Alive!” features hit live versions of “Show Me the Way” and “Do You Feel Like We Do”.
explanation_et: Peter Framptoni topeltkontsertalbum „Frampton Comes Alive!“ sisaldab menukaid live-versioone lugudest „Show Me the Way“ ja „Do You Feel Like We Do“.

category_name_en: Live albums that define a performer
clue_en: The Who captured which famously loud 1970 album in the dining hall of a Yorkshire university?
clue_et: Millise kuulsalt valju 1970. aasta albumi salvestas The Who ühe Yorkshire’i ülikooli sööklas?
explanation_en: The Who recorded “Live at Leeds” at the University of Leeds Refectory on 14 February 1970.
explanation_et: The Who salvestas „Live at Leedsi“ 14. veebruaril 1970 Leedsi ülikooli sööklas.

category_name_en: Live albums that define a performer
clue_en: A lone singer begins “Psycho Killer” with a portable cassette player; performers and equipment then join song by song, and later he appears in an oversized suit. Name the concert film and album.
clue_et: Üksik laulja alustab lugu „Psycho Killer“ kaasaskantava kassetimängijaga; seejärel lisandub iga looga lavale esinejaid ja tehnikat ning hiljem ilmub ta hiiglaslikus ülikonnas. Mis kontsertfilm ja -album see on?
explanation_en: Jonathan Demme filmed Talking Heads for “Stop Making Sense”; its staged concert adds performers and equipment song by song and features David Byrne’s oversized suit.
explanation_et: Jonathan Demme filmis Talking Headsi teose „Stop Making Sense“ jaoks; lavastus lisab esinejaid ja tehnikat lugu loo haaval ning selles kannab David Byrne hiiglaslikku ülikonda.

category_name_en: Cover versions that became the standard
clue_en: UB40 turned a Neil Diamond song into which relaxed reggae-pop hit?
clue_et: Millise Neil Diamondi laulu muutis UB40 rahulikuks reggae-pop-hitiks?
explanation_en: Neil Diamond wrote and first recorded “Red Red Wine”; UB40’s reggae version became an international hit.
explanation_et: Neil Diamond kirjutas ja salvestas esimesena „Red Red Wine’i“; UB40 reggae-versioonist sai rahvusvaheline hitt.

category_name_en: Cover versions that became the standard
clue_en: John Lennon shredded his voice in one take at the end of a long Beatles session for which Isley Brothers-associated cover?
clue_et: Millise The Isley Brothersiga seostatud kaveri laulis John Lennon ühe võttega pika Beatlesi salvestuspäeva lõpus, hääl juba katkemas?
explanation_en: The Beatles recorded “Twist and Shout” in one take at the end of the session for their debut album, with John Lennon on lead vocal.
explanation_et: The Beatles salvestas „Twist and Shouti“ debüütalbumi sessiooni lõpus ühe võttega ning John Lennon laulis soolot.

category_name_en: Cover versions that became the standard
clue_en: Santana joined Peter Green’s Fleetwood Mac song to “Gypsy Queen” for which enduring Latin-rock recording?
clue_et: Millise kestva latiinoroki salvestuse jaoks ühendas Santana Peter Greeni Fleetwood Maci loo teosega „Gypsy Queen“?
explanation_en: Peter Green wrote “Black Magic Woman” for Fleetwood Mac; Santana’s hit recording combined it with Gábor Szabó’s “Gypsy Queen”.
explanation_et: Peter Green kirjutas „Black Magic Womani“ Fleetwood Macile; Santana hittsalvestus ühendas selle Gábor Szabó looga „Gypsy Queen“.

category_name_en: Cover versions that became the standard
clue_en: Blondie took a Jamaican rocksteady song by the Paragons to number one under what title?
clue_et: Millise pealkirjaga Jamaica rocksteady-loo viis Blondie edetabeli tippu pärast The Paragonsi algversiooni?
explanation_en: The Paragons first recorded “The Tide Is High”; Blondie’s 1980 cover became a transatlantic number-one hit.
explanation_et: The Paragons salvestas „The Tide Is High“ esimesena; Blondie 1980. aasta kaver tõusis mõlemal pool Atlandit esikohale.

category_name_en: Cover versions that became the standard
clue_en: Kris Kristofferson co-wrote this song, Roger Miller recorded it first, but Janis Joplin’s version became a posthumous US number one. Name it.
clue_et: Kris Kristofferson oli selle loo kaasautor ja Roger Miller salvestas selle esimesena, kuid Janis Joplini versioonist sai postuumne USA esikohahitt. Mis laul?
explanation_en: Kris Kristofferson and Fred Foster wrote “Me and Bobby McGee”; Janis Joplin’s recording reached number one after her death.
explanation_et: Kris Kristofferson ja Fred Foster kirjutasid „Me and Bobby McGee“ ning Janis Joplini salvestus jõudis pärast tema surma esikohale.

category_name_en: Festivals remembered for one historic moment
category_name_et: Festivalid, mida meenutatakse ühe ajaloolise hetke järgi
clue_en: At which 1967 California festival did Jimi Hendrix set his guitar alight during his American breakthrough performance?
clue_et: Millisel 1967. aasta California festivalil süütas Jimi Hendrix oma Ameerika läbimurdel kitarr põlema?
explanation_en: Jimi Hendrix’s performance at the 1967 Monterey International Pop Festival, ending with his guitar being set on fire, helped establish him in the United States.
explanation_et: Jimi Hendrixi 1967. aasta Monterey popfestivali esinemine, mille lõpus ta kitarri süütas, aitas tal Ameerika Ühendriikides läbi murda.

category_name_en: Festivals remembered for one historic moment
category_name_et: Festivalid, mida meenutatakse ühe ajaloolise hetke järgi
clue_en: At the first edition in 1985, a vast Brazilian crowd sang “Love of My Life” back to Queen at which festival?
clue_et: Millise festivali esimesel, 1985. aasta üritusel laulis tohutu Brasiilia publik koos Queeniga lugu „Love of My Life“?
explanation_en: Queen played the first Rock in Rio in 1985, where the audience’s mass singalong to “Love of My Life” became one of the festival’s remembered images.
explanation_et: Queen esines 1985. aastal esimesel Rock in Riol, kus publiku ühislaulust „Love of My Life“ sai üks festivali meeldejäävaid hetki.
source_title: Love of My Life (Queen song) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Festivals remembered for one historic moment
category_name_et: Festivalid, mida meenutatakse ühe ajaloolise hetke järgi
clue_en: Hells Angels provided security and Meredith Hunter was killed at which disastrous 1969 California event?
clue_et: Millisel katastroofilisel 1969. aasta California üritusel valvasid korda Hells Angelsi liikmed ning tapeti Meredith Hunter?
explanation_en: At the 1969 Altamont Free Concert, Meredith Hunter was killed near the stage while the Hells Angels were acting as security.
explanation_et: 1969. aasta Altamonti tasuta kontserdil tapeti lava lähedal Meredith Hunter ajal, mil Hells Angels tegutses turvana.

category_name_en: Festivals remembered for one historic moment
category_name_et: Festivalid, mida meenutatakse ühe ajaloolise hetke järgi
clue_en: Jimi Hendrix, the Who, the Doors, Miles Davis and Joni Mitchell all played which enormous 1970 festival on an English island?
clue_et: Millisel Inglismaa saarel peetud hiiglaslikul 1970. aasta festivalil esinesid Jimi Hendrix, The Who, The Doors, Miles Davis ja Joni Mitchell?
explanation_en: The 1970 Isle of Wight Festival assembled those major acts at Afton Down and became one of the largest music events of its time.
explanation_et: 1970. aasta Isle of Wighti festival tõi need nimekad esinejad Afton Downile ning sellest sai üks oma aja suurimaid muusikasündmusi.

category_name_en: Festivals remembered for one historic moment
category_name_et: Festivalid, mida meenutatakse ühe ajaloolise hetke järgi
clue_en: Footage of Nina Simone, Stevie Wonder and Sly and the Family Stone at Mount Morris Park lay unseen for decades before appearing in “Summer of Soul”. Which 1969 festival was it?
clue_et: Mount Morris Parkis toimunud Nina Simone’i, Stevie Wonderi ning Sly and the Family Stone’i esinemiste ülesvõtted jäid aastakümneteks avalikkuse ette jõudmata, enne kui neid näidati filmis „Summer of Soul“. Mis 1969. aasta festival see oli?
explanation_en: The 1969 Harlem Cultural Festival featured those performers; its long-unseen footage was presented in Questlove’s documentary “Summer of Soul”.
explanation_et: 1969. aasta Harlemi kultuurifestivalil esinesid need artistid ning aastakümneid näitamata ülesvõtted jõudsid Questlove’i dokumentaalfilmi „Summer of Soul“.

category_name_en: Studio stories hidden inside famous songs
clue_en: Sting accidentally sat on a piano, producing an atonal chord and laughter left at the start of which Police song?
clue_et: Sting istus kogemata klaverile; tekkinud kakofooniline akord ja naer jäid millise The Police’i laulu algusse?
explanation_en: The opening of the Police’s “Roxanne” preserves an accidental piano chord and Sting’s laughter after he sat on the keyboard.
explanation_et: The Police’i loo „Roxanne“ algusesse jäi kogemata tekkinud klaveriakord ja Stingi naer pärast seda, kui ta klaviatuurile istus.

category_name_en: Studio stories hidden inside famous songs
clue_en: Al Kooper arrived hoping to play guitar but improvised the prominent organ part on which Bob Dylan single?
clue_et: Al Kooper tuli stuudiosse lootusega mängida kitarri, kuid improviseeris millise Bob Dylani singli silmapaistva orelipartii?
explanation_en: Al Kooper, originally present as a guitarist, improvised the Hammond organ part heard on Bob Dylan’s “Like a Rolling Stone”.
explanation_et: Al Kooper, kes tuli stuudiosse kitarristina, improviseeris Bob Dylani „Like a Rolling Stone’i“ Hammondi oreli partii.

category_name_en: Studio stories hidden inside famous songs
clue_en: Dave Davies slashed the speaker cone of a small Elpico amplifier to create the distorted riff on which Kinks hit?
clue_et: Millise The Kinksi hiti moonutatud rifi jaoks lõikas Dave Davies väikese Elpico võimendi kõlarikoonuse katki?
explanation_en: Dave Davies produced the distorted guitar sound on “You Really Got Me” by cutting the speaker cone of his Elpico amplifier.
explanation_et: Dave Davies tekitas „You Really Got Me“ moonutatud kitarrikõla, lõigates oma Elpico võimendi kõlarikoonust.

category_name_en: Studio stories hidden inside famous songs
clue_en: Merry Clayton’s voice cracks on a high note and Mick Jagger’s reaction is audible in which Rolling Stones recording?
clue_et: Millises The Rolling Stonesi salvestuses murdub Merry Claytoni hääl kõrgel noodil ning kuulda on Mick Jaggeri reaktsiooni?
explanation_en: Merry Clayton’s backing vocal on “Gimme Shelter” includes a voice crack, followed by an audible reaction from the studio.
explanation_et: Merry Claytoni taustavokaalis loos „Gimme Shelter“ murdub hääl ning sellele järgneb stuudios kuuldav reaktsioon.

category_name_en: Studio stories hidden inside famous songs
clue_en: According to drummer Ron Bushy, Doug Ingle slurred his intended title “In the Garden of Eden”; what title did Bushy write down?
clue_et: Trummar Ron Bushy sõnul hääldas Doug Ingle kavandatud pealkirja „In the Garden of Eden“ segaselt. Millise pealkirja Bushy kirja pani?
explanation_en: Iron Butterfly’s title “In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida” arose when Ron Bushy transcribed Doug Ingle’s slurred pronunciation of “In the Garden of Eden”.
explanation_et: Iron Butterfly pealkiri „In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida“ sündis, kui Ron Bushy kirjutas üles Doug Ingle’i segase häälduse fraasist „In the Garden of Eden“.

category_name_en: Film themes that escaped the screen
category_name_et: Filmiteemad, mis hakkasid elama oma elu
clue_en: Henry Mancini’s prowling tenor-saxophone melody for Inspector Clouseau became a chart single and won Grammys. Name it.
clue_et: Henry Mancini hiiliv tenorsaksofonimeloodia inspektor Clouseau filmile sai edetabelisingliks ja võitis Grammysid. Mis selle nimi on?
explanation_en: Henry Mancini composed “The Pink Panther Theme” for the 1963 film; the tenor-saxophone-led recording became a successful single.
explanation_et: Henry Mancini kirjutas „The Pink Panther Theme’i“ 1963. aasta filmile ning tenorsaksofoniga salvestusest sai menukas singel.

category_name_en: Film themes that escaped the screen
category_name_et: Filmiteemad, mis hakkasid elama oma elu
clue_en: Bill Conti’s brass-driven music accompanies a boxer’s training and run up the Philadelphia Museum steps. Name the theme.
clue_et: Bill Conti vaskpillidest kantud muusika saadab poksija treeningut ja jooksu mööda Philadelphia kunstimuuseumi treppe. Mis teema see on?
explanation_en: Bill Conti composed “Gonna Fly Now” as the training theme for the film “Rocky”; it later reached number one in the United States.
explanation_et: Bill Conti kirjutas „Gonna Fly Now“ filmi „Rocky“ treeninguteemaks ning lugu jõudis hiljem USA edetabeli tippu.

category_name_en: Film themes that escaped the screen
category_name_et: Filmiteemad, mis hakkasid elama oma elu
clue_en: Clint Mansell’s Kronos Quartet cue from “Requiem for a Dream” was rearranged as “Requiem for a Tower” for a “Two Towers” trailer. Name the original cue.
clue_et: Clint Manselli Kronos Quarteti pala filmist „Requiem for a Dream“ seati „Kahe kantsi“ treilerile ümber nimega „Requiem for a Tower“. Mis oli algse pala nimi?
explanation_en: Clint Mansell’s “Lux Aeterna” was written for “Requiem for a Dream”; an orchestral adaptation called “Requiem for a Tower” was used in “The Two Towers” advertising.
explanation_et: Clint Manselli „Lux Aeterna“ kirjutati filmile „Requiem for a Dream“; orkestriseadet „Requiem for a Tower“ kasutati „Kahe kantsi“ reklaamis.
source_title: Lux Aeterna (Requiem for a Dream) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Film themes that escaped the screen
category_name_et: Filmiteemad, mis hakkasid elama oma elu
clue_en: Metallica has long used which Ennio Morricone cemetery-scene cue from “The Good, the Bad and the Ugly” as entrance music?
clue_et: Millist Ennio Morricone surnuaia-stseeni pala filmist „Hea, halb ja inetu“ on Metallica kaua kasutanud lavale tuleku muusikana?
explanation_en: Ennio Morricone composed “The Ecstasy of Gold” for “The Good, the Bad and the Ugly”; Metallica adopted it as concert entrance music.
explanation_et: Ennio Morricone kirjutas „The Ecstasy of Goldi“ filmile „Hea, halb ja inetu“ ning Metallica võttis selle kontsertide sissejuhatuseks.

category_name_en: Film themes that escaped the screen
category_name_et: Filmiteemad, mis hakkasid elama oma elu
clue_en: A tin whistle and fiddle carry Howard Shore’s Shire music in “The Fellowship of the Ring”. Name the cue that became shorthand for Hobbit life.
clue_et: Plekkflööt ja viiul kannavad Howard Shore’i Maakonna muusikat filmis „Sõrmuse vennaskond“. Mis pala sai kääbikuelu muusikaliseks märgiks?
explanation_en: Howard Shore’s “Concerning Hobbits” appears on “The Fellowship of the Ring” soundtrack and develops the Shire theme with folk-like instruments.
explanation_et: Howard Shore’i „Concerning Hobbits“ kõlab „Sõrmuse vennaskonna“ heliribal ning arendab Maakonna teemat rahvapilliliku kõlaga.

category_name_en: Classical works with a creation story
clue_en: Name the piece George Gershwin premiered at the piano in 1924 after Paul Whiteman commissioned it for his “Experiment in Modern Music”.
clue_et: Millise Paul Whitemani „Experiment in Modern Musicu“ jaoks tellitud teose 1924. aasta esiettekandel mängis klaverit George Gershwin ise?
explanation_en: George Gershwin composed “Rhapsody in Blue” for Paul Whiteman’s 1924 concert “An Experiment in Modern Music” and played the piano at its premiere.
explanation_et: George Gershwin kirjutas „Rhapsody in Blue“ Paul Whitemani 1924. aasta kontserdile „An Experiment in Modern Music“ ning mängis esiettekandel klaverit.

category_name_en: Classical works with a creation story
clue_en: Beethoven initially dedicated his Third Symphony to Napoleon, then withdrew the dedication after Napoleon declared himself emperor. By what name is the work known?
clue_et: Beethoven pühendas oma kolmanda sümfoonia algul Napoleonile, kuid võttis pühenduse tagasi, kui Napoleon kuulutas end keisriks. Millise nime all seda sümfooniat tuntakse?
explanation_en: Beethoven’s manuscript shows Napoleon’s name erased from the title page; the published work was titled “Sinfonia eroica”.
explanation_et: Beethoveni käsikirja tiitellehel on Napoleoni nimi maha kraabitud; trükis ilmus teos pealkirjaga „Sinfonia eroica“.

category_name_en: Classical works with a creation story
clue_en: George I heard which Handel suite from musicians travelling on a barge along the Thames in 1717?
clue_et: Millist Händeli süiti kuulas George I 1717. aastal Thamesil liikunud praamil mänginud muusikutelt?
explanation_en: Handel’s “Water Music” was performed for King George I during a royal barge journey on the Thames in 1717.
explanation_et: Händeli „Veemuusikat“ esitati kuningas George I-le 1717. aasta kuninglikul praamisõidul Thamesil.

category_name_en: Classical works with a creation story
clue_en: In the finale, Haydn’s musicians stop playing and leave one by one—a pointed request that Prince Esterházy let them go home. Name the symphony.
clue_et: Finaalis lõpetavad Haydni muusikud ükshaaval mängimise ja lahkuvad, vihjates vürst Esterházyle, et nad tahavad koju. Mis sümfoonia see on?
explanation_en: In the finale of Haydn’s Symphony No. 45, musicians leave one by one; the gesture is traditionally linked to their wish to return home from Esterháza.
explanation_et: Haydni 45. sümfoonia finaalis lahkuvad muusikud ükshaaval; seda žesti seostatakse nende sooviga Esterházast koju pääseda.

category_name_en: Classical works with a creation story
clue_en: Berlioz turned unrequited love, an opium dream and a recurring idée fixe into a march to the scaffold and a witches’ sabbath. Name the work.
clue_et: Berlioz põimis vastamata armastuse, oopiumiunenäo ja korduva idée fixe’i tapalavale viivaks marsiks ning nõidade sabatiks. Mis teos see on?
explanation_en: Berlioz’s program for “Symphonie fantastique” follows an artist’s opium vision; its recurring idée fixe represents his beloved.
explanation_et: Berliozi „Fantastilise sümfoonia“ programm jälgib kunstniku oopiumiunenägu ning korduv idée fixe kujutab tema armastatut.

category_name_en: Pop hooks played on unexpected instruments
clue_en: George Harrison’s sitar gave which Beatles song one of Western rock’s earliest widely heard Indian-instrument hooks?
clue_et: Millisele The Beatlesi laulule andis George Harrisoni sitar ühe lääne roki varaseima laialt kuuldud sitarikäigu?
explanation_en: George Harrison played sitar on “Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown)”, an early prominent use of the instrument on a Western rock recording.
explanation_et: George Harrison mängis sitarit loos „Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown)“, mis oli üks pilli varaseid silmapaistvaid kasutusi lääne roki salvestusel.
source_title: Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Pop hooks played on unexpected instruments
clue_en: After Paul McCartney heard a piccolo trumpet in Bach’s Second Brandenburg Concerto, George Martin arranged a part for that instrument in which Beatles single?
clue_et: Pärast seda, kui Paul McCartney kuulis Bachi teises Brandenburgi kontserdis pikolotrompetit, seadis George Martin sellele pillile partii millises The Beatlesi singlis?
explanation_en: Paul McCartney was inspired by the televised Bach performance to use piccolo trumpet in “Penny Lane”; George Martin arranged the part and David Mason performed it.
explanation_et: Televisioonis nähtud Bachi teos innustas Paul McCartneyt kasutama loos „Penny Lane“ pikolotrompetit; George Martin seadis partii ja David Mason mängis selle sisse.

category_name_en: Pop hooks played on unexpected instruments
clue_en: The Campbeltown Pipe Band supplies the massed bagpipe hook on which Wings single?
clue_et: Millise Wingsi singli võimsa torupillikäigu mängib Campbeltown Pipe Band?
explanation_en: Wings recorded “Mull of Kintyre” with the Campbeltown Pipe Band, whose bagpipes are central to the arrangement.
explanation_et: Wings salvestas „Mull of Kintyre’i“ koos Campbeltown Pipe Bandiga, kelle torupillid on seade keskmes.

category_name_en: Pop hooks played on unexpected instruments
clue_en: Greg Ham’s recurring saxophone line answers Colin Hay’s anxious vocal in which Men at Work hit?
clue_et: Millises Men at Worki hitis vastab Greg Hami korduv saksofonikäik Colin Hay ärevale vokaalile?
explanation_en: Men at Work’s “Who Can It Be Now?” features a prominent saxophone hook played by Greg Ham.
explanation_et: Men at Worki loos „Who Can It Be Now?“ kõlab Greg Hami silmapaistev saksofonikäik.
source_title: Who Can It Be Now? — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Pop hooks played on unexpected instruments
clue_en: Jim Horn’s flute carries the hook of which Canned Heat song, adapting the quill melody from Henry Thomas’s “Bull Doze Blues”?
clue_et: Millise Canned Heati loo käiku mängib Jim Horni flööt, mugandades Henry Thomase „Bull Doze Bluesi“ vilepillimeloodiat?
explanation_en: Canned Heat’s “Going Up the Country” adapts Henry Thomas’s “Bull Doze Blues”; Jim Horn plays its distinctive flute part.
explanation_et: Canned Heati „Going Up the Country“ mugandab Henry Thomase lugu „Bull Doze Blues“ ning iseloomuliku flöödipartii mängib Jim Horn.

category_name_en: Recordings built mostly from the human voice
clue_en: Bobby McFerrin layered his own voice and body sounds, with no instruments, on which first a cappella US number-one hit?
clue_et: Millise esimese a cappella USA esikohahiti lõi Bobby McFerrin oma hääle ja kehahäälte kihtidest ilma pillideta?
explanation_en: Bobby McFerrin recorded “Don’t Worry, Be Happy” using only vocal and other sounds he made, without instruments; it became a US number one.
explanation_et: Bobby McFerrin salvestas „Don’t Worry, Be Happy“ ainult enda tekitatud vokaal- ja kehahäältega, ilma pillideta; loost sai USA esikohahitt.

category_name_en: Recordings built mostly from the human voice
clue_en: Suzanne Vega’s original version was an unaccompanied vocal; DNA later added a dance beat to which song?
clue_et: Suzanne Vega algversioon oli saateta vokaal ning DNA lisas sellele hiljem tantsubiidi. Mis laul see on?
explanation_en: Suzanne Vega first released “Tom’s Diner” as an a cappella recording; DNA’s unauthorized remix turned it into a dance hit.
explanation_et: Suzanne Vega avaldas „Tom’s Dineri“ algul a cappella salvestusena; DNA loata remiks muutis selle tantsuhitiks.

category_name_en: Recordings built mostly from the human voice
clue_en: Clare Torry improvised a wordless vocal over Richard Wright’s piano progression on which Pink Floyd track?
clue_et: Millises Pink Floydi loos improviseeris Clare Torry sõnadeta vokaali Richard Wrighti klaverikäigu kohal?
response_en: The Great Gig in the Sky
response_et: The Great Gig in the Sky
explanation_en: Clare Torry improvised the wordless lead vocal on Pink Floyd’s “The Great Gig in the Sky”, built around Richard Wright’s composition.
explanation_et: Clare Torry improviseeris sõnadeta soolovokaali Pink Floydi loos „The Great Gig in the Sky“, mille aluseks on Richard Wrighti helilooming.
source_title: The Great Gig in the Sky — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Recordings built mostly from the human voice
clue_en: Imogen Heap stacked and processed her voice through a harmonizer, with almost no conventional instrumentation, on which song?
clue_et: Millises loos kihistas ja töötles Imogen Heap oma häält harmonisaatoriga peaaegu ilma tavapillideta?
explanation_en: Imogen Heap’s “Hide and Seek” is constructed around her multitracked voice processed through a harmonizer.
explanation_et: Imogen Heapi „Hide and Seek“ on üles ehitatud harmonisaatoriga töödeldud mitmerajalisele vokaalile.
source_title: Hide and Seek (Imogen Heap song) — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Recordings built mostly from the human voice
clue_en: Björk used throat singers, beatboxers and choirs to make which album overwhelmingly from voices?
clue_et: Millise valdavalt häältest koosneva albumi lõi Björk kurgulauljate, vokaalperkussionistide ja kooride abil?
explanation_en: Björk’s “Medúlla” is composed almost entirely of human vocals, including choir, throat singing and beatboxing.
explanation_et: Björki „Medúlla“ koosneb peaaegu täielikult inimhäältest, sealhulgas koorist, kurgulaulust ja vokaalperkusioonist.

category_name_en: Electronic records that redrew the map
clue_en: New Order fused sequenced electronics and a machine-like drum pattern on which famously best-selling 12-inch single?
clue_et: Millises kuulsalt menukas 12-tollises singlis ühendas New Order sekventseeritud elektroonika masinliku trummirütmiga?
explanation_en: New Order’s “Blue Monday” combined sequencers, synthesizers and electronic percussion and became the best-selling 12-inch single.
explanation_et: New Orderi „Blue Monday“ ühendas sekventserid, süntesaatorid ja elektroonilised löökpillid ning sellest sai enimmüüdud 12-tolline singel.

category_name_en: Electronic records that redrew the map
clue_en: A motorway journey became the long title track of which Kraftwerk album that gave the group its international breakthrough?
clue_et: Kiirteereisist sai millise Kraftwerki rahvusvahelise läbimurde toonud albumi pikk nimilugu?
explanation_en: Kraftwerk’s album “Autobahn”, centred on its motorway-themed title track, brought the group international commercial success.
explanation_et: Kraftwerki album „Autobahn“, mille keskmes on kiirteeteemaline nimilugu, tõi ansamblile rahvusvahelise edu.

category_name_en: Electronic records that redrew the map
clue_en: Jean-Michel Jarre recorded which analogue-synthesizer landmark in a makeshift home studio?
clue_et: Millise analoogsüntesaatorite märgilise albumi salvestas Jean-Michel Jarre ajutises kodustuudios?
explanation_en: Jean-Michel Jarre recorded “Oxygène” in a home studio using analogue synthesizers and other electronic instruments.
explanation_et: Jean-Michel Jarre salvestas „Oxygène’i“ kodustuudios analoogsüntesaatorite ja teiste elektrooniliste pillidega.

category_name_en: Electronic records that redrew the map
clue_en: DJ Shadow assembled which debut album almost entirely from sampled records using turntables and a sampler?
clue_et: Millise debüütalbumi pani DJ Shadow peaaegu täielikult kokku sämplitud plaatidest, kasutades plaadimängijaid ja sämplerit?
explanation_en: DJ Shadow’s “Endtroducing.....” was constructed almost entirely from samples and is recognised as a landmark of instrumental hip-hop.
explanation_et: DJ Shadow’ „Endtroducing.....“ ehitati peaaegu täielikult sämplitest ning seda peetakse instrumentaalhiphopi märgiliseks albumiks.

category_name_en: Electronic records that redrew the map
clue_en: Early home recordings by Richard D. James became which Aphex Twin debut, a cornerstone of ambient techno?
clue_et: Millise Aphex Twini ambient-techno nurgakiviks saanud debüütalbumi moodustasid Richard D. Jamesi varased kodusalvestused?
explanation_en: Aphex Twin’s debut album “Selected Ambient Works 85–92” collects tracks recorded by Richard D. James over several earlier years.
explanation_et: Aphex Twini debüütalbum „Selected Ambient Works 85–92“ koondab Richard D. Jamesi mitme varasema aasta jooksul salvestatud lugusid.

category_name_en: Orchestral works that paint a world
clue_en: Four violin concertos come with sonnets depicting barking dogs, summer storms, harvest dances and winter ice. Name the cycle.
clue_et: Neli viiulikontserti on seotud sonettidega, mis kujutavad haukuvaid koeri, suvetorme, lõikustantse ja talvejääd. Mis tsükkel see on?
explanation_en: Vivaldi’s “The Four Seasons” consists of four violin concertos accompanied by sonnets that describe scenes and weather in each season.
explanation_et: Vivaldi „Neli aastaaega“ koosneb neljast viiulikontserdist, mida saadavad iga aastaaja stseene ja ilma kirjeldavad sonetid.

category_name_en: Orchestral works that paint a world
clue_en: “Mars” is warlike and “Jupiter” brings jollity in which seven-movement astrological suite that omits Earth?
clue_et: Millises seitsmeosalises astroloogilises süidis on „Marss“ sõjakas ja „Jupiter“ rõõmutooja, kuid Maa puudub?
explanation_en: Holst’s suite “The Planets” gives seven planets astrological characters, from Mars to Neptune, and does not include Earth.
explanation_et: Holsti süit „Planeedid“ annab seitsmele planeedile Marsist Neptuunini astroloogilise karakteri ega sisalda Maad.

category_name_en: Orchestral works that paint a world
clue_en: A recurring “Promenade” walks between musical depictions of Viktor Hartmann’s artworks in which Mussorgsky suite?
clue_et: Millises Mussorgski süidis liigub korduv „Promenaad“ Viktor Hartmanni kunstiteoste muusikaliste kujutiste vahel?
explanation_en: Mussorgsky composed “Pictures at an Exhibition” in response to an exhibition of Viktor Hartmann’s art; its “Promenade” links several movements.
explanation_et: Mussorgski kirjutas „Pildid näituselt“ Viktor Hartmanni kunstinäituse põhjal ning „Promenaad“ seob mitut osa.

category_name_en: Orchestral works that paint a world
clue_en: Which Smetana tone poem, the second in “Má vlast”, takes both its Czech name and German title from the river that flows through Prague?
clue_et: Milline Smetana sümfooniline poeem, tsükli „Má vlast“ teine osa, kannab Praha läbiva jõe tšehhikeelset nime?
explanation_en: Smetana’s second “Má vlast” tone poem is “Vltava”, also known by the German name “The Moldau”, after the river that runs through Prague.
explanation_et: Smetana tsükli „Má vlast“ teine sümfooniline poeem on „Vltava“, saksa nimega „The Moldau“, ning see kujutab Praha läbivat jõge.

category_name_en: Orchestral works that paint a world
clue_en: A recurring solo violin voices the storyteller who survives by spinning tales from “One Thousand and One Nights”. Name Rimsky-Korsakov’s suite.
clue_et: Korduv sooloviiul annab hääle jutustajale, kes jääb ellu „Tuhande ja ühe öö“ lugusid jutustades. Mis on Rimski-Korsakovi süidi nimi?
explanation_en: Rimsky-Korsakov’s “Scheherazade” draws on “One Thousand and One Nights”, with a recurring solo violin associated with its storyteller.
explanation_et: Rimski-Korsakovi „Šeherezade“ tugineb „Tuhande ja ühe öö“ lugudele ning korduvat sooloviiulit seostatakse jutustajaga.

clue_en: Two violins, a viola and a cello make up this four-player chamber ensemble. Name it.
clue_et: Kaks viiulit, vioola ja tšello moodustavad selle neljaliikmelise kammeransambli. Nimeta koosseis.
explanation_en: A string quartet is an ensemble of two violinists, a violist and a cellist, as well as music written for that group.
explanation_et: Keelpillikvartett on ansambel, kuhu kuuluvad kaks viiuldajat, vioolamängija ja tšellist, ning ka sellele koosseisule kirjutatud muusika.

clue_en: A main theme keeps returning between contrasting passages in this classical form. Name the form.
clue_et: Selles klassikalises vormis naaseb põhiteema kontrastsete vaheosade järel ikka ja jälle. Nimeta vorm.
explanation_en: A rondo is built around a principal theme that returns between contrasting musical episodes.
explanation_et: Rondo põhineb peateemal, mis naaseb kontrastsete muusikaliste episoodide vahel.

clue_en: This lyrical composition evokes the night; a Polish Romantic composer wrote many famous examples for piano. Name the form.
clue_et: See lüüriline teos loob öise meeleolu; üks Poola romantismiaja helilooja kirjutas klaverile palju kuulsaid näiteid. Nimeta vorm.
explanation_en: A nocturne is a musical composition inspired by or evocative of the night, especially associated with lyrical piano music.
explanation_et: Nokturn on ööst inspireeritud või öist meeleolu kujutav muusikateos, mida seostatakse eriti lüürilise klaverimuusikaga.

clue_en: A musician practises a piece designed to develop a particular technical skill. Name this kind of composition.
clue_et: Muusik harjutab pala, mis on loodud kindla mängutehnilise oskuse arendamiseks. Nimeta selline teos.
explanation_en: An étude is a composition created to practise a particular musical technique, though many are also concert works.
explanation_et: Etüüd on kindla mängutehnika harjutamiseks loodud teos, ehkki paljud etüüdid kuuluvad ka kontserdirepertuaari.

clue_en: Soloists, choir and orchestra tell a large sacred story in concert, without costumes or scenery. Name the form.
clue_et: Solistid, koor ja orkester jutustavad kontserdil ulatusliku vaimuliku loo ilma kostüümide ja lavakujunduseta. Nimeta vorm.
explanation_en: An oratorio is a large work for voices and orchestra, often on a sacred subject and normally presented without staging.
explanation_et: Oratoorium on ulatuslik teos häältele ja orkestrile, sageli vaimulikul teemal ning tavaliselt ilma lavastuseta.

clue_en: This Canadian crooner recorded Haven't Met You Yet and a popular cover of Feeling Good. Name him.
clue_et: See Kanada mahedahäälne laulja salvestas lood „Haven't Met You Yet“ ja populaarse kaveri laulust „Feeling Good“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Michael Bublé is a Canadian singer whose recordings include Haven't Met You Yet and a cover of Feeling Good.
explanation_et: Michael Bublé on Kanada laulja, kelle salvestiste hulka kuuluvad „Haven't Met You Yet“ ja kaver laulust „Feeling Good“.

clue_en: Come Away with Me introduced this American singer and pianist to a worldwide audience. Name her.
clue_et: Album „Come Away with Me“ tutvustas seda USA lauljat ja pianisti ülemaailmsele publikule. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Norah Jones is an American singer and pianist whose debut album was Come Away with Me.
explanation_et: Norah Jones on USA laulja ja pianist, kelle debüütalbum oli „Come Away with Me“.

clue_en: I Left My Heart in San Francisco and later jazz albums with Lady Gaga point to this American singer. Name him.
clue_et: „I Left My Heart in San Francisco“ ja hilisemad džässialbumid Lady Gagaga viitavad sellele USA lauljale. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: American singer Tony Bennett was known for I Left My Heart in San Francisco and later recorded jazz albums with Lady Gaga.
explanation_et: USA laulja Tony Bennett sai tuntuks looga „I Left My Heart in San Francisco“ ja salvestas hiljem Lady Gagaga džässialbumeid.

clue_en: Smooth Operator and The Sweetest Taboo feature the restrained, jazz-influenced voice of this Nigerian-born British singer. Name her.
clue_et: „Smooth Operator“ ja „The Sweetest Taboo“ toovad esile selle Nigeerias sündinud Briti laulja jaheda, džässimõjulise hääle. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: British singer Sade fronts the band that bears her name and is known for songs including Smooth Operator and The Sweetest Taboo.
explanation_et: Briti laulja Sade on enda nime kandva ansambli solist ja tuntud muu hulgas lugude „Smooth Operator“ ning „The Sweetest Taboo“ järgi.

clue_en: Nine Million Bicycles became an international hit for this Georgian-born British singer whose music blends pop, blues and jazz. Name her.
clue_et: „Nine Million Bicycles“ tõi sellele Gruusias sündinud Briti lauljale rahvusvahelise tuntuse; tema muusikas põimuvad popp, bluus ja džäss. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Georgian-born British singer Katie Melua became internationally known through songs including Nine Million Bicycles.
explanation_et: Gruusias sündinud Briti laulja Katie Melua sai rahvusvaheliselt tuntuks muu hulgas looga „Nine Million Bicycles“.

clue_en: This style developed in Puerto Rico from Spanish reggae of Panama, then its dembow rhythm travelled worldwide with artists such as Daddy Yankee. Name it.
clue_et: See stiil kujunes Puerto Ricos Panama hispaaniakeelsest reggae'st ning levis hiljem Daddy Yankee suguste artistide ja dembow-rütmiga üle maailma. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Reggaeton developed in Puerto Rico from Spanish reggae of Panama and is strongly associated with the repeating dembow rhythm.
explanation_et: Reggaeton kujunes Puerto Ricos Panama hispaaniakeelsest reggae'st ning seda seostatakse tugevalt korduva dembow-rütmiga.

clue_en: This Cuban music and dance tradition shares its name with one of the ballroom dances. Name it.
clue_et: See Kuuba muusika- ja tantsutraditsioon kannab sama nime ühe võistlustantsuga. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Rumba refers to related Cuban music and dance traditions and also gave its name to a ballroom dance.
explanation_et: Rumba tähistab omavahel seotud Kuuba muusika- ja tantsutraditsioone ning andis nime ka võistlustantsule.

clue_en: This relaxed samba style developed in Rio de Janeiro in the late 1950s and later entered a fruitful dialogue with jazz. Name it.
clue_et: See mahe sambastiil kujunes 1950. aastate lõpus Rio de Janeiros ning põimus hiljem džässiga. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Bossa nova developed as a relaxed samba style in Rio de Janeiro and later became closely associated with jazz musicians.
explanation_et: Bossanoova kujunes Rio de Janeiros maheda sambastiilina ning seostus hiljem tihedalt džässmuusikutega.

clue_en: This dance music began on Colombia's Caribbean coast and later spread across Latin America. Name it.
clue_et: See tantsumuusika sai alguse Colombia Kariibi mere rannikul ja levis hiljem üle Ladina-Ameerika. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Cumbia originated on Colombia's Caribbean coast and developed into many popular forms across Latin America.
explanation_et: Cumbia pärineb Colombia Kariibi mere rannikult ning sellest kujunes üle Ladina-Ameerika palju populaarseid vorme.

clue_en: The Dominican Republic claims this lively music and partner dance as a national tradition. Name it.
clue_et: Dominikaani Vabariik peab seda hoogsat muusika- ja paaristantsustiili oma rahvuslikuks traditsiooniks. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Merengue is a lively music and partner-dance genre closely associated with the Dominican Republic.
explanation_et: Merengue on hoogne muusika- ja paaristantsužanr, mida seostatakse tihedalt Dominikaani Vabariigiga.

clue_en: This red-haired English songwriter co-wrote Thinking Out Loud with Amy Wadge, then recorded it himself. Name him.
clue_et: See punapäine Inglise laulukirjutaja kirjutas loo „Thinking Out Loud“ koos Amy Wadge'iga ja salvestas selle ise. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Ed Sheeran and Amy Wadge wrote Thinking Out Loud, which Sheeran recorded for the album ×.
explanation_et: Ed Sheeran ja Amy Wadge kirjutasid loo „Thinking Out Loud“, mille Sheeran salvestas albumile „×“.

clue_en: This Canadian singer-songwriter co-wrote Complicated and Sk8er Boi for her debut album. Name her.
clue_et: See Kanada laulja-laulukirjutaja oli oma debüütalbumi lugude „Complicated“ ja „Sk8er Boi“ üks autoreid. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Canadian singer-songwriter Avril Lavigne co-wrote Complicated and Sk8er Boi for her debut album Let Go.
explanation_et: Kanada laulja-laulukirjutaja Avril Lavigne oli debüütalbumi „Let Go“ lugude „Complicated“ ja „Sk8er Boi“ üks autoreid.

clue_en: This Canadian singer-songwriter wrote and recorded her breakthrough song I'm Like a Bird. Name her.
clue_et: See Kanada laulja-laulukirjutaja kirjutas ja salvestas oma läbimurdelaulu „I'm Like a Bird“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Nelly Furtado wrote and recorded I'm Like a Bird for her debut album Whoa, Nelly!.
explanation_et: Nelly Furtado kirjutas ja salvestas loo „I'm Like a Bird“ oma debüütalbumile „Whoa, Nelly!“.

clue_en: This former British Army officer co-wrote You're Beautiful before recording it as his worldwide hit. Name the songwriter.
clue_et: See endine Briti armee ohvitser oli loo „You're Beautiful“ üks autoreid ja salvestas selle hiljem ülemaailmse hitina. Nimeta laulukirjutaja.
explanation_en: English singer-songwriter and former British Army officer James Blunt co-wrote and recorded You're Beautiful.
explanation_et: Inglise laulja-laulukirjutaja ja endine Briti armee ohvitser James Blunt oli loo „You're Beautiful“ üks autoreid ning salvestas selle ise.

clue_en: This Missouri singer-songwriter co-wrote If It Makes You Happy with Jeff Trott, then recorded it herself. Name her.
clue_et: See Missourist pärit laulja-laulukirjutaja kirjutas loo „If It Makes You Happy“ koos Jeff Trottiga ja salvestas selle ise. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Sheryl Crow and Jeff Trott wrote If It Makes You Happy, which Crow recorded for her self-titled album.
explanation_et: Sheryl Crow ja Jeff Trott kirjutasid loo „If It Makes You Happy“, mille Crow salvestas oma nime kandvale albumile.
source_title: If It Makes You Happy — Wikipedia

clue_en: A drummer grips a matched pair of these slender beaters to strike drums and cymbals. Name one.
clue_et: Trummar hoiab käes paari peenikesi löögivahendeid, et lüüa trumme ja taldrikuid. Nimeta üks.
explanation_en: A drumstick is a specialised beater used to strike drums, cymbals and other percussion instruments.
explanation_et: Trummipulk on eriline löögivahend trummide, taldrikute ja teiste löökpillide mängimiseks.

clue_en: A guitarist presses a string behind one of these raised strips on the neck to choose its sounding length. Name the strip.
clue_et: Kitarrist surub keele kaelal ühe sellise kõrgema riba taha, et määrata keele kõlava osa pikkus. Nimeta riba.
explanation_en: A fret is a raised strip on the neck of a stringed instrument that helps set the vibrating length of a stopped string.
explanation_et: Krihv on keelpilli kaelal olev kõrgem riba, mis aitab määrata allavajutatud keele võnkuva osa pikkust.

clue_en: A pianist presses one of these levers with a foot to sustain or soften the instrument's sound. Name one.
clue_et: Pianist vajutab jalaga üht neist hoobadest, et nootide kõla pikendada või pilli kõla pehmendada. Nimeta üks.
explanation_en: Piano pedals are foot-operated levers that alter the instrument's sound, for example by sustaining notes or making them softer.
explanation_et: Klaveripedaalid on jalaga juhitavad hoovad, mis näiteks pikendavad nootide kõla või muudavad pilli kõla pehmemaks.

clue_en: A guitarist clamps this device across the fretboard to shorten all strings and raise their pitch while keeping familiar chord shapes. Name it.
clue_et: Kitarrist kinnitab selle vahendi üle sõrmlaua, et lühendada kõiki keeli, tõsta nende helikõrgust ja säilitada tuttavad akordivõtted. Nimeta vahend.
explanation_en: A capo clamps across a fretted instrument's strings to raise their pitch while the player uses familiar chord shapes.
explanation_et: Barreevõti kinnitatakse üle keelpilli sõrmlaua, et tõsta kõigi keelte helikõrgust ja säilitada tuttavad akordivõtted.

clue_en: A string player rubs this sticky substance onto bow hair so it grips the strings. Name it.
clue_et: Keelpillimängija hõõrub seda kleepuvat ainet poognajõhvidele, et need haaraksid keeli paremini. Nimeta aine.
explanation_en: Rosin is rubbed onto bow hair to create the friction needed to set a string vibrating.
explanation_et: Kampolit hõõrutakse poognajõhvidele, et tekitada keele võnkuma panemiseks vajalik hõõrdumine.

clue_en: Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 is far better known by this night-sky nickname. Name the piece.
clue_et: Beethoveni 14. klaverisonaati tuntakse palju paremini selle öötaevast meenutava hüüdnime järgi. Nimeta teos.
explanation_en: Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 is commonly known as the Moonlight Sonata, a nickname added after his death.
explanation_et: Beethoveni 14. klaverisonaati tuntakse tavaliselt „Kuupaistesonaadina“; hüüdnimi lisandus pärast helilooja surma.

clue_en: Players hold their hands vertically, little fingers down, in a chopping motion for this widely known piano waltz. Name it.
clue_et: Selle tuntud klaverivalsi mängijad hoiavad käsi püstiselt, väikesed sõrmed all, ning teevad raiumist meenutavaid liigutusi. Nimeta pala.
explanation_en: Chopsticks is a widely known piano waltz played with the hands vertical and the little fingers making a chopping motion.
explanation_et: „Chopsticks“ on tuntud klaverivalss, mida mängides hoitakse käsi püstiselt ja tehakse väikeste sõrmedega raiumist meenutavaid liigutusi.

clue_en: Scott Joplin wrote this jaunty rag later made famous again by the film The Sting. Name the piece.
clue_et: Scott Joplin kirjutas selle hoogsa sünkopeeritud klaveripala, mille film „The Sting“ hiljem taas kuulsaks tegi. Nimeta teos.
explanation_en: The Entertainer is a rag by Scott Joplin that gained renewed popularity through the film The Sting.
explanation_et: „The Entertainer“ on Scott Joplini sünkopeeritud klaveripala, mis sai filmi „The Sting“ kaudu uuesti populaarseks.

clue_en: Its French title means moonlight: name Debussy's dreamy piano piece from Suite bergamasque.
clue_et: Selle prantsuskeelne pealkiri tähendab kuuvalgust. Nimeta Debussy unenäoline klaveripala süidist „Suite bergamasque“.
accepted_variants_en: Debussy's Clair de lune;Clair de Lune
accepted_variants_et: Debussy Clair de lune;Clair de Lune
explanation_en: Clair de lune, whose title means moonlight, is the third movement of Claude Debussy's Suite bergamasque.
explanation_et: „Clair de lune“, mille pealkiri tähendab kuuvalgust, on Claude Debussy „Suite bergamasque'i“ kolmas osa.

clue_en: Tom Hanks and Robert Loggia play this song as a duet on a giant floor piano in the film Big. Name it.
clue_et: Tom Hanks ja Robert Loggia mängivad seda laulu filmis „Big“ hiiglaslikul põrandaklaveril duetina. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Heart and Soul is a 1938 song by Hoagy Carmichael and Frank Loesser that is often played as a simple piano duet and appears in Big.
explanation_et: „Heart and Soul“ on Hoagy Carmichaeli ja Frank Loesseri 1938. aasta laul, mida mängitakse sageli lihtsa klaveriduetina ja mis kõlab filmis „Big“.
source_title: Heart and Soul (Frank Loesser and Hoagy Carmichael song) — Wikipedia

clue_en: A familiar French nursery round asks whether a friar is sleeping. Name the song.
clue_et: See tuntud prantsuse lastelaulukaanon küsib, kas munk magab. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Frère Jacques is a traditional French round about a sleeping friar.
explanation_et: „Frère Jacques“ on traditsiooniline prantsuse kaanon, mis räägib magavast mungast.

clue_en: Ivan Larionov wrote this Russian song whose title refers to the guelder-rose plant. Name it.
clue_et: Ivan Larionov kirjutas selle vene laulu, mille pealkiri viitab lodjapuule. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Kalinka is a Russian song written by Ivan Larionov; its title refers to the guelder-rose or snowball-tree plant.
explanation_et: „Kalinka“ on Ivan Larionovi kirjutatud vene laul, mille pealkiri viitab lodjapuule.

clue_en: People traditionally sing this Scots-language song at midnight on New Year's Eve. Name it.
clue_et: Seda šotikeelset laulu lauldakse traditsiooniliselt vana-aastaõhtu südaööl. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Auld Lang Syne is a Scots-language song traditionally sung around the world at the close of the old year.
explanation_et: „Auld Lang Syne“ on šotikeelne laul, mida lauldakse kogu maailmas traditsiooniliselt vana aasta lõpus.

clue_en: The title of this Cuban song means woman from Guantánamo. Name it.
clue_et: Selle Kuuba laulu pealkiri tähendab Guantánamost pärit naist. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Guantanamera is a Cuban song whose Spanish title means a woman from Guantánamo.
explanation_et: „Guantanamera“ on Kuuba laul, mille hispaaniakeelne pealkiri tähendab Guantánamost pärit naist.

clue_en: Frederic Weatherly's words turned the Irish tune Londonderry Air into this farewell song. Name it.
clue_et: Frederic Weatherly sõnad muutsid iiri viisi „Londonderry Air“ selleks hüvastijätulauluks. Nimeta laul.
explanation_en: Danny Boy sets words by Frederic Weatherly to the traditional Irish melody Londonderry Air.
explanation_et: „Danny Boy“ ühendab Frederic Weatherly sõnad traditsioonilise iiri viisiga „Londonderry Air“.

clue_en: Piano, double bass and drums make up the classic version of this three-player jazz ensemble. Name it.
clue_et: Klaver, kontrabass ja trummid moodustavad selle kolmeliikmelise džässansambli klassikalise koosseisu. Nimeta ansambel.
explanation_en: A jazz trio is a three-musician ensemble, often formed by piano, double bass and drums.
explanation_et: Džässitrio on kolmeliikmeline ansambel, kuhu kuuluvad sageli klaver, kontrabass ja trummid.

clue_en: Large dance bands, a strong rhythmic groove and stars such as Benny Goodman made this jazz style the sound of the 1930s. Name it.
clue_et: Suured tantsuorkestrid, hoogne rütm ja Benny Goodmani sarnased tähed tegid sellest džässistiilist 1930. aastate tunnuskõla. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Swing music became a dominant popular jazz style in the 1930s through dance-oriented big bands and bandleaders such as Benny Goodman.
explanation_et: Svingmuusika tõusis 1930. aastatel populaarseks džässistiiliks tantsuliste bigbändide ja Benny Goodmani sarnaste orkestrijuhtide kaudu.

clue_en: Before jazz fully emerged, this syncopated piano style spread through sheet music and player-piano rolls. Name the style.
clue_et: Enne džässi täielikku väljakujunemist levis see sünkopeeritud klaveristiil noodiväljaannete ja isemängivate klaverite rullide kaudu. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Ragtime is a strongly syncopated musical style that became widely known through published piano music and player-piano rolls.
explanation_et: Ragtime on tugevalt sünkopeeritud muusikastiil, mis sai laialt tuntuks klaverinootide ja isemängivate klaverite rullide kaudu.

clue_en: A jazz bassist outlines the chords with a steady, stepwise bass line. Name this technique.
clue_et: Džässbassist järgib akorde ühtlaselt astmeliselt liikuva bassiliiniga. Nimeta tehnika.
explanation_en: Walking bass creates regular movement through a mostly stepwise or arpeggiated line that outlines the harmony.
explanation_et: Kõndiv bass järgib harmooniat korrapäraselt liikuva, enamasti astmelise või murtud akordidel põhineva bassiliiniga.

clue_en: A restrained sound and lighter tone distinguished this postwar style from faster, fiery jazz. Name it.
clue_et: Vaoshoitud kõla ja kergem toon eristasid seda sõjajärgset stiili kiiremast ja tulisemast džässist. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Cool jazz developed after the Second World War with a comparatively relaxed and restrained approach.
explanation_et: Cool jazz kujunes pärast Teist maailmasõda suhteliselt rahuliku ja vaoshoitud lähenemisena.

clue_en: This large drum supplies the marching band's deepest boom and often marks the main pulse. Name it.
clue_et: See madalahäälne löökpill annab marsiorkestrile kõige sügavama kõma ja märgib sageli põhipulssi. Nimeta pill.
explanation_en: A bass drum is a large low-pitched drum used to provide a deep beat in ensembles including marching bands.
explanation_et: Suur trumm on madala kõlaga suur löökpill, mis annab muu hulgas marsiorkestris sügava põhilöögi.

clue_en: Wires stretched beneath this drum's lower head give marching rhythms their crisp rattle. Name the drum.
clue_et: Selle trummi alumise naha alla pingutatud traadid annavad marsirütmile terava põrina. Nimeta pill.
explanation_en: A snare drum has wires called snares stretched beneath its lower head, producing a sharp rattling sound.
explanation_et: Väikese trummi alumise naha all on pingutatud spiraaltraadid, mis tekitavad terava põriseva heli.

clue_en: This simple brass instrument normally has no valves, so players change notes with their lips. Name it.
clue_et: Sellel lihtsal vaskpuhkpillil pole tavaliselt ventiile, seega muudab mängija helikõrgust huulte abil. Nimeta pill.
explanation_en: A bugle is a simple brass signal instrument that normally has no valves; the player's embouchure controls its notes.
explanation_et: Signaalpasun on lihtne vaskpuhkpill, millel tavaliselt pole ventiile ja mille helisid juhib mängija ambušüür.

clue_en: This low brass instrument wraps around the player's body and carries a large forward-facing bell. Name it.
clue_et: See madal vaskpuhkpill keerdub ümber mängija keha ja selle suur lehter on suunatud ette. Nimeta pill.
explanation_en: A sousaphone is a tuba designed to coil around the player, making it practical for marching and outdoor performance.
explanation_et: Sousafon on ümber mängija keha keerduv tuuba, mis sobib marsiks ja vabas õhus esinemiseks.

clue_en: In marching ensembles, a bell-forward version of this deep-sounding valved instrument is carried horizontally. Its name literally suggests a pleasant sound. Name it.
clue_et: Marsikoosseisudes kantakse selle madalahäälse ventiilidega pilli ettepoole suunatud lehtriga versiooni rõhtsalt. Selle nimi viitab otseselt heale või mahedale kõlale. Nimeta pill.
explanation_en: The euphonium is a low-sounding valved instrument, and marching models have a horizontal, forward-facing bell.
explanation_et: Eufoonium on madalahäälne ventiilidega pill ning marsimudelil on rõhtne ettepoole suunatud lehter.

clue_en: In Western notation, notes are placed on five parallel horizontal lines and the spaces between them. Name this five-line system.
clue_et: Lääne noodikirjas paigutatakse noodid viiele paralleelsele rõhtjoonele ja nende vahedesse. Nimeta seda viiest joonest koosnevat süsteemi.
explanation_en: A musical staff is a set of usually five horizontal lines with spaces between them, used to write notes.
explanation_et: Noodijoonestik on tavaliselt viiest rõhtjoonest ja nendevahelistest vahedest koosnev süsteem, millele noodid kirjutatakse.

clue_en: This vertical mark crosses the staff to separate one measure from the next. Name it.
clue_et: See püstine märk läbib noodijoonestikku ja eraldab ühe takti järgmisest. Nimeta märk.
explanation_en: A bar line is a vertical mark in notation that shows the boundary between measures.
explanation_et: Taktijoon on noodijoonestikul olev püstjoon, mis märgib taktide piiri.

clue_en: A filled oval notehead with a stem usually lasts one beat in 4/4 time. Name this note value.
clue_et: Täidetud ovaalse noodipea ja noodivarrega noot kestab 4/4 taktimõõdus tavaliselt ühe löögi. Nimeta noodivältus.
explanation_en: A quarter note has a filled notehead and a stem and normally receives one beat in 4/4 time.
explanation_et: Veerandnoodil on täidetud noodipea ja noodivars ning 4/4 taktimõõdus kestab see tavaliselt ühe löögi.

clue_en: Two dots beside a double bar tell a performer to go back and play a section again. Name this symbol.
clue_et: Kaks täppi kahekordse taktijoone kõrval käsivad esitajal tagasi minna ja osa uuesti mängida. Nimeta märk.
explanation_en: A repeat sign marks music that should be performed again, usually with dots beside paired vertical strokes.
explanation_et: Kordusmärk tähistab uuesti esitatavat muusikalõiku ja koosneb tavaliselt kahekordse taktijoone kõrval olevatest täppidest.

clue_en: At the start of the staff, two stacked numbers such as 4 over 4 show how beats are grouped. Name this notation.
clue_et: Noodirea alguses näitavad kaks kohakuti arvu, näiteks 4 ja 4, kuidas löögid taktidesse rühmituvad. Nimeta märge.
explanation_en: A time signature indicates how many beats are grouped in each measure and which note value represents a beat.
explanation_et: Taktimõõt näitab, mitu lööki on taktis ja milline noodivältus vastab ühele löögile.

category_name_en: Classical Music That Tells a Story
clue_en: A narrator introduces a boy, a duck, a cat and a dangerous animal while each character is represented by an orchestra instrument. Name Prokofiev's musical tale.
clue_et: Jutustaja tutvustab poissi, parti, kassi ja ohtlikku looma ning iga tegelast kujutab orkestris eri pill. Nimeta Prokofjevi muusikaline muinasjutt.
explanation_en: Sergei Prokofiev wrote Peter and the Wolf as a narrated orchestral tale in which instruments represent the characters.
explanation_et: Sergei Prokofjev kirjutas „Petja ja hundi“ jutustajaga orkestriteoseks, kus tegelasi kujutavad eri pillid.

category_name_en: Classical Music That Tells a Story
clue_en: Lions, tortoises, an elephant and a swan parade through this Saint-Saëns suite. Name the animal-filled work.
clue_et: Lõvid, kilpkonnad, elevant ja luik astuvad üles selles Saint-Saënsi süidis. Nimeta loomadest tulvil teos.
explanation_en: Camille Saint-Saëns's suite The Carnival of the Animals portrays a playful procession of animals in separate movements.
explanation_et: Camille Saint-Saënsi süit „Loomade karneval“ kujutab eri osades mängulist loomade rongkäiku.
source_title: The Carnival of the Animals — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Classical Music That Tells a Story
clue_en: This 1897 orchestral scherzo by Paul Dukas became famous when Disney used it in Fantasia. Name the piece.
clue_et: See Paul Dukas' 1897. aasta orkestriskeertso sai kuulsaks, kui Disney kasutas seda filmis „Fantaasia“. Nimeta pala.
explanation_en: Paul Dukas composed The Sorcerer's Apprentice in 1897, and the piece became widely known through Disney's Fantasia.
explanation_et: Paul Dukas lõi „Nõia õpipoisi“ 1897. aastal ning pala sai laialt tuntuks Disney „Fantaasia“ kaudu.

category_name_en: Classical Music That Tells a Story
clue_en: Morning Mood and In the Hall of the Mountain King come from Edvard Grieg's music for an Ibsen drama. Name that drama's wandering hero and title.
clue_et: „Hommikumeeleolu“ ja „Mäekuninga koopas“ pärinevad Edvard Griegi muusikast Ibseni näidendile. Nimeta näidendi rändav nimikangelane.
explanation_en: Edvard Grieg composed incidental music for Henrik Ibsen's play Peer Gynt, including Morning Mood and In the Hall of the Mountain King.
explanation_et: Edvard Grieg kirjutas Henrik Ibseni näidendile „Peer Gynt“ lavamuusika, mille hulka kuuluvad „Hommikumeeleolu“ ja „Mäekuninga koopas“.

category_name_en: Classical Music That Tells a Story
clue_en: The Lone Ranger gallops to the famous finale of this Rossini overture, whose opera tells of a Swiss hero. Name the work.
clue_et: Telesarja „The Lone Ranger“ kangelane kappab selle Rossini avamängu kuulsa finaali saatel; ooper jutustab Šveitsi kangelasest. Nimeta teos.
explanation_en: Rossini's William Tell Overture opens the opera about the Swiss hero, and its galloping finale became famous as the theme for The Lone Ranger.
explanation_et: Rossini „Wilhelm Telli avamäng“ alustab Šveitsi kangelasest jutustavat ooperit ning selle kappav finaal sai tuntuks telesarja „The Lone Ranger“ tunnusmuusikana.

clue_en: This Alpine-associated singing technique rapidly switches between a low chest voice and a high head voice. Name it.
clue_et: See Alpidega seostatud laulutehnika vaheldab kiiresti madalamat rinnahäält ja kõrget peahäält. Nimeta tehnika.
explanation_en: Yodeling features rapid repeated changes between the lower chest register and the higher head register.
explanation_et: Joodeldamisele on iseloomulik kiire korduv vaheldumine madalama rinna- ja kõrgema pearegistri vahel.

clue_en: Sailors once sang this work song together to coordinate hauling ropes or raising an anchor. Name the song type.
clue_et: Meremehed laulsid seda töölaulu koos, et köite tõmbamist või ankru hiivamist rütmis teha. Nimeta laululiik.
explanation_en: A sea shanty is a rhythmic work song formerly sung aboard large sailing vessels to coordinate labour.
explanation_et: Meremeeste töölaul on rütmiline laul, mida lauldi purjelaevadel ühise töö koordineerimiseks.

clue_en: Close harmony, simple beats and playful nonsense syllables mark this 1950s vocal-group style. Name it.
clue_et: Lähiharmoonia, lihtne rütm ja mängulised tähenduseta silbid iseloomustavad seda 1950. aastate vokaalansamblistiili. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Doo-wop is a rhythm-and-blues vocal style known for close harmony and repeated nonsense syllables.
explanation_et: Doo-wop on rütmibluusi vokaalstiil, mida iseloomustavad lähiharmoonia ja korduvad tähenduseta silbid.

clue_en: Four unaccompanied voices sing close harmony as lead, tenor, baritone and bass in this style. Name it.
clue_et: Neli saateta häält laulavad selles stiilis lähiharmoonias juht-, tenori-, baritoni- ja bassipartiid. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Barbershop music uses close four-part unaccompanied vocal harmony, traditionally labelled lead, tenor, baritone and bass.
explanation_et: Barbershop-muusikas kõlab saateta neljahäälne lähiharmoonia, mille partiid on juht, tenor, bariton ja bass.

clue_en: Singers use this name for the human voice's highest register, which can produce flute-like notes. Name it.
clue_et: Selle nimega tähistatakse inimhääle kõrgeimat registrit, milles saab tekitada flööditaolisi helisid. Nimeta register.
explanation_en: The whistle register is the highest register of the human voice and produces very high, flute-like tones.
explanation_et: Vileregister on inimhääle kõrgeim register ja selles tekivad väga kõrged flööditaolised helid.

clue_en: This New Jersey songwriter wrote and recorded Born in the U.S.A. and became known as The Boss. Name him.
clue_et: See New Jerseyst pärit laulukirjutaja kirjutas ja salvestas loo „Born in the U.S.A.“ ning sai tuntuks hüüdnimega The Boss. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: New Jersey singer-songwriter Bruce Springsteen wrote and recorded Born in the U.S.A. and is widely nicknamed The Boss.
explanation_et: New Jerseyst pärit laulja-laulukirjutaja Bruce Springsteen kirjutas ja salvestas loo „Born in the U.S.A.“ ning teda tuntakse hüüdnimega The Boss.

clue_en: This New York songwriter wrote Piano Man from his experience playing in a Los Angeles piano bar. Name him.
clue_et: See New Yorgist pärit laulukirjutaja kirjutas „Piano Mani“ oma Los Angelese klaveribaaris mängimise kogemusest. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: American singer-songwriter Billy Joel wrote Piano Man after working as a lounge pianist in Los Angeles.
explanation_et: Ameerika laulja-laulukirjutaja Billy Joel kirjutas „Piano Mani“ pärast seda, kui oli töötanud Los Angeleses salongipianistina.

clue_en: This American singer-songwriter wrote both Fast Car and Talkin' 'bout a Revolution for her debut album. Name her.
clue_et: See USA laulja-laulukirjutaja kirjutas oma debüütalbumile nii loo „Fast Car“ kui ka „Talkin' 'bout a Revolution“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: American singer-songwriter Tracy Chapman wrote Fast Car and Talkin' 'bout a Revolution for her self-titled debut album.
explanation_et: USA laulja-laulukirjutaja Tracy Chapman kirjutas oma nime kandvale debüütalbumile lood „Fast Car“ ja „Talkin' 'bout a Revolution“.

clue_en: This American singer-songwriter wrote Fire and Rain about personal loss and recorded it for Sweet Baby James. Name him.
clue_et: See USA laulja-laulukirjutaja kirjutas isiklikust kaotusest loo „Fire and Rain“ ja salvestas selle albumile „Sweet Baby James“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: American singer-songwriter James Taylor wrote and recorded Fire and Rain for his album Sweet Baby James.
explanation_et: USA laulja-laulukirjutaja James Taylor kirjutas ja salvestas albumile „Sweet Baby James“ loo „Fire and Rain“.

clue_en: She co-wrote Will You Love Me Tomorrow for another group before writing and recording songs for her own album Tapestry. Name her.
clue_et: Ta oli ansamblile The Shirelles loodud laulu „Will You Love Me Tomorrow“ üks autoreid ning kirjutas ja salvestas hiljem laule oma albumile „Tapestry“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Carole King co-wrote Will You Love Me Tomorrow before becoming a recording artist and songwriter behind the album Tapestry.
explanation_et: Carole King oli loo „Will You Love Me Tomorrow“ üks autoreid ning sai hiljem albumi „Tapestry“ esitaja ja laulukirjutajana tuntuks.

clue_en: A player strikes rubber or mesh pads, and a sound module turns the hits into percussion sounds. Name this digital drum setup.
clue_et: Mängija lööb kummist või võrkkattega patju ning helimoodul muudab löögid löökpillihelideks. Nimeta see digitaalne trummikomplekt.
explanation_en: Electronic drums use playable pads and an electronic sound module to produce percussion sounds.
explanation_et: Elektrontrummides tekitavad mängitavad padjad ja elektrooniline helimoodul löökpillihelisid.

clue_en: Its piano-style keys usually send performance instructions to software or another sound module rather than making acoustic sound themselves. Name this controller.
clue_et: Selle klaverilaadsed klahvid saadavad tavaliselt mängukäske tarkvarale või helimoodulile, mitte ei tekita ise akustilist heli. Nimeta see kontroller.
explanation_en: A MIDI keyboard is a piano-style controller that sends MIDI performance data to another device or software instrument.
explanation_et: MIDI-klaviatuur on klaverilaadne kontroller, mis saadab MIDI-mänguandmeid teisele seadmele või tarkvarapillile.

clue_en: A solo musician records a phrase during a performance, starts it repeating and plays the next part over it. Name this device.
clue_et: Soolomuusik salvestab esinemise ajal fraasi, laseb selle korduses käima ja mängib järgmise partii peale. Nimeta seade.
explanation_en: A loop station records short passages and repeats them so a performer can build layered music live.
explanation_et: Luuper salvestab lühikesi lõike ja kordab neid, et esitaja saaks reaalajas kihilist muusikat luua.

clue_en: A producer records, edits and mixes tracks on a computer inside this kind of music software. Name it.
clue_et: Produtsent salvestab, töötleb ja miksib arvutis heliradu seda liiki muusikatarkvaras. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: DAW software is used to record, edit, arrange and mix digital audio.
explanation_et: DAW-tarkvara kasutatakse digitaalse heli salvestamiseks, töötlemiseks, seadmiseks ja miksimiseks.

clue_en: This hardware or software arranges recorded or programmed musical events along a timeline for later playback. Name it.
clue_et: See riistvara või tarkvara paigutab salvestatud või programmeeritud muusikasündmused ajajoonele, et neid hiljem esitada. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: A music sequencer records, edits and plays back musical performance information in an ordered sequence.
explanation_et: Sekventser salvestab, muudab ja esitab muusikalist esitusinfot järjestatud jadana.

clue_en: Pop music performed mainly in Spanish or Portuguese is grouped under this two-word genre name. Name it.
clue_et: Peamiselt hispaania või portugali keeles esitatud popmuusikat koondatakse selle kahe sõnaga žanrinimetuse alla. Nimeta žanr.
explanation_en: Latin pop is a broad label for popular music from Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking areas and performers.
explanation_et: Ladinapopp on hispaania- ja portugalikeelsete piirkondade ning esitajate popmuusika lai koondnimetus.

clue_en: This Cuban dance-music genre was popularised in big-band form by Pérez Prado and became a 1940s–1950s dance craze. Name it.
clue_et: Selle Kuuba tantsumuusikažanri tegi bigbändiseades tuntuks Pérez Prado ning 1940.–1950. aastatel sai sellest tantsuhullus. Nimeta žanr.
explanation_en: Mambo is a Cuban dance-music genre that Pérez Prado popularised internationally in a big-band form.
explanation_et: Mambo on Kuuba tantsumuusikažanr, mille Pérez Prado tegi bigbändiseades rahvusvaheliselt tuntuks.

clue_en: This jazz genre uses Latin American rhythms; its main branches include Afro-Cuban and Afro-Brazilian jazz. Name it.
clue_et: Selles džässižanris kasutatakse Ladina-Ameerika rütme; selle peamiste harude hulka kuuluvad afrokuuba ja afrobrasiilia džäss. Nimeta žanr.
explanation_en: Latin jazz combines jazz with Latin American rhythms, especially through Afro-Cuban and Afro-Brazilian branches.
explanation_et: Ladina džäss ühendab džässi Ladina-Ameerika rütmidega, eriti afrokuuba ja afrobrasiilia harude kaudu.

clue_en: This Spanish phrase names rock music whose vocals are sung in Spanish. Give the phrase.
clue_et: Selle hispaaniakeelse väljendiga nimetatakse hispaaniakeelsete vokaalidega rokkmuusikat. Nimeta väljend.
explanation_en: Rock en español is the Spanish-language term for rock music performed with Spanish vocals.
explanation_et: Rock en español on hispaaniakeelne nimetus hispaaniakeelsete vokaalidega rokkmuusikale.

clue_en: This eastern Cuban music-and-dance tradition blends Spanish-derived song and guitar with African-rooted clave, call-and-response and percussion. Name it.
clue_et: See Ida-Kuubast pärit muusika- ja tantsutraditsioon ühendab Hispaania päritolu laulustiili ja kitarri Aafrika juurtega clave-rütmi, eeslaulja ja koori vaheldumise ning löökpillidega. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Son cubano developed in eastern Cuba by combining Spanish-derived song and guitar with African-rooted rhythms, vocal exchange and percussion.
explanation_et: Son cubano kujunes Ida-Kuubas, ühendades Hispaania päritolu laulustiili ja kitarri Aafrika juurtega rütmide, vokaalse vaheldumise ning löökpillidega.

clue_en: Time to Say Goodbye and duets that bridge opera and pop point to this blind Italian tenor. Name him.
clue_et: „Time to Say Goodbye“ ning ooperit ja poppi ühendavad duetid viitavad sellele pimedale Itaalia tenorile. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Blind Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli became internationally known through recordings that cross between classical and popular music, including Time to Say Goodbye.
explanation_et: Pime Itaalia tenor Andrea Bocelli sai rahvusvaheliselt tuntuks klassikalist ja levimuusikat ühendavate salvestistega, sealhulgas looga „Time to Say Goodbye“.

clue_en: This Dutch violinist leads the Johann Strauss Orchestra in festive concerts filled with waltzes. Name him.
clue_et: See Hollandi viiuldaja juhatab pidulikel valsikontsertidel Johann Straussi orkestrit. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Dutch violinist André Rieu founded and leads the Johann Strauss Orchestra, known for popular performances of waltzes.
explanation_et: Hollandi viiuldaja André Rieu asutas Johann Straussi orkestri ja juhib seda populaarsetel valsikontsertidel.

clue_en: This Paris-born cellist's work ranges from Bach recordings to projects with the Silk Road Ensemble. Name him.
clue_et: Selle Pariisis sündinud tšellisti tegevus ulatub Bachi teoste salvestamisest Silk Road Ensemble'i projektideni. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Cellist Yo-Yo Ma has recorded Bach and founded the Silk Road Ensemble alongside his classical career.
explanation_et: Tšellist Yo-Yo Ma on salvestanud Bachi teoseid ning asutas klassikalise karjääri kõrval Silk Road Ensemble'i.

clue_en: This Greek-American soprano, nicknamed La Divina, became one of the twentieth century's most celebrated opera singers. Name her.
clue_et: See kreeka-ameerika sopran hüüdnimega La Divina sai üheks 20. sajandi kuulsaimaks ooperilauljaks. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Greek-American soprano Maria Callas was one of the twentieth century's most renowned opera singers and was nicknamed La Divina.
explanation_et: Kreeka-Ameerika sopran Maria Callas oli üks 20. sajandi hinnatumaid ooperilauljaid ning kandis hüüdnime La Divina.

clue_en: This Chinese concert pianist's name repeats the same spelling in the Latin alphabet, and he performed at the 2008 Beijing Olympics opening ceremony. Name him.
clue_et: Selle Hiina kontsertpianisti nimi kordab ladina kirjas sama kirjapilti ning ta esines 2008. aasta Pekingi olümpiamängude avatseremoonial. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Chinese concert pianist Lang Lang, whose two names have the same Latin-alphabet spelling but different tones, performed at the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games opening ceremony.
explanation_et: Hiina kontsertpianist Lang Lang, kelle kahe nime kirjapilt on ladina kirjas sama, kuid toon erineb, esines 2008. aasta Pekingi olümpiamängude avatseremoonial.

clue_en: Metal plates on a dancer's shoes turn footwork into audible percussion in this style. Name it.
clue_et: Tantsija kingade metallplaadid muudavad sammud selles stiilis kuuldavaks löökpillipartiiks. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Tap dance uses shoes fitted with metal taps to create rhythmic percussion through footwork.
explanation_et: Stepp kasutab metallplaatidega kingi, et luua sammudega rütmilist löökpillikõla.

clue_en: Bent knees, swinging arms and fast kicks made this 1920s dance named after a South Carolina city instantly recognisable. Name it.
clue_et: Kõverdatud põlved, hoogsed käeliigutused ja kiired jalalöögid tegid selle Lõuna-Carolina linna järgi nimetatud 1920. aastate tantsu kergesti äratuntavaks. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: The Charleston is an energetic dance named for Charleston, South Carolina, and closely associated with the 1920s.
explanation_et: Tšarleston on energiline Lõuna-Carolina Charlestoni järgi nimetatud tants, mida seostatakse tihedalt 1920. aastatega.

clue_en: Long, smooth travelling steps give this partner dance its characteristic slow-slow-quick-quick rhythm. Name it.
clue_et: Pikad sujuvad sammud annavad sellele paaristantsule iseloomuliku „aeglane–aeglane–kiire–kiire“ rütmi. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: The foxtrot is a smooth progressive partner dance commonly taught with a slow-slow-quick-quick rhythm.
explanation_et: Fokstrott on sujuvalt edasi liikuv paaristants, mida õpetatakse sageli rütmiga „aeglane–aeglane–kiire–kiire“.

clue_en: High-stepping couples once competed for a cake as the prize in this dance, whose name later came to mean an easy task. Name it.
clue_et: Kõrgete sammudega paarid võistlesid selles tantsus kunagi auhinnaks olnud koogi nimel; tantsu ingliskeelne nimi hakkas hiljem tähendama lihtsat ülesannet. Nimeta tants.
explanation_en: The cakewalk developed as a competitive dance whose prize was often a cake, and its name later became a term for something easily accomplished.
explanation_et: Cakewalk kujunes võistlustantsuna, mille auhind oli sageli kook, ning selle nimi hakkas hiljem tähendama kergesti tehtavat asja.

clue_en: Keeping the torso mostly still while the shoulders shake rapidly creates this Jazz Age dance. Name it.
clue_et: Selles džässiajastu tantsus püsib kere suuresti paigal, kuid õlad värisevad kiiresti. Nimeta tants.
explanation_en: The shimmy is a dance in which the body is held fairly still while the shoulders move rapidly back and forth.
explanation_et: Shimmy on tants, milles keha püsib üsna paigal ja õlad liiguvad kiiresti edasi-tagasi.

clue_en: BTS and BLACKPINK helped take this South Korean popular-music style to a worldwide audience. Name the style.
clue_et: BTS ja BLACKPINK aitasid selle Lõuna-Korea popmuusikastiili ülemaailmse publikuni viia. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: K-pop is South Korean popular music that gained a large international audience through acts including BTS and BLACKPINK.
explanation_et: K-pop on Lõuna-Korea popmuusika, mis jõudis muu hulgas BTS-i ja BLACKPINKi kaudu suure rahvusvahelise publikuni.

clue_en: This short label means Japanese popular music and became common for Japan's modern mainstream sound. Name it.
clue_et: See lühinimetus tähendab Jaapani popmuusikat ja kinnistus Jaapani moodsa peavoolumuusika kohta. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: J-pop is the common abbreviated name for modern Japanese popular music.
explanation_et: J-pop on Jaapani moodsa popmuusika levinud lühinimetus.

clue_en: Songs written for India's Hindi-language cinema form this tradition, often known internationally through Bollywood. Name it.
clue_et: India hindikeelsele kinole kirjutatud laulud moodustavad selle muusikatraditsiooni, mida tuntakse rahvusvaheliselt sageli Bollywoodi kaudu. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Hindi film music consists of songs written and performed for Hindi-language cinema and is widely associated with Bollywood.
explanation_et: Hindi filmimuusika koosneb hindikeelsele kinole kirjutatud ja esitatud lauludest ning seda seostatakse laialt Bollywoodiga.

clue_en: Burna Boy and Wizkid helped take this contemporary West African pop umbrella, centred especially in Nigeria and Ghana, around the world. Name it.
clue_et: Burna Boy ja Wizkid aitasid selle eriti Nigeeria ja Ghanaga seotud nüüdisaegse Lääne-Aafrika popmuusika koondnimetuse üle maailma viia. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Afrobeats is an umbrella term for contemporary West African popular music, distinct from the older genre called Afrobeat.
explanation_et: Afrobeats on nüüdisaegse Lääne-Aafrika popmuusika koondnimetus ning erineb vanemast žanrist Afrobeat.

clue_en: Hong Kong popular songs performed mainly in Cantonese carry this blended name. Name the style.
clue_et: Peamiselt kantoni keeles esitatud Hongkongi poplaulud kannavad seda liitsõnalist nimetust. Nimeta stiil.
explanation_en: Cantopop is a form of popular music associated with Hong Kong and sung chiefly in Cantonese.
explanation_et: Cantopop on Hongkongiga seostatud popmuusika, mida lauldakse peamiselt kantoni keeles.

clue_en: This Polish-born Romantic composer became inseparable from the piano through his nocturnes, études and mazurkas. Name him.
clue_et: See Poolas sündinud romantismiaja helilooja sai oma nokturnide, etüüdide ja masurkade kaudu klaveriga lahutamatult seotuks. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Frédéric Chopin was a Polish-born Romantic composer and pianist celebrated for works including nocturnes, études and mazurkas.
explanation_et: Frédéric Chopin oli Poolas sündinud romantismiaja helilooja ja pianist, kes on tuntud muu hulgas nokturnide, etüüdide ja masurkade poolest.

clue_en: Hungarian Rhapsodies and dazzling piano showpieces point to this Hungarian Romantic composer and virtuoso. Name him.
clue_et: „Ungari rapsoodiad“ ja säravad klaveripalad viitavad sellele Ungari romantismiaja heliloojale ja virtuoosile. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Hungarian Romantic composer and pianist Franz Liszt wrote the Hungarian Rhapsodies and many virtuoso piano works.
explanation_et: Ungari romantismiaja helilooja ja pianist Franz Liszt kirjutas „Ungari rapsoodiad“ ja palju virtuoosseid klaveriteoseid.

clue_en: This Viennese composer wrote the song Erlkönig and left a famous symphony Unfinished. Name him.
clue_et: See Viini helilooja kirjutas laulu „Metshaldjas“ ning jättis ühe kuulsa sümfoonia lõpetamata. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: Viennese composer Franz Schubert wrote the art song Erlkönig and the work known as the Unfinished Symphony.
explanation_et: Viini helilooja Franz Schubert kirjutas kunstlaulu „Metshaldjas“ ja teose, mida tuntakse „Lõpetamata sümfooniana“.

clue_en: Four symphonies and the lively Hungarian Dances point to this German Romantic composer. Name him.
clue_et: Neli sümfooniat ja särtsakad „Ungari tantsud“ viitavad sellele Saksa romantismiaja heliloojale. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: German Romantic composer Johannes Brahms wrote four symphonies and the collection of Hungarian Dances.
explanation_et: Saksa romantismiaja helilooja Johannes Brahms kirjutas neli sümfooniat ja kogumiku „Ungari tantsud“.

clue_en: The Wedding March heard at many ceremonies comes from this German Romantic composer's music for A Midsummer Night's Dream. Name him.
clue_et: Paljudel pulmatseremooniatel kõlav „Pulmamarss“ pärineb selle Saksa romantismiaja helilooja muusikast näidendile „Suveöö unenägu“. Nimeta ta.
explanation_en: German Romantic composer Felix Mendelssohn wrote the Wedding March as part of his music for A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation_et: Saksa romantismiaja helilooja Felix Mendelssohn kirjutas „Pulmamarsi“ osana oma muusikast näidendile „Suveöö unenägu“.

clue_en: Du hast and spectacular pyrotechnic concerts point to this German industrial-metal band. Name it.
clue_et: „Du hast“ ja suurejoonelised pürotehnilised kontserdid viitavad sellele Saksa industrial metal'i ansamblile. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Rammstein is a German industrial-metal band known for Du hast and concert performances featuring extensive pyrotechnics.
explanation_et: Rammstein on Saksa industrial metal'i ansambel, mida tuntakse loo „Du hast“ ja rohke pürotehnikaga kontsertide järgi.

clue_en: Lovefool and My Favourite Game came from this Swedish rock band fronted by Nina Persson. Name it.
clue_et: „Lovefool“ ja „My Favourite Game“ pärinevad sellelt Nina Perssoni juhitud Rootsi rokkansamblilt. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: The Cardigans are a Swedish rock band fronted by Nina Persson and known for songs including Lovefool and My Favourite Game.
explanation_et: The Cardigans on Nina Perssoni juhitud Rootsi rokkansambel, mida tuntakse muu hulgas lugude „Lovefool“ ja „My Favourite Game“ järgi.

clue_en: Former Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl founded this American rock band. Name it.
clue_et: Nirvana endine trummar Dave Grohl asutas selle Ameerika rokkansambli. Nimeta see.
explanation_en: Dave Grohl founded the American rock band Foo Fighters after his time as Nirvana's drummer.
explanation_et: Dave Grohl asutas Ameerika rokkansambli Foo Fighters pärast Nirvana trummarina tegutsemist.

clue_en: How You Remind Me became an international hit for this Canadian rock band fronted by Chad Kroeger. Name the band.
clue_et: „How You Remind Me“ sai selle Chad Kroegeri juhitud Kanada rokkansambli rahvusvaheliseks hitiks. Nimeta ansambel.
explanation_en: Nickelback are a Canadian rock band fronted by Chad Kroeger whose breakthrough international hit was How You Remind Me.
explanation_et: Nickelback on Chad Kroegeri juhitud Kanada rokkansambel, mille rahvusvaheliseks läbimurdehitiks sai „How You Remind Me“.

clue_en: Matt Bellamy fronts this British rock trio behind Supermassive Black Hole and Uprising. Name the band.
clue_et: Matt Bellamy juhib seda Briti rokitriot, mille tuntud lugude hulka kuuluvad „Supermassive Black Hole“ ja „Uprising“. Nimeta ansambel.
explanation_en: Muse are a British rock trio fronted by Matt Bellamy and known for songs including Supermassive Black Hole and Uprising.
explanation_et: Muse on Matt Bellamy juhitud Briti rokitrio, mida tuntakse muu hulgas lugude „Supermassive Black Hole“ ja „Uprising“ järgi.
